sections.title: VESTAX PDX-2000
sections.overview: Standard model of turntable developed for professional DJ.Based on requests from DJs and musicians who use turntables, the PDX 2000 was developed by reconsidering the concept and design concept of turntables as conventional audio equipment and reconsidering the functions and performance required for turntables as musical instruments.The tone arm is equipped with a newly developed A. S. T. S. (Anti Skipping Tonearm System). By synergizing with the T. H. (tracing and holding) system, the tone arm effectively reduces the movement in both directions, and reduces the number of needle skipping by more than 90%.A. S. T. S. does not seek cancellation of inside force and outside force, but it is made on the assumption that the effective length of the arm is shortened so that these vectors do not occur.This minimizes the lateral vibration that occurs during rotation and reverse rotation, greatly reducing the burden on the cantilever.In the trace-hold method, the center of gravity position of the balance weight is lower than the arm supporting point to increase the restoring force, thereby minimizing the vertical amplitude of the tone arm generated when touching the surface of the record board.In addition to the conventional   10% rotational speed adjustment, it is equipped with the world's first   50% ultra pitch fader.Pitch adjustment up to   60% is possible when used together. Also equipped with a reverse function that enables instantaneous forward / reverse rotation at constant speed.A newly designed original DC motor is used in the motor section, and torque of up to 4.7CN/m is obtained, and constant speed rotation is achieved within 0.5 seconds. In addition, attention is paid to the magnetization pattern of extra-large ferrite magnet, and smooth rotation is achieved.In addition, in order to control the speed, torque, start / stop time, etc. of the high-power DC motor, a high-speed CPU with an internal 32-bit configuration is adopted. This increases the reaction speed in units of one hundredth of a second and makes it possible to follow any movement.The platters are die-cast and fixed to the motor with two screws.The slope and shape of the side are also designed for braking.The chassis uses a resin chassis with a maximum thickness of 15 mm by low foam molding of ABS, and meets the high durability, impact resistance, and feedback resistance required for professional equipment.Uses a vibration absorbing gel insulator that minimizes howling.There was a black version available only in Japan.There was a version upgrade service for PDX 2000 to PDX 2300.When upgrading, the part of the quartz lock switch is changed to pitch bend.There was an original dust cover as an option sold separately.

sections.title: VESTAX VRX-2000
sections.overview: This is a vinyl recorder developed over three years utilizing top engineering in various fields such as acoustic engineering, electromagnetism, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, etc.The VRX 2000 is an all-in-one type of vinyl recorder that consists of an input limiter, compensation EQ, drive power amplifier, cutting arm, playback arm and cutting head.The cutting time is approximately 12 minutes for one side and 24 minutes for both sides at 33 1/3 rotation, and approximately 9 minutes for one side and 18 minutes for both sides at 45 rotation.The XLR balanced input terminal and the RCA unbalanced input terminal are used as input.The -10, 0, and + 4 dB attenuator switch conversion supports input levels from various devices.In addition, it is equipped with a dedicated tone arm and phono output for immediate monitoring of cut records.Equipped with a   10% pitch control that can be used for both cutting and playback, the rotational speed control can be finely adjusted according to the load needle pressure.Appropriate level control is possible while checking the signal input to the cutting head with the stereo VU meter.Equipped with static electricity removal device that generates ions.This prevents static electricity noise and enables easy chip disposal.The cutting head uses VCH-1, an original V-drive stereo cutting head.The VCH-1 boasts excellent frequency characteristics, and realizes high maintainability so that it can be easily replaced even if the coil is damaged by fire. Moreover, the cutting stylus can be easily replaced.A maintenance kit is included.A set includes an anti-static ion generator, a brush for chip removal, bamboo tweezers, a stylus cleaner, a driver for replacing the stylus, a spring weight for needle pressure adjustment, and a record cleaner.The record cut on an original vinyl board (Hermodisc) has almost the same durability as a commercial record, and has a specification that reduces the power level degradation to less than 6 dB even after more than 100 uses.Cutting is also possible on lacquer and acetate boards.Cutting work can be done relatively easily, but special know-how is required for setup, so participation in the training session was required at the time of purchase.Some music sources require analog recording techniques such as high-frequency limiter processing and master comps.

sections.title: VICTOR JP-S7
sections.overview: This is a pre-amplifier that gathers the best of circuit technology and adds JVC's original design philosophy such as elimination of shield wire and final circuit decision by hearing.The equalizer circuit uses a 7-stage 3-stage direct-coupled configuration with differential inputs and class A push-pull outputs. By operating at a high voltage of   59 v, an allowable input of 350 mv and a total gain of 40 db are obtained.In addition, no mechanical contacts are used for the input switching of the Route 3. Instead, a pure electronic switch with a MOS FET and diode is used. As a result, there is no shield line from the input terminals to the EQ board. This prevents changes over time caused by oxidation or sulfurization of the mechanical contacts.The volume is a 4-row slide type. In addition to the input section, the output buffer amplifier section also reduces the volume to reduce residual noise.The SEA graphic equalizer uses a newly developed semiconductor L-circuit.Unlike conventional SEA, this system uses a combination of a 100% NFB circuit consisting of a capacitor and a transistor to change the frequency characteristics. Since no coil is used, there is no need to worry about core distortion or induction hum, and the allowable input also increased.Each variable element is arranged at intervals of one octave, and the center frequency of the highest range can be changed in three stages.The adjustment is done with a 2-dB-step clicked slide volume, gain is 1, and the whole circuit can be impaired.Flat amplifiers other than SEA are mainly composed of inverted Darlington circuits with low distortion and excellent frequency characteristics.These can also be dimmed by the switch, and the filter, loudness and output buffer amplifier are still active.Equipped with 3-stage selector switch for load resistance and load capacity of MM cartridge.The Phono2 and 3, Aux1 and 2, and Output2 are equipped with volume on the rear panel for level adjustment.It has an output amplifier for headphones only.The power supply section uses a cut core transformer with good regulation and low leakage flux.All power supply circuits operate with   2 power supply except for the headphone amplifier.Equipped with 2-system tape monitor capable of mutually dubbing.The Rec out has a buffer amplifier.Aluminum die-cast panel is adopted.Side panels were sold separately.

sections.title: VICTOR P-2020
sections.overview: 2020 series control amplifier.To support MC cartridges, it is equipped with a head amplifier composed of 6 carefully selected low-noise FETs.An FET is used in the first stage of the equalizer amplifier section. In order to take advantage of FET, an ICL circuit without a capacitor is used in the input section of all stages. Because FET is a voltage amplifier with high input impedance, unlike transistors, which are originally current amplifiers, voltage amplification can be performed directly. Moreover, even when the signal source impedance is not constant, the influence on the operation of the circuit is reduced.In addition to utilizing circuit technology for low distortion rate, wide band and stable operation, such as double differential circuit for reducing dynamic strain, class-A operation for all stages, design with as few shield wires as possible, and power-oriented design, excellent parts such as polypropylene condenser are used.The tone circuit is similar to that of the equalizer, and new consideration has been given to the curve and accuracy of the volume in order to improve the accuracy of the variation characteristics, so that a total of 21 click points have less waviness.In the flat position, the frequency characteristics and distortion factor hardly change regardless of whether the tone switch is turned ON or DEFEAT.The Phono1 input has a 3-stage cartridge load switching function.The tape input is provided in the Route 3, one of which is pulled out to the front panel.In order to reduce distortion due to volume and deterioration of sound quality, the slider is made into multi-contact, which greatly reduces current distortion and sliding noise. In addition, the twin volume configuration, which is placed in front and rear of the tone amplifier, also improves the S/N of hearing sense at low volume.Equipped with a subsonic filter and -20dB muting switch.Equipped with a relay type muting circuit that cuts noise when the power is turned ON/OFF.Equipped with two output terminals.

sections.title: VICTOR P-3030
sections.overview: This is a control amplifier that challenged the thin design while pursuing the quality and various control functions of a separate amplifier.The MC head amplifier uses an FET that is effective in improving the SN ratio by strictly selecting noise, and adopts a circuit configuration that takes advantage of the characteristics of the FET to achieve an excellent SN ratio and low distortion factor.An ICL (Input Capacitor-less) circuit without the input coupling and capacitor has been adopted for all signal circuits including the MC head amplifier, equalizer and tone amplifier. This circuit has succeeded in greatly improving the transient characteristics and phase characteristics in the low frequency range.A noise-selective FET is used for the first stage, and the equalizer and tone amplifier are double-differential inputs. This circuit is very effective in reducing distortion and achieves a total harmonic distortion factor of 0.005% by synergistic effect with the ICL circuit.The newly developed High Legh Near Volume is used.This volume has a special structure with a current distortion of less than 0.003% and a voltage distortion of less than 0.0005% by homogenization of the resistor material and improvement of the manufacturing process. The linearity of volume vs. distortion at low volume is remarkably improved. This volume is coupled with twin configuration arranged in front and back of the tone amplifier, so residual noise at low volume is effectively cut.The power supply section uses a highly efficient cut-core transformer with less leakage flux to supply stabilized power to all stages. The AC cord uses a high-capacity 15A cord.In order to obtain optimum characteristics for various cartridges, it is possible to switch between 4 stages of load resistance and 4 stages of load capacity.The 100   position is also compatible with high-output MC cartridges.Equipped with a 2-system tape selector capable of mutual dubbing.Equipped with a subsonic filter and -20dB muting switch.Equipped with two output terminals.Built-in relay type muting circuit to prevent noise during power ON/OFF.There was a rack handle as an option sold separately.

sections.title: VICTOR P-L10
sections.overview: This is a high-end preamplifier of the Laboratory Series that uses a development method based on a thorough emphasis on hearing. The signal circuit is constructed with a completely different shipping method from conventional ones, and requires the highest level of sound quality and functions.We reviewed the transistor issues from the starting point, and after repeated audibility tests, completed the Gm processor, our original current amplifier circuit, and incorporated it into a volume amplifier.This processor operates by converting a signal voltage into a current, amplifying it, making it a voltage again, and sending it out. Since the gain changes only depending on the value of the resistance that determines the conversion ratio between current and voltage, the amplifier itself functions as a volume and has little effect on the characteristics and sound quality of the amplifier.In addition, the noise level is reduced in proportion to the volume reduction, so that the SN ratio in actual use is excellent.The equalizer circuit is also equipped with a Gm processor, making it a current type equalizer that is different from the conventional NF and CR types. Because the equalizer curve is simply determined by the constant of the CR element, the RIAA deviation is flat up to 100 kHz.In addition, the high-frequency dynamic range is equivalent to that of the NF type, and the transmission and dynamic characteristics are equivalent to those of the CR type because the current amplifier is flat. Thus, the structure combines the advantages of the NF type and the CR type.The Phono1 is a MM/MC high-gain equalizer with the conversion factor of the Gm processor. The Phono2 has an MC head amplifier at the front.The circuit elements are carefully selected after listening and comparing with special consideration.It is designed with high reliability and sound quality in mind from the parts to the substrate pattern, such as highly reliable nitrogen filled relay, highly stable metal film resistor, silver foil clad contact switch, plane foil (non-etching) large electrolytic capacitor, low-noise zener diode, high-speed diode, etc.Functions such as tone control, recording selector and cartridge switching are installed in the sealing pocket.It is equipped with a direct switch. When it is ON, the tone amplifier, mode switch and subsonic filter are impaired, and the output is directly connected as a volume amplifier.The cabinet has a rose-style natural wood finish with a piano-like mirror finish.A piano usually has about 16 steps to paint, but P-L10 has 21 steps to paint carefully.

sections.title: VICTOR JP-V1000
sections.overview: A 4-channel control amplifier of the Laboratory 1000 series specially developed for professional use such as studios.The Laboratory 1000 Series was designed and manufactured by selected staff members of the Victor Laboratory Center. The characteristics of the Series are compensated by the measured data of all the machines, and the specifications can be changed slightly according to the purpose.In addition to using highly reliable parts for all parts, it is checked up to one resistance and one knob.The JP-V1000 is equipped with many functions, including four SEA controllers. It is equipped with control functions that support both two and four channels. In addition, the entire amplifier stage is equipped with a unique circuit system that was completed through thorough investigation of characteristics and hearing. This ensures high fidelity sound quality and reduces the influence of wiring by minimizing wires.For the internal structure, the plug-in unit is adopted for the circuit board with an emphasis on serviceability for business use. In addition, the frequently used master volume and selector switch can be removed and replaced together with the board.The amplifier circuit of the JP-V1000 has the same basic configuration except for the headphone amplifier, and has many features such as no crossover distortion observed in the SEPP circuit because the output stage is A-class single operation.In particular, the Phono equalizer circuit achieves a bare gain of more than 90 dB by using a high voltage operation of   75 V, and a large dynamic range of up to 400 mV (RMS) and a very low distortion factor by using a negative feedback of 50 dB (1 kHz).The SEA amplifier operates at   35 V, and the linearity has been improved by combining the newly designed permalloy shield High Legh near coil to take advantage of the circuit system.The input selector is mounted on an independent board and can be removed and replaced.In addition, the L and R wafers of Phono are separated and a shield plate is inserted between them to prevent signal jumping and increase of crosstalk.Newly developed flexible wires are used to connect the input terminal board to the circuit board.This flexible wire has a five layer structure based on a polyimide heat-resistant sheet, so that the board can be checked and removed while maintaining a good shielding effect.It uses a 4-strand master trimming volume.This volume combines the advantages of an attenuator and volume. It is a 315 degree wide-angle rotating volume with a 22-point click with extremely low tracking error. The 3 notches turned to the left are an attenuator that switches accurately in 10 dB steps, and more are ultra-precision volumes.With this volume, there is little tracking error at low volume levels, and unlike the attenuator, there is no inconvenience of step-by-step volume changes at normal volume levels. In addition, since this volume is clickable, accurate reproduction of the same volume is provided.In addition, it is mounted on the plug-in board in the same way as other operation parts, so the service manufacture is also improved.Equipped with a sub-level volume that can individually adjust each of the 4 ch levels.A 2.9 kg large toroidal transformer is used for the power supply section, and a constant voltage circuit with   75 v,   35 v and   25 v Route 3 supplies a stable power supply to all circuits.It is equipped with four SEA circuits unique to VICTOR/JVC that divide the audible frequency into seven bands.There are seven center frequencies, and the front and back channels can be adjusted separately with a double volume and an independent ON-OFF switch, and can be further reduced.Equipped with a pink noise generation circuit that can be used for 4-channel phase check and level adjustment.The phase switching of front back and left right is independent, and the phase can be checked between any of the four channels.Equipped with a level meter corresponding to 4 ch.This meter is a narrow-angle operation type that uses only the center part with good linearity of the magnetic circuit. The pointer moves in equilibrium. The meter is structured to indicate the input level as it is regardless of the master volume.It has a headphone port for monitor.There is also a headphone level control for headphones that operates independently of the master volume.A cast-aluminum side frame is used to increase the rigidity of the body and achieve stable rack-mounting.The mount size is BTS standard and can be changed to RCA type by order.The power supply is a universal system of 100 V, 117 V, 220 V and 240 V. It can be used overseas simply by changing internal connections.

sections.title: VICTOR M-7070
sections.overview: Laboratory 7070 series monaural power amplifier that uses D-class power supply.The D-class power supply directly rectifies and smoothes the 100 v commercial power supply, unlike the conventional system that rectifies and smoothes after voltage conversion by a transformer. After obtaining a DC voltage once, it is converted into a 35 kHz square wave pulse by a switching element, the voltage is converted by a high-frequency transformer, and the DC output is taken out again through the rectifying and smoothing circuit.In addition, the voltage is stabilized by the PWM (Pulse Width Modulation) control method in which feedback is applied from the DC output terminal, an error amplifier compares the DC fluctuation with the reference voltage to detect an error signal, and a pulse width modulator controls the conduction time of the switching element.This D-Class power supply realizes power supply efficiency of 80% or more, voltage recovery time as transient response characteristics of about 1 / 15 and internal impedance of 1 / 30 compared to conventional systems.Power MOS FET is adopted as the active element of the output stage. This element succeeded in high withstand voltage and large current of MOS FET used in the high-frequency region such as the front end of FM tuner. It has excellent properties such as wide bandwidth, low distortion rate, good linearity at large current, and no danger of thermal runaway.The M-7070 achieves high power by operating P-channel and N-channel power MOS FETs in parallel push-pull operation.The protective circuit is based on JVC's proprietary three Oshige point protective circuit, with protector ICs added and integrated functions.This IC is equipped with functions such as muting when the power is ON, muting when the power is OFF, midpoint voltage detection, relay drive, etc. In combination with an external circuit, overload detection and temperature detection can be performed.The M-7070 uses a special magnet reed switch that operates at 80 ? as a temperature sensing element. It senses the temperature rise of the printed circuit board and power MOS FET and automatically turns off the signal.There are two types of input jacks, Direct and Subsonic. Direct is a full DC amplifier and Subsonic adds a low-cut filter.The Subsonic side is also equipped with a Canon 3P connector (unbalanced) for business use.Equipped with a 12-point LED peak power indicator using LED without indication inertia.This level meter uses three thick glass panels with one LED embedded in the middle to enhance the projection effect of multiple reflections.There was a rack handle sold separately.

sections.title: VICTOR ME-1000
sections.overview: The Laboratory series monaural power amplifier was developed based on the idea of Isolated Power Train = non-interference energy amplification.In pursuit of the ideal material for the amplifier chassis, and in pursuit of high damping and high rigidity, the 33 kg heavy cast iron chassis is adopted.Using this chassis as a mechanical earth, the four major mechanical parts of the power amplifier, power transformer, power condenser, heat sink and foot are directly attached.In addition, connecting rigidity of heavy parts such as power transformer and heat sink is increased by through bolt.As a result, we succeeded in suppressing the vibration of the part, and it becomes a base of non-interference amplification as a powerful mechanical earth.The conventional variable bias type output stage, Super A, has been reconsidered, and the Advanced Super A has been adopted. It not only achieves high power and high quality, but also eliminates crossover distortion, switching distortion, and nonlinear distortion of the output transistor, and realizes wide bandwidth and stability of output impedance.This enables non-feedback operation of the output circuit.In addition, high power of 1000W/2   can be obtained with high stability by 4 parallel push-pull of bipolar transistor by advanced output circuit design.Equipped with a new Gm circuit with an emphasis on dynamic characteristics.This makes it possible to achieve both superior performance and higher linearity than the conventional major loop feedback type.In addition, the balance input is operated in the current mode for both negative and positive input signals, and a balance input circuit with a high CMRR is realized without adjustment, enabling fast music playback.A real-time thermotracer is used.The temperature of the output stage is detected, and based on this temperature, the temperature of the modularized advanced super A circuit is controlled to realize remote and high-precision temperature compensation.2 box construction Equipped with AC primary isolated power supply.In order to avoid interference with the secondary side, the AC primary side has a box structure made of cast iron that is molded independently and integrally with the front lower part of the cast iron chassis.In addition, the AC100V cable is 3.5m3Power cable made of 6N material is used.Uses ultra-high-speed, large-capacity, and rectifier diodes to handle large instantaneous power with plenty of margin.Strong electric parts are used across the board to minimize energy loss.

sections.title: VICTOR JM-S7
sections.overview: A stereo power amplifier designed to take full advantage of the advantages of a vertical power FET with a powerful power supply.3.6 mm cross-sectional area for the secondary winding in the power supply section2A large toroidal transformer using a flat copper wire is adopted.Coupled with the high-performance Orient Core (Nippon Steel Z-8H), it has obtained excellent regulation superior to the conventional toroidal transformer. The voltage drop at full load continuous 450 VA is less than 3% and the temperature rise is less than 28 ?.The condenser is equipped with 22,000 ? Fx2. The new electrode structure and improved electrolysis station have reduced the output loss. Moreover, the deviation of the capacitance between two pairs is less than 5%. This almost completely eliminates the unevenness of the capacitance caused by the output waveform due to the variation of the capacitance, which has not been a problem so far.In the first stage of the amplifier section, a compound FET with good thermal stability, in which three elements including those for constant current are enclosed in one chip, is adopted. A DC amplifier configuration with no NFB loop and no low-frequency time constant up to the output stage is adopted.The shift of the operating point and mid-point drift due to the fluctuation of the power supply voltage, which tend to occur with DC conversion, are dealt with by using a constant current power supply for the first and second stage differential amplifier sections, and a capacitor is used for the input section to prevent DC shock.The output stage is a pure complimentary service parallel push-pull circuit in which two high-voltage vertical power FETs of P-channel and N-channel are carefully selected and combined.The vertical power FET has excellent characteristics such as 3-pole tube characteristics and excellent switching characteristics at ultra-high frequencies. However, since the input impedance lowers at high frequencies, the JM-S7 uses a complimentary service transistor in the drive stage to allow sufficient current to flow and drive without distortion.An idle current of approximately 400 mA is applied to the power FET for class AB operation, and clear sound quality of class A operation is obtained at low volume, and good sound quality of elongation is obtained at high volume.Since the power FET is a 3-pole tube, the bias current changes according to the fluctuation of the power supply voltage.To cope with this problem, the JM-S7 is equipped with an automatic control circuit to maintain the proper bias.A large aluminum die-cast heat sink is adopted, and temperature rise at maximum output is suppressed to 30 ? or less.When the temperature of the heat sink exceeds 85 ? due to a short-circuit load, it is equipped with a 3 Oshige point protection circuit that disconnects the load and simultaneously controls the current of the output stage. It also protects the speaker from pop noise and fluctuation of the midpoint potential when the power is turned on / off.Equipped with 2 types of speaker selector and headphone port.The side panel is removable.

sections.title: VICTOR M-2020
sections.overview: A 2020 series stereo power amplifier.In order to prevent dynamic interference distortion, a class A and class B independent two power supply system is adopted in which the power supply for the class A amplifier stage and the class B amplifier stage are independent.In this method, the power supply for the class A amplifier stage is provided independently of the transformer itself to provide a constant voltage. This method prevents the voltage fluctuation of the class B amplifier stage from being directly transmitted to the class A amplifier stage and prevents dynamic interference distortion.In addition, the power supply for the class B amplifier stage, in which dynamic interference distortion is hardly a problem in principle, is designed to reduce impedance by shortening the power supply wire, a large transformer, a large-capacity capacitor, and a power supply wire instead of constant voltage. In particular, a pair capacitor with excellent characteristics is adopted with an emphasis on the balance between the positive side and the negative side.In addition, the casing of the transformer is filled with a compound in order to prevent the throbbing of the transformer, which is often a problem in a power supply with excellent fluctuation rate.It is a DC amplifier configuration that does not have a low-frequency time constant in the signal path. The newly developed dual FET is used in the first stage circuit in order to improve stability. The dual FET contains two FETs with the same characteristics in a single package. It has a good thermal balance and minimizes DC drift caused by temperature change.In addition, a constant current circuit is inserted into the power supply, and the next stage transistor and double differential circuit are constructed. Moreover, a stable circuit resistant to heat, noise, and voltage fluctuations is realized by using polypropylene capacitors with good temperature stability at important points.The input circuit is a direct coupling without a condenser, but a subsonic input terminal is also provided so that the ultra-low frequency input including DC can be cut if necessary.Equipped with a power meter and LED peak indicator.The power meter is a logarithmic compression type and can read from 0 to 130W. The peak indicator has five levels from 2W to 130W. It captures the peak level of music and emits light with an attack time of 10 ms.Equipped with 3 high sensitivity filling protection circuits.Equipped with an inrush protector circuit to prevent excessive current when power is turned on.Equipped with 2 types of speaker selector.It has a headphone port.

sections.overview: A stereo power amplifier with reduced dynamic interference distortion.In order to reduce dynamic interference distortion, the AB and LR independent power supply system is adopted, which is further developed from the A-class and B-class independent two power supply system adopted by VICTOR/JVC.Dynamic interference distortion occurs when the current consumption of the class B power amplifier stage (output stage) changes drastically according to the signal level change and interferes with the class A amplifier stage before the output stage where the voltage is amplified. To fundamentally solve this problem, in the class A and class B independent two power supply system, the power supply for the class A stage and the class B stage is separated from the transformer itself, and the power supply for the class A stage is made constant voltage. This prevents the voltage fluctuation of the class B stage from being directly transmitted to the class A stage, thus preventing dynamic interference distortion.The AB / LR power supply system adopted for the M-3030 has been developed to further reduce distortion by using the power supply for the B stage exclusively for the left and right channels.Twin monaural configuration is adopted to reduce static crosstalk such as jumping interference between board patterns and signal wires, potential difference between ground lines, jumping interference due to chassis structure, etc.An ICL (input, capacitor-less) circuit has been adopted in which the coupling and condenser of the input section are eliminated.Equipped with left and right independent level control.It is equipped with two input terminals, Directo and Subsonic.

This is a stereo power amplifier of the Laboratory series that adopts Super A circuit.It is equipped with a super A circuit developed to improve the efficiency of A class amplifier without switching distortion.In the Super A, the bias voltage of the power stage is not fixed and is automatically controlled according to the input signal. This allows power to be utilized according to the magnitude of the signal while the power transistor is always kept ON, achieving efficiency close to that of Class B.In addition, this Super A bias circuit realizes more excellent linearity and lower distortion factor than the conventional A-class power stage. In addition, it is easy to obtain the theoretical output characteristic which is inversely proportional to the load impedance with Super A. Therefore, it is possible to send a high-fidelity signal to the addition of a speaker with many undulations in the impedance characteristic.In the Super A, a unique concept is incorporated not only in the power stage but also in the driver stage, and an excellent distortion factor is realized in the overall.Class A operation is often used in general driver stages because they do not use as much power as the power stage. However, even class A operation cannot cover the nonlinearity of the semiconductor itself. Super A is reconsidering the use of semiconductors. By making the operation locus of the static characteristics of the common-emitter circuit constant, which changed according to the input signal level, a low distortion factor of less than 1/10 compared to the conventional driver stage is realized.The power supply section uses a special structure transformer with a capacity of 500 VA and a weight of 15 kg, an electrolytic capacitor that maintains low impedance and low distortion rate up to ultra-high frequencies, and also takes into consideration dynamic interference distortion between the power stage and driver stage.Aluminum is used for the chassis base to suppress distortion caused by non-magnetic materials such as iron, and magnetic materials are eliminated from signal circuit parts to eliminate magnetic distortion.Equipped with a relay-type speaker selector that maintains the same low impedance as the Direct Out.Equipped with a color tone switchable illuminate scale large power meter.This meter can confirm the operation of the protection circuit.High reliability glass epoxy board is adopted.The input terminal is equipped with two systems, direct (DC) and subsonic (AC).Equipped with level control.

sections.title: VICTOR M-L10
sections.overview: This is a stereo power amplifier of the Laboratory Series that was developed through repeated trial listening with an emphasis on listening feeling in pursuit of ideal operation when mounting speakers.Power Cascode Super A circuit (PAT. PEND.) is adopted for the circuit system.This circuit utilizes the characteristics of a transistor, which is originally a current amplifier, to solve the difference in operation between a pure resistance load and a speaker load. The output transistor always operates at a constant voltage, and only the current changes according to the signal. Therefore, the phase difference between the voltage and current when a speaker is loaded does not become a problem, and the same operation and performance as a pure resistance load are ensured.In addition, the output transistor generates extremely low heat, and the instantaneous heat generated when the speaker is mounted is less than 1/10 of the conventional circuit. As a result, there is little variation in the output transistor characteristics due to heat, dynamic distortion such as diurnal thermal distortion is reduced, and idling current is stabilized.In order to realize a power, cascode and super A circuit, a newly developed output transistor is used.As with the P-L10 model, we have carefully examined the sound quality of the power transformer core and carefully selected high-quality elements for both reliability and audibility.Also, careful consideration is given to the substrate pattern.The cabinet has the same rose-style real wood mirror coating finish as the P-L10 type.

sections.title: VICTOR AX-AV5
sections.overview: An AV amplifier with 5 dd surround system.In order to further improve the conventional 4-channel surround system, we added a center channel to create a 5-channel 5 dd (dimensional digital) surround system.The center channel outputs a monaural signal that is a mix of the left and right signals, so even if the left and right speakers are separated in order to expand the sound field, there are no gaps.In addition, the center channel, which normally has full range characteristics, can be switched to the sub-woofer characteristics with the switch on the remote control.A dedicated power amplifier is mounted on each channel that constitutes 5 dd.It can also be used as a high-output 3-channel system with BTL connection using a rear power amplifier and a front power amplifier.Three types of mode switching and level adjustment are available : Dolby Surround, which allows you to enjoy movies with powerful sound, Space Surround with stereo effect on the rear channel, and Simulated Surround which makes monaural sound into pseudo surround.The delay circuit that controls sound over time to create a more live sound field employs a digital delay that controls music signals through digital processing.This reduces noise and distortion that cannot be avoided by analog delay.It is equipped with an AV adapter terminal to which a color collector or graphic equalizer can be connected, and a pre-out terminal to take out the signal of each channel.The dubbing function is enhanced so that one video source can be dubbed to two video decks simultaneously, or two video sources can be combined into one.It is also possible to dub video and audio from different sources.It has a video enhancer that can correct the contour of the image.Comes with a multi-functional remote controller with volume control capability.The volume uses a motor drive type for the master volume, giving consideration to sound quality.

sections.title: VICTOR AX-F10
sections.overview: A digital AV amplifier equipped with DEUS, a unique technology of JVC.The amplifier section is equipped with DEUS which is Victor's original D-class amplifier.DEUS uses Victor's unique hybrid feedback technology, which combines digital feedback and analog feedback.The digital feedback constantly monitors the PWM modulation and the analog feedback eliminates the effects of noise and distortion introduced during the digital amplification process and the back-emf of the connected speakers.In addition, a newly developed power module with greatly improved switching capability is installed in the output stage, and the multi-pole compensation technology has been introduced to further improve sound quality. As a result, it achieves high sound quality while consuming less than half the power consumption of a same class analog amplifier and achieving a compact size.With Smart Surround Setup Ver2.0, you can easily set up your multi-channel speakers.With this function, you just need to clap your hands at the listening point and you can adjust 6 speakers.It is equipped with Dolby Digital EX and DTS-ES compatible with 6.1 ch DVD, DTS 96/24 capable of 96kHz/24bit multi-channel playback, and MPEG-2 AAC decoder used for BS / terrestrial digital broadcasting.DTS NEO : 6 expands 2 ch signal to 6.1 ch and Dolby Pro Logic II expands to 5.1 ch.Equipped with a D4 input Route 3 for high-definition and progressive high-definition video signals.Comes with a luminous multi-brand remote controller.

sections.title: VICTOR AX-V505
sections.overview: This is an AV amplifier for Dolby Pro Logic that has inherited the design of high-end machines.The AX-V505 supports Dolby Pro Logic Surround.It is equipped with 4 types of pro-logic mode, and in addition, it is equipped with 3 types of surround sound which can be enjoyed with sources other than Dolby surround sound and 3 types of delay time.Dolby Pro Logic mode allows you to choose between normal, wide, phantom and 3-channel logic. Normal mode is selected when a small-size speaker is used for the center channel. Frequencies below 100 Hz are distributed to the front L/R and output. Wide mode is used when the same speaker is used for the center channel. Phantom mode does not have a speaker for the center channel. The center channel signal is distributed to the front L/R and output. 3-channel logic mode mixes the rear surround signal to the front L/R.You can choose between Surround mode : Hall, Live, or Synthetic. Synthetic creates stereo-like spaciousness on a mono source.The delay time can be selected from 15 msec, 20 msec and 30 msec.The power amplifier section contains a 5-channel discrete power amplifier.All channels are designed with emphasis on sound quality using carefully selected power transistors. In addition, construction to protect the power amplifier section from noise, adoption of vibration control base for power transformer, oxygen-free copper AC cord, and carefully selected power capacitor are used to ensure high sound quality.Equipped with the CD direct function, the number of contacts can be reduced by shortening the signal path of the CD source, and you can enjoy a simple signal line.A total of 16 input terminals are provided.A video input terminal for the Route 6 and an S-video input terminal for the Route 3, one system for video movies is installed on the front panel, and an input terminal for the Route 6 is installed for audio equipment.The front panel is equipped with independent REC selectors for Tape1 and VTR1.The Tape1 can record audio and the VTR1 can record visual audio and video independently of each other. While listening to a CD, you can edit from tape to tape and record from behind or behind, such as dubbing a video. It also has a REC monitor that allows you to check the situation.You can also use the Sound Selector to add audio sources to visual sources.Y/C separation circuit is mounted on the S image terminal, and composite connected images can be dubbed with the S image terminal.Equipped with on-screen function, operation status can be displayed in text on TV screen.Equipped with a video enhancer, the contour of the image can be corrected continuously from soft to sharp.A full remote control is included.With this remote control, the remote control signals of VICTOR/JVC CD, deck, TV and VTR are already input, and it can be operated together.

sections.title: VICTOR AX-V707
sections.overview: AV amplifier equipped with Dolby Pro Logic and 5-channel power amplifier.It is compatible with Dolby Pro Logic Surround, and by surround playback using 5 speakers of front 2 ch, center ch and rear 2 ch with built-in directional enhancement circuit, you can enjoy video software recorded with Dolby Pro Logic in the stereoscopic sound field of movie theaters or theaters.The AX-V707 supports four pro-logic modes : three center modes and three channel logic.It is equipped with 3 modes of surround sound and 3 types of delay time in which you can enjoy the sound field effect with realistic feeling even with sources other than Dolby surround sound.The D/A converter is equipped with a newly developed DD (Digital Direct) converter.The DD converter is a type of 1-bit D/A converter that converts digital signals into 1-bit pulse waves that vary based on the crystal clock, and directly converts them into analog signals. Because the bits are not stacked, the 0 cross distortion caused by amplitude error that occurs in conventional ladder-type D/A converters does not occur in principle, greatly improving the ability to reproduce at a minute level.The DD converter consists of three parts : 8 x oversampling digital filter + VANS 4th-noise shaper + PEM DAC. The newly developed VANS noise shaper compresses the data output from the digital filter into data suitable for the 1-bit PEM DAC. The requantization noise generated at this time is eliminated by 4th-noise shaping for the first time in the 1-bit DAC. Thus, the dynamic range is expanded. The PEM DAC converts the input data into high-precision, high-resolution pulse waves that vary with the crystal clock and directly converts them into analog signals.The digital input has a total of four systems, one optical system and a coaxial Route 3 system.The power amplifier section is equipped with a 5-channel power amplifier of complete discrete configuration.In addition, the front two channels are equipped with Dynamic Super A so that the sound quality is emphasized.The power amplifier section is surrounded by a heat sink in the internal construction to shield the delicate input signal processing section from noise, and the power transformer is mounted via a vibration control base to eliminate vibration.The AC cord is made of oxygen-free copper wire and the power condenser is made of carefully selected materials in pursuit of higher sound quality.The CD analog input minimizes the signal path and reduces the number of contacts, thus reducing sound quality degradation.All of the Route 6 video inputs are equipped with S-video terminals, one of which is installed on the front panel for easy connection of video equipment, and the audio input is equipped with Route 6.Equipped with an AV independent REC selector.It is equipped with a multi-mode display which displays the operation status of the amplifier in text such as source and surround mode selection, level adjustment, etc.It is also equipped with an on-screen function that displays the operation status on the TV screen so that you can see at a glance what you are listening to, what you are recording or recording, and in what surround mode you are enjoying. The usage status of the speaker is displayed graphically, and the levels of the center channel and rear channel are displayed on a 7-level graph.Equipped with a test tone function, you can adjust the speaker volume balance.A built-in Y/C separation circuit makes editing from composite input to S-image input convenient.It is also equipped with an enhancer that can correct image contours.There are 2 color variations, gun metallic and black.A programmable remote controller is included as a remote controller to control other AV devices.This remote control is equipped with a learning function, and can store up to 174 types of remote control signals for up to 18 models, including VTRs, TVs, video disks, BS tuners, CDs, DAT, and decks.

sections.title: VICTOR AX-V909
sections.overview: An AV amplifier equipped with digital signal processing Dolby Prologic, digital acoustic processor and 6-channel power amplifier.The AX-V909 uses digital signal processing of Dolby Pro Logic surround information and advanced digital signal processing to improve the dynamic range of the control signal by more than 20 dB. This greatly improves the sense of accurate sound movement, the sense of localization in small signals, and channel separation.Four types of pro-logic mode are installed.Equipped with a digital auto azimuth collector and auto balancer.The directional enhancement circuit of Dolby Pro-Logic Surround loses the realistic sense of movement and orientation if there is a phase difference or level difference in the input signal. To solve this problem, the Digital Auto Azimuth Collector & Auto Balancer uses digital signal processing to optimally and automatically adjust the phase difference and level difference generated during software production or signal output from a playback device in real time to extract the sound of Dolby Pro-Logic Surround.DAP (Digital Acoustic Processor) is installed as a surround function to reproduce the realistic sensation in the actual performance venue.To realize this function, JVC uses a unique symmetrical 6-point sound field analysis method using six microphones to actually measure the sound of famous concert halls around the world. We analyze the spatial characteristics of a 360-degree sound field by recording the sound spread in the hall with high precision. We also focus on the unique sound field characteristics of music software and listening rooms. With the cooperation of the software production side, we also analyze the sound field of recording studios and listening rooms. Together with the data obtained at the concert hall, we conduct comprehensive computer analysis together with data obtained at the concert hall. For the first time, we introduced a fully independent L/R signal processing system using stereo for the signal processing of these data, and we completed data without losing sound field components that were lost in conventional monaural (L + R) signal processing.The AX-V909 has eight preset sound field patterns. In addition, you can adjust various parameters according to the reverberation time and space of the listening room. In addition, you can enjoy the original sound field according to your preference by installing two playback modes of 6 ch and 4 ch.(Features are described in the specifications column)The D/A converter is equipped with a K2 interface circuit and a DD (Digital Direct) converter.The DD converter is a type of 1-bit D/A converter that converts digital signals into 1-bit pulse waves that vary based on the crystal clock, and directly converts them into analog signals. Because the bits are not stacked, the 0 cross distortion caused by amplitude error that occurs in conventional ladder-type D/A converters does not occur in principle, greatly improving the ability to reproduce at a minute level.The DD converter consists of three parts : 8 x oversampling digital filter + VANS 4th-noise shaper + PEM DAC. The newly developed VANS noise shaper compresses the data output from the digital filter into data suitable for the 1-bit PEM DAC. The requantization noise generated at this time is eliminated by 4th-noise shaping for the first time in the 1-bit DAC. Thus, the dynamic range is expanded. The PEM DAC converts the input data into high-precision, high-resolution pulse waves that vary with the crystal clock and directly converts them into analog signals.With digital input, both Dolby Pro Logic Surround and DAP can be used for digital direct pure playback without D/A conversion on the player side or A/D conversion on the AX-V909.The A/D converter is equipped with a 64 fs fourth order noise shaping 1-bit dual A/D converter.Equipped with a digital delay, it can be changed from 15 to 30 msec in 1 msec steps.The power amplifier section is equipped with a fully discrete 6-channel power amplifier.In addition, the front channel 2 and center channel 2 are equipped with Dynamic Super A and are designed with an emphasis on sound quality.The power amplifier section is surrounded by a heat sink in the internal construction to shield the delicate input signal processing section from noise, and the power transformer is mounted via a vibration control base to eliminate vibration.The AC cord is made of oxygen-free copper wire and the power condenser is made of carefully selected materials in pursuit of higher sound quality.The speaker output has eight channels for Dolby Pro Logic Dual Center / DAP.Equipped with four digital inputs including two optical inputs and Route 6 audio inputs. Equipped with Route 6 video inputs, all of which are equipped with S jacks.The digital (coaxial), video and audio connectors are gold-plated.It has a Route 6 pre-out connector that can be used as a Dolby Pro Logic Surround / DAP processor and a main in connector that can be used as an independent 6-channel power amplifier.Equipped with an AV independent REC selector that can select sound and video sources separately.Equipped with Y/C separation circuit which is convenient for editing from conventional VTR to S-VTR.It is also equipped with an enhancer that can correct image contours.It is equipped with an on-screen function that can display the operation status in text on the TV screen.The on-screen display shows you how your speakers are being used, and shows the center and rear channel levels in decibels.Equipped with a test tone function, you can adjust the speaker volume balance.There are 2 color variations, gun metallic and black.A programmable remote controller is included as a remote controller to control other AV devices.This remote control is equipped with a learning function, and can store up to 174 types of remote control signals for up to 18 models, including VTRs, TVs, video disks, BS tuners, CDs, DAT, and decks.

is used for BS / terrestrial digital broadcasting.It is equipped with a multi-channel DAP (Digital Acoustic Processor) jointly developed by Tokyu Construction Co., Ltd., which was engaged in the sections.title: VICTOR AX-V7000
sections.overview: This is an AV amplifier with THX ULTRA certified quality and a 7 ch power amplifier compatible with THX SURROUND EX.With a fully discrete 7-channel power amplifier, it delivers 150Wx2 for 2-channel playback and 150W for each 7-channel multi-channel.An independent direct power supply is used in the power supply section to support these devices. The power supply section is divided into three blocks : the Lch section, the Rch section, and the center ch section to reduce crosstalk between channels through the rectifying circuit.In addition to decoding Dolby Digital, DTS and MPEG2-AAC, and adjusting sound quality with parametric equalizers, as well as sound field processing for THX Surround EX and multi-channel DAP, it is equipped with two DSPs 56367 which are 24 bitDSP (Digital Signal Processor) made by Motorola with 150 MIPS calculation processing power.This enables digital processing with 96 kHz sampling.In addition, a 96 kHz / 24-bit A/D converter is installed in consideration of sound quality when various DSP processes are performed on analog input signals.It is equipped with THX Surround EX decoder which added 7.1 ch by adding 2 ch (surround back) to 5.1 ch.You can enjoy not only surround EX-compatible sources but also ordinary 5.1 ch sources by expanding to 7.1 ch.It is equipped with DAP (Digital Acoustic Processor) that reproduces various hall sound fields by digital processing based on measured data.A computer-based sound field simulation technology developed jointly by Tokyu Kensetsu Co., Ltd. and Victor Company of Japan, Ltd., which designed and constructed buildings such as the Bunkamura Shibuya Orchard Hall and the Yokohama Sunheart Hall, and the Sound Research Institute of Victor Company of Japan, Ltd., has been introduced to enhance the perfection of the sound field. This technology enables the extraction of various sound field patterns, which was difficult to obtain by measuring reflected sound by conventional impulse response. Moreover, this technology has been verified by human audition, making it possible to obtain natural sound fields.As a result, in addition to 2-channel surround movies, audio from monaural film movies, music sources recorded with linear PCM, and 5.1 channel sources for Dolby Digital, DTS, and MPEG2-AAC recording are all expanded to 7.1 channel sound field data.New K2 technology with compression mode (real algorithm) to improve sound quality variation due to compressed digital signal, and CC converter equipped with this is installed in all 7.1 channels.All 7.1 channels are equipped with a PEM-DD converter with low harmonic noise and good sound quality.Equipped with a precision downmix converter.This is an analog downmix technology for DVD-Multi and EXT7.1 ch analog multi-channel inputs. It is possible to set up speakers according to the room or base material without losing sound quality even with DVD-Audio software such as 96kHz/24bit/5ch or multi-channel sources for which speaker management is not allowed.Uses a highly rigid cross-frame Z (0) chassis to reduce adverse effects such as unwanted vibration and interference.In addition, in order to realize a layout that does not interfere with each other inside, each circuit is divided into nine blocks for each function, and through thorough subdivision, intrusion of digital noise is eliminated to ensure the purity of audio circuits.In the power supply section, analog and digital transformers are separated, and in order to satisfy the strict quality standard of THX ULTRA, the rectifier circuit and the subsequent circuit are made into independent 7 ch construction. Power is supplied independently and each circuit can be placed close to each other.This reduces transmission loss as much as possible.It is equipped with a multi-brand remote control that can operate all AV equipment of major manufacturers and has a learning function that can improve usability by storing frequently used functions.

sections.title: VICTOR AX-V8000
sections.overview: This is an AV amplifier certified by THX Ultra2, combining JVC's amplifier technology.THX Ultra2, a standard for home theaters, is certified.The Home THX is designed to be able to faithfully reproduce the sound environment of THX in the home, which is the proof of the qualities required by THX for first class movie theaters, and the THX Ultra2 is a new standard that is compatible with the latest surround format and requires further quality improvement.The AX-V8000 combines JVC's amplifier technology and is certified as a strict standard without being unnecessarily large.The power amplifier section is equipped with a seven channel discrete power amplifier.The discrete configuration and independent power supply improve the quality of the power supply to realize high power with low distortion factor.In the case of 5.1 channel playback, it is equipped with a speaker management function that allows bi-amplifier connection, so that the main speaker can be driven with higher quality.An independent power supply is used for the power supply section.In this system, the analog audio, digital and video transformers are independent, and the power supply section, which consists of a high-current rectifying circuit and a high-capacity capacitor, is divided into three blocks : the Lch section, the Rch section, and the center ch section. This reduces crosstalk between channels through the rectifying circuit.The chassis structure is reinforced with a highly rigid cross-frame Z (0) chassis and stay brackets to prevent unwanted vibration and interference.In addition, along with the adoption of a copper-tight chassis and a four layer board, each circuit is divided into nine blocks for each function, improving S/N, reducing digital noise, and completely eliminating interference within the chassis.A ZIST (7.1 interference audio signal transmission) circuit is mounted on the EXT0 ch input.This circuit keeps the cold side of the audio signal independent of ground, preventing the video signal from mixing into the audio signal and reducing sound quality.Equipped with a precision downmix converter that enables analog speaker management without loss of sound quality.High-quality multi-channel sources can record ultra-high sound quality on the center channel as well as on the main channel. However, if you want to play music on a system with a center speaker that is clearly inferior to the main speaker, you may want to disable the center speaker. This can be done by changing the speaker settings, but with the DVD player speaker settings, you must reduce the level before adding to avoid overflow when adding in the digital domain, which can adversely affect sound quality.The Precision Downmix Converter is an analog downmix technology for DVD-Multi and EXT7.1 channel analog multi-channel inputs. It can be adjusted to suit the room and equipment without loss of sound quality even with DVD-Audio software such as 96kHz/24bit/5ch or sources for which speaker management is not allowed.The circuit that performs digital processing such as surround system decoding and sound field processing is equipped with TI's 32/64bitDSP "Aureus" with 1800 MIPS for fixed-point operation and 1350 MFLOPS for floating-point operation.It supports decoding of Dolby Digital EX, Dolby Pro Logic II, DTS-ES discrete / matrix, DTS NEO : 6, DTS 96/24, etc.It also supports MPEG-2 AAC, etc.It is equipped with a high-definition multi-channel DAP (Digital Acoustic Processor) for 7.1 channels, which introduced sound field simulation technology for actual music halls.This system was jointly developed by Tokyu Construction Co., Ltd. and Victor Acoustics Research Laboratories, which were engaged in the acoustic design and construction of the Tokyu Bunkamura Shibuya Orchard Hall and other buildings. The introduction of computer-based sound field simulation technology has made it possible to extract sound field patterns, which were difficult to detect by measuring reflected sound with conventional impulse responses. Furthermore, this system has been verified by human ears, making it possible to reproduce real hall sound fields.With this function, it is possible to extend surround of various formats to all 7.1 channel sound field data.Equipped with a CC converter to improve the sound quality of digital signals.The CC converter in the AX-V8000 is based on K2 technology with a compression mode (real algorithm) to improve the compressed digital signal in addition to the ExtendedK2 processing in the high-end CD-player.This CC converter is mounted on the 7.1 ch, and the reproducibility is further enhanced by high bit and high sampling.The D/A converter uses a 192 kHz / 24-bit PEM-DD converter developed by Victor for DVD audio.All 7.1 channels of the AX-V8000 are equipped with this noise-shaping type D/A converter chip originally developed by VICTOR/JVC.Equipped with an A/D converter for analog multi-channel input.Compatible with 5.1 channel analog sources such as DVDs, the front 2 channel can be converted to 192kHz/24bit, while other channels can be converted to 96kHz/24bit. This allows high-precision digital conversion of analog multi-channel input, enabling all digital processing.Equipped with a video converter, it is possible to convert between composite video signal and S video signal (Y/C separation and mixing).Since the composite image input and S image input can be converted into component signals and output, there is no need to switch the input on the display side.Although it is a large amplifier, it is designed to be quiet by not using a cooling fan at all.Equipped with an on-screen display function, you can superimpose on the video screen.Equipped with an audio delay function, it can compensate for subtle differences between video and audio.Route 3 equipped with D5 image input of the highest standard D-terminal and D5-compatible component image input.It is equipped with a phono equalizer that supports both MM and MC.The speaker terminal uses a brass machined gold plated terminal.Equipped with 3D headphone mode, you can enjoy stereoscopic sound even with headphones.RM-A2500X, an AV system controller with a large touch panel LCD equipped with macro and learning functions, is included as a wireless remote control.The included RM-A2500X is specifically designed for the AX-V8000.

sections.overview: A digital AV amplifier equipped with DEUS, a unique technology of JVC.The amplifier circuit is equipped with DEUS which is a digital amplifier of VICTOR/JVC.This system uses hybrid feedback technology to monitor digital modulation accurately and to eliminate noise generated in the digital amplification process as well as the influence of connected speakers to improve sound quality.The digital amplifier DEUS uses a high-precision floating triamble PWM (digital) modulation circuit. This circuit realizes digital conversion without noise in the audio band by introducing digital feedback. The generated digital signal is amplified by a high-speed switching element and passed through an LPF to remove the high-frequency signal and return it to the music signal. This adds switching noise and magnetostriction of the ferrite core used for the LPF. It is also affected by the back electromotive force of the connected speaker system.In order to solve these problems, the DEUS employs analog feedback. Compared with the input signal, the DEUS and influence from the speaker are greatly reduced, and the sound quality is improved compared with the conventional digital amplifier.Built-in Smart Surround Setup makes it easy to set up your annoying speakers.With this function, the speaker is regarded as a microphone, and the sound of hand tapping is detected as electromotive force, and the level and distance are calculated and the setting is completed automatically.In addition to the MPEG-2 AAC decoder compatible with Dolby Digital, DTS and BS digital broadcasting audio formats, various decoders such as Dolby Pro Logic II, which can be reproduced by expanding 2 ch source to 5.1 ch, are installed.It also has an audio input terminal that supports analog 5.1 channels such as DVD audio.It is equipped with D4 input / output jacks for high-definition video signals such as HDTV and progressive.Comes with a luminous multi-brand remote control.

sections.title: VICTOR MX-1
sections.overview:
This system component was developed as a compact system that can fit into any interior and be laid out freely.The MX-1 consists of CD player / amplifier, deck / tuner deck / tuner unit, and a speaker unit. The center unit of the MX-1 is in the form of a 2 box, enabling installation in a more flexible layout than conventional components.

CD player / amplifier, deck / tunerWe have adopted a 3-amp power engine to realize the conflicting requirements of compactness and high power.Power engines incorporate the methodology of the engine cooling system of high-performance vehicles and employ a forced cooling system using a newly developed blower to cope with the heat problem that occurs at high power.The blower is designed to reduce noise by driving the diaphragm at extremely low frequency, and the effect on sound is eliminated.Equipped with a 7-element electronic graphic equalizer, you can make your favorite sound.The programmed memory has six built-in patterns : Rock, Jazz, Pops, Classic, Headphone, and Car. You can also manually memorize one original pattern. You can adjust each element and call up each pattern using the included remote control.Equipped with a rich editing function, it can be used for editing original tapes, etc.With auto-edit, you can program songs that fit within the tape time by distributing them to the A/B side of the tape in the order of recorded songs with one touch. With program-edit, you can program songs that fit within the tape time to the A/B side of the tape by rearranging them in your favorite order of songs. You can set the tape time (C-46/54/60/74/90) by simply pressing each edit key. With the CD10 key, you can also set the time in minutes.With Fade Edit, even if you end in the middle of the last piece of Side A, you fade out immediately before it ends, and rerecord the piece from the head of Side B of the tape, so that you can make a tape without a blank at the tape end.Equipped with two AV (video / audio) input terminals and monitor (video) output terminals.Equipped with 5-way multi-program timer with 5-step wake-up volume.The wake-up volume can be set in 4 steps + 5 steps in total when the timer is ON. In addition, the program timer which can specify the source is installed in the Route 3 (timer 1, timer 2, daily). In addition, the sleep & wake-up timer which is convenient for night and wake-up playback is also installed.

Speaker partThe speaker system of the MX-1 consists of a main section consisting of a full-range unit and a Kelton sub-woofer section with a built-in woofer unit.Two 7.5 cm cone type full-range units are mounted on the main part.The subwoofer uses a Kelton system with a labyrinth aeroport.In this system, a 12.5 cm cone woofer is mounted inside, and a port of sufficient length is provided in a compact size by a labyrinth structure, which enhances resonance and compression effects and enables more powerful low-frequency playback.

OtherWireless remote control is included.For vertical layout, lay out the amplifier part on top.

sections.title: VICTOR XL-V1-N
sections.overview: HMV series CD player.The digital circuit uses newly developed 20-bit K2 processing.This circuit expands the CD-16-bit signal by assuming that it is an analog signal of the original sound. It a unique music energy equivalent exchange method to reproduce it with 20-bit accuracy, thereby acquiring sound that could not be expressed by conventional CD-players.A 20-bit DD converter is used for the D/A converter.In this method, since 1-bit operation is expressed by a pulse wave with crystal precision, 0 cross distortion is eliminated in principle, and high-precision D/A conversion is realized by a fourth order noise shaper.In addition, the input mode has been expanded to 20 bit to expand the capability as a DD converter.The servo circuit is equipped with a newly developed digital servo system.In this circuit, servo characteristics are optimized by automatic adjustment for each disk, servo error is greatly reduced and stable playability is realized.To minimize the signal length, the servo circuit is integrated into a small module board.A symmetrical layout is adopted for the circuit structure, and by making the pattern and part arrangement symmetrical, the left and right deviation of sound quality is eliminated.An electromagnetic relay is used for the muting circuit of the output stage, and a photocoupler is used to eliminate adverse effects on the audio signal.Equipped with two digital output terminals that are coaxial with the optical system.These terminals are set to the terminal farthest from the analog output terminal, and a digital output ON / OFF switch is provided to ensure complete digital / analog separation design.A 3-pointed base has been adopted for the legs, making it possible to install stably without being affected by the flatness of the place.The display section has been revised based on the waveform of noise, and the display space and functions that generate noise are minimized in order to reduce noise from the root.In addition, in order to prevent noise from mixing in from the front display board, the whole board is covered with a metal plate to shut out noise.It is equipped with a display OFF function to eliminate display noise and the dimmer switch to reduce display light.Wireless remote control is included.

sections.overview: This CD player was developed based on non-resonance and non-vibration technology and know-how from commercial digital recording systems.The D/A converter uses a 16-bit D/A converter, and the digital filter uses a double oversampling digital filter.By shifting up the sampling frequency by two times with the digital filter, unwanted signals are suppressed to a low level before D/A conversion, a simple analog filter can be used to improve sound quality, and reliability is enhanced by integrating the digital filter into the digital signal processing LSI.The IS mechanism is adopted for the mechanism part.In the IS mechanism, the chassis is reinforced with a strong mechanical base, and the rotating system and pickup section are floated from the main body with a large insulator. Together with the increased electric servo stabilizer effect, stable sound quality is obtained.New Y servo system is used for the servo circuit.The New Y Servo consists of two types of servo circuits. First of all, a high traceability servo circuit with frequency characteristics, phase characteristics, and gain that make full use of the high sensitivity pickup is used to ensure the best operating conditions at all times. Second, a high balance servo circuit is used to prevent trace errors caused by disc scratches and dirt. This circuit uses the time difference between the leading and trailing beams of the three spot beams. The flaw waveform detected by the leading beam is delayed, and the waveform is superimposed on the trailing beam and cancelled.The disk tray uses a disk center hold system, and only the center of the disk is supported by a spring mechanism to prevent damage to the disk by touching the signal recording surface.The power supply circuit controls beat disturbance and interference distortion by separating analog system and digital / servo system independently.The analog stage is composed of many discrete parts with good sound, and the printed circuit board is composed of a symmetrical isometric pattern of left and right channels to reduce crosstalk, noise and phase distortion.It uses high-quality parts such as electrolytic capacitors for audio, fast recovery diodes, low-noise low-distortion OP amplifiers, and copper screws.A large FL multi-display is used for the display.Uses a large insulator.Equipped with a headphone port with volume.It comes with a wireless remote control that allows you to turn the power ON/OFF and operate the buttons except for the disk tray OPEN/CLOSE.

sections.title: VICTOR XL-V500
sections.overview: A CD player that integrates Victor's original technology.The mechanism part uses an independent suspension mechanism pursuing non-resonance and non-vibration.In this mechanism, the rotating system is fixed to a sturdy mechanical base mixed with glass. Together with the pickup section, it is floated from the chassis by a special shape of insulation rubber. By this, disturbance vibrations and sound pressure of speakers are shielded, and traceability is improved.The disk clamper uses a magnet catch method.When the arm of the disk clamper directly touches the disk, the sound quality deteriorates due to vibration transmitted from the outside and resonance of the arm. To prevent this, the magnetic catch method disk clamper adopts a structure in which the clamper is completely floated from the arm during performance. The disk is pressed against the turntable by magnetic force.The Y servo system is used for the servo circuit.The Y servo minimizes the operation of the error correction function and increases the traceability of the pickup body. When an error occurs, the servo loop characteristics are automatically adjusted so that the pickup can accurately capture the signal pit.Equipped with 2 x oversampling digital filter.The sampling frequency is doubled to 88.2 kHz, and unwanted signals located just above the audible band are removed by a digital filter and then attenuated by a slow analog filter with good phase characteristics.The analog circuit uses an isotropic substrate pattern with symmetrical left and right channels to minimize crosstalk up to the high frequency range.In addition, the filter is composed of fine discrete parts to reduce the deterioration of sound quality.The power supply section employs a double power transformer system, and the analog power supply is independent of the transformer itself, which fundamentally cuts off digital noise and beat interference.Along with vibration isolation measures everywhere, distortion and noise are reduced by adopting thick earth lines and non-magnetic parts.Equipped with timer play function and auto pause function.It comes with a wireless remote control that can perform most operations such as 15-track program with 10 keys and direct selection of music.

sections.title: VICTOR XL-V501
sections.overview: A CD player using Optica link and optical transmission system.The Optica Link optical transmission system is used. The digital part of the pickup, servo system and signal processing system is completely electrically separated from the audio part of the digital filter, D/A converter and low-pass filter, and the signal is transmitted only by the photocoupler.The photocoupler consists of a light-emitting element and a light-receiving element, which are insulated with a special film and sealed with epoxy. It also shows excellent characteristics in terms of leakage current and high-voltage insulation, so it blocks the noise of digital circuits that used to flow into analog circuits through power lines and ground lines.High-precision 3-beam pickup is used for the pickup part.In this pickup, the response speed is improved by shortening the distance between the main beam which reads the signal from the disk and the two servo beams. In addition, the XL-V501 pickup is lighter in weight to realize further improvement of the response. This reduces the excess servo current and reduces noise generation in the servo system.In order to eliminate unnecessary vibration and resonance that degrade sound quality, Victor's original IS mechanism is adopted.In this structure, the disk drive system and the pickup system, which are susceptible to adverse effects, are set on the damping material base with large internal loss, and are floating mounted with insulation rubber to block sound pressure and external vibration from the speakers.The digital circuit employs a digital filter that doubles the sampling frequency to reduce the effect on the audio band, while the XL-V501 employs a newly developed high-order digital filter that has excellent cutoff characteristics for unwanted bands, improving attenuation by approximately 30 dB at 24.1 kHz, near the audible band.In order to prevent the center of gravity of the chassis from being shifted to the disk drive system and the pickup system, a lattice-like radial base with a vibration control structure is installed on the audio board side. This protects the analog circuit from vibration and realizes low center of gravity and center weight balance.It is equipped with an editing function and can be programmed automatically by setting the time of the tape when recording on the tape.There are two types of output terminals, fixed and variable. Gold-plated.It uses a motor drive type volume and can be operated from a remote control.It is equipped with functions such as program and random play of up to 32 songs and 5 kinds of repeat.In addition, it is equipped with an intro-scan function that plays the head of a song approximately 15 seconds at a time.Equipped with a synchro terminal, editing and recording is possible in conjunction with JVC's synchro-compatible cassette decks.Equipped with a large FL display.It is also compatible with Emphasis Disc, and appears on the FL display during playback.Built-in timer standby mechanism allows playback to start at desired time by combining with an optional timer.Multi-functional remote control is included.
