sections.title: VICTOR XL-V1100
sections.overview: A reference CD player of the Digifine series aiming at the ultimate in digital audio.The internal structure adopts a D/A2 box design in which the digital part and analog audio part are completely independent.In order to separate the audio section from the digital servo system and power supply section, it is housed in a shield box using a thick non-magnetic chassis.In addition, all chassis other than the audio section are made of a non-magnetic structure consisting of extruded aluminum and copper-plated steel plates to eliminate magnetic distortion. In addition, by placing damping materials at important points, harmful resonance is suppressed.The newly developed High Precision 3-beam pickup is used in the pickup section.In this pickup, the distance between the main beam and the servo beam has been shortened from the conventional 22 ? m to 16 ? m. This accelerates the response to scratches and dirt on the disk, increases the amount of information from the servo beam, and improves the stability of tracing.This enhances the effect of the Y servo, which superimposes and cancels out the abnormal waveform of the preceding and succeeding beams.A V servo has been newly added to the servo circuit.In the V servo system, a highly sensitive vibration detection element V sensor senses external vibration and sound pressure from speakers, and controls servo gain quickly.It adopts IS (Independent Suspension) mechanism which is a large insulation support structure.The IS mechanism has a structure in which a disk drive and an optical pickup are floating mounted with a large insulator on a mechanical base made of damping material, and shuts off disturbance vibration and sound pressure.In addition, rotational accuracy is improved by a chucking center clamp mechanism that reduces disc eccentricity and surface runout and by a thick shaft motor.The digital filter uses a 4-fold oversampling digital filter to increase the sampling frequency from 44.1 kHz to 176.4 kHz before D/A conversion to reduce interference in the audio band.As a result, the structure of the analog filter at the latter stage can be simplified, and sound quality with less phase shift and distortion can be obtained.The D/A converter uses an independent D/A converter for the left and right channels, and the output signal of the D/A converter uses a current transmission method instead of a conventional voltage transmission method to improve the ability to eliminate digital noise.Newly developed digital filters and D/A converters are used to improve phase and crosstalk characteristics.In the audio section, the printed foil on the upper part of the double-sided printed circuit board is grounded to prevent a slight induction noise, and the L/R symmetric isometric pattern is used for the signal line to eliminate mutual interference.We use high-quality parts such as high-speed diodes with low pulse noise and wide-band low-noise electrolytic capacitors for audio. We also select the best products for signal processors and other digital ICs.The power supply unit is composed of three independent power, servo system, digital system and audio system, eliminating interference between each block.Equipped with two gold-plated output terminals, fixed and variable.Subcode output is installed.Equipped with a headphone port with volume.The volume uses a motor drive system that emphasizes sound quality.Equipped with a large FL multi-display.It comes with a wireless remote control that allows you to play a program of 15 songs and open / close the disc tray.

sections.title: VICTOR XL-Z505
sections.overview: A CD player with technologies such as K2 interface and DD converter.The D/A converter is equipped with a DD (Digital Direct) converter developed from a 1-bit DAC using original technology.In principle, the 1-bit DAC does not generate 0 cross distortion due to amplitude error, so the micro-level reproduction capability, which was difficult with the ladder-type DAC, is greatly enhanced. However, since 16-bit CD data is represented by 1-bit pulse waves, the reproducibility is greatly affected by the noise shaper that improves data compression error and the resolution of pulse waves.The DD converter uses a VANS noise shaper for bit compression to express 16-bit precision data with 1-bit pulse wave operation. This enables fourth order noise shaping, which was previously limited to the third order, to achieve higher precision conversion.In addition, the DD converter is equipped with a PEM (Pulse Edge Modulation) circuit, which generates two pulse waves and utilizes the time difference between the rise and fall of each pulse wave. This realizes high resolution and high precision more than twice that of conventional systems.It is equipped with a newly developed fine clock generator to support digital direct recording of CD in SCMS DAT standard.In this circuit, the master clock generation circuit incorporated in the conventional D/A converter is made independent and shielded to eliminate interference with peripheral circuits, thereby improving the quality of digital signal output.It has a unique K2 interface circuit.The K2 interface circuit takes note of the fact that sound quality changes due to jitter (time difference distortion) and ripple (waveform distortion) that occur in digital signals. By reading only code information from digital transmission signals and recreating the same music signal, digital distortion that cannot be eliminated by conventional waveform shaping is eliminated.The K2 interface and DD converter are provided with a synchronous signal from a precise fine clock generator for more precise conversion.In order to eliminate transmission loss, not only analog circuits but also digital signal circuits are pursuing the shortest and efficient layout along the signal flow. In addition, in order to eliminate mutual interference between each circuit, the separation structure is also taken into consideration. In particular, a full-scale shield panel is installed for the first time in this class against microcomputer noise leaking from the FL display.The D/A separation type is also used for the power supply.It uses a center mechanism in which the rotating system is located near the center of gravity of the main body, and realizes more accurate pickup operation by reducing vibration structurally.In order to completely eliminate vibration, the chassis base adopts a ladder frame chassis reinforced with a 1.6 mm thick steel plate with a unique frame, thereby strengthening bending rigidity and suppressing vibration from the outside.In addition, vibration is reduced by mounting a pickup system on the ladder frame chassis via a mechanical arc base. This mechanical arc base is an evolution of the arc base, which was born from the same robust structure as the foundation of the building. It uses foamed high-density resin that boasts a high vibration damping rate.The top cover beam is used on the upper part of the chassis to prevent the noise of the top plate and to reinforce the front and rear panels.Equipped with a triple editing system that can perform two mode tape editing.With this function, you can perform editing that fits within the specified time. With auto-edit, you can perform one touch editing according to the order of songs by leaving it to the microcomputer, and with program edit, you can program according to the order of songs you like.Equipped with a display ON/OFF function to prevent microcomputer noise.Equipped with a dimmer switch that can adjust the brightness.There are 2 color variations, gun-metallic and black.Wireless remote control is included.

sections.title: VICTOR XL-Z511
sections.overview: The optical transmission system is a CD player adopting D/A separation two block structure.In order to eliminate digital noise such as servo current noise of digital circuits and clock pulses of microcomputers, an optica link (optical transmission method) using a photocoupler is adopted.In addition, by using separate boards for the digital & servo circuit and the analog circuit, the analog circuit is mechanically and electrically separated, eliminating the sound quality degradation caused by noise interference.It is equipped with two digital outputs which are coaxial with the optical system.The digital filter uses a newly developed 4-times oversampling digital filter, which realizes 266 order operation, 100 dB out-of-band attenuation characteristics, and   0.0001 dB in-band ripple.As a result, the analog filter at the latter stage can be made loose and simple, reducing phase shift and distortion.The D/A converter employs a newly developed high-speed fine D/A converter using an independent high-speed I-V amplifier.The SN ratio and dynamic range have been expanded by greatly increasing the conversion speed to voltage compared to the conventional one.A lightweight, high-precision 3-beam pickup is used for the pickup part.In this pickup, the response speed is improved by shortening the distance between the main beam for reading signals and the two sub-beams. In addition, the weight of the moving part is reduced to 1/2 of the conventional weight, and the tracing performance is improved. This reduces excess servo current and greatly reduces servo noise.The chassis structure uses a newly developed silent base in addition to a large insulated foot.The SILENT BASE has a 3-layer structure with a special synthetic resin as a core. It has extremely high internal loss and low resonance. Moreover, it has a low center of gravity due to its weight, which reduces vibration structurally.Non-resonance and non-vibration are achieved by adopting IS mechanism k.The IS mechanism has a structure in which the disk drive system and the pickup system are set on one base and floating mounted by an insulation system using special rubber. This double anti-vibration structure eliminates disturbance vibration and sound pressure from speakers.It has an editing function that automatically programs according to the tape time.Program playback of 32 songs is possible.Program operations can be performed in the tray eject state, and additional memory is available during performance.It has a random play function.It is equipped with an intro-scan function that plays back the head of a song for about 15 seconds each.Equipped with 5 types of repeat functions.It is equipped with FL display.Equipped with a remote control electric volume that can be used as a headphone volume.The volume is motorized for sound quality, and the LED flashes during operation, making it easy to see from a distance.Equipped with a timer standby mechanism.Equipped with a synchro terminal, it can be linked with VICTOR/JVC's synchro compatible deck.Equipped with auto-space function.Wireless remote control is included.

sections.overview: A CD player with a full-time 18-bit D/A converter.Full-time 18-bit L/R independent combination 4 dac is mounted on the D/A conversion part.The XL-Z521 uses a discrete configuration for the lower two bits, which is difficult to achieve accuracy, and a combination of a 16-bit DAC and a 4 DAC configuration for current addition. It realizes high accuracy and high resolution by always operating the 18 bits at full capacity from Chikara Oire to large input.The digital filter uses an 8 x oversampling digital filter.By shifting up from 44.1 kHz to 352.8 kHz, which is 8 times higher, and removing unnecessary high frequency components, the load on the low-pass filter after D/A conversion is reduced, and phase characteristics, distortion factor, and SN ratio are improved.The chassis structure uses a thick triple chassis.Two bottom bases of different thickness are installed under the chassis base to effectively disperse the resonance mode of the body. In addition, the solid chassis structure realizes a total weight of 8.5 kg, which reduces resonance and eliminates unnecessary vibration.In addition, a large insulated foot is directly attached to the 3.2 mm thick bottom base to reduce external vibration.A newly developed stabilizing wheel is mounted on the rotating part to improve rotational stability by equalizing the moment of inertia of disks of different sizes.The digital circuit, servo circuit and audio circuit are independent on each board, and the logic and analog sections of the audio circuit are electrically separated by an optical link method to eliminate the adverse effects of digital noise.In order to eliminate the influence of digital noise generated from the FL display, a display ON/OFF switch which can turn off the FL display is mounted.It is equipped with two digital outputs which are coaxial with the optical system.Equipped with a Triple A dipping system.Auto Edit Mode 1 automatically distributes songs that fit within a specified time to the A/B side of the tape according to the order of songs, and Program Edit Mode 2 allows you to program songs that fit within a specified time to the A/B side of the tape according to the order of songs.In Mode 3 Multi Edit, you can program from any number of discs within the specified time, and even if you change discs, you can display the remaining time for each selected song.Equipped with an electric volume that supports remote control.Uses gold-plated output terminal.It is equipped with a random program selection function of up to 32 songs.Equipped with 99 track index search function.It is equipped with an auto space function that allows 4 seconds between songs.Equipped with 4 types of repeat function between all tracks / one track / program / A and B.Equipped with a Compulink terminal for synchronized operation.Wireless remote control is included.

sections.title: VICTOR XL-Z531
sections.overview: A CD player with K2 interface and newly developed arc base.The digital circuit has a K2 interface.In this circuit, a detection circuit controlled by a precise master clock reads only the code information from the digital signal including the non-code component, and creates a completely identical new digital waveform on another block based on the information. This circuit completely shuts out the non-code component contained before passing through the K2 interface and suppresses current noise that cannot be removed by waveform shaping.The D/A converter is equipped with a DD (Digital Direct) converter.Unlike conventional ladder-type D/A converters, the DD converter converts digital signals into 1-bit pulse waves that vary based on the crystal clock and directly converts them into analog signals. Therefore, unlike conventional ladder-type D/A converters, the DD converter does not accumulate bits, so 0 cross distortion caused by amplitude errors does not occur in principle. This greatly enhances the ability to reproduce signals at minute levels. In addition, it realizes excellent characteristics such as a dynamic range of more than 100 dB and a distortion rate of less than 0.0017%.The DD converter consists of three parts : a digital filter, a noise shaper, a PEM, and a DAC, all of which are digitally processed.The chassis structure employs a newly developed arc base.The arc base is made of a newly developed special resin with excellent vibration absorption, and has a new design of lattice-like ribs that completely suppress resonance.The structure damping characteristics of the CD player as a whole are greatly improved by attaching the mechanism and circuit board directly to the chassis base steel plate and then attaching it to the base. In addition, in order to maintain the precision operation of the disk drive system, an insulator is placed between the arc base, mechanical base, and pickup base for flow training, and vibration is effectively eliminated by a three layer suspension structure combined with a special damper of a large insulated foot integrally molded with the arc base.It uses a stabilizing wheel to improve rotational stability by equalizing the moment of inertia of the 12 cm disc and the 8 cm CD single, thereby suppressing changes in servo current and maintaining high sound quality at a high level.Two FL displays are mounted on the display section, and the counter display is separated from the 20-track program chart and installed separately on the upper part of the tray. It is easier to see by function.In addition, the display ON/OFF switch, which prevents microcomputer noise, can turn off either one of the positions that can be turned off during play, and the dimmer switch allows the display brightness to be adjusted to three levels.Equipped with a 3-mode Triple A ditto system, you can edit various CDs.In addition to distributing songs that fit within the specified time to the A/B side of the tape, it is equipped with auto-edit which can be automatically edited by one touch according to the order of songs by the microcomputer, program edit which can be selected according to your favorite order of songs, and multi-edit which can be programmed from many disks to make the best.The volume uses a remote control electric volume linked to the headphone.It is equipped with functions such as repeat (all songs / one song / program / A-B), 32 songs random program, 99 songs index search, introscan, autospace, timer play, etc.Equipped with two digital output terminals that are coaxial with the optical system.There are two analog outputs, fixed and variable.Equipped with synchronous terminal.In addition to the regular color, there was a gun-metallic color variation.Wireless remote control is included.

sections.overview: A CD player with K2 interface circuit.A K2 interface circuit is mounted to eliminate digital distortion caused by jitter (time difference distortion) and ripple (waveform distortion) added to digital waveform.In this circuit, a detection circuit controlled by a precise master clock reads only the code information from the digital signal containing the non-code component and creates the same digital waveform on another block based on that information, thereby electrically suppressing the non-code component contained before passing through the K2 interface.The D/A converter uses an 8-times oversampling digital filter and a full-time 18-bit L/R independent combination 4 dac configuration. The 18-bit is always fully operated from the time of Chikara Oire to the time of large input, realizing high precision and resolution.In order to prevent interference between circuits, digital / analog / K2 interface circuits are used as separate boards. The K2 interface circuit also uses D/A separation pattern on the board.A large transformer with excellent regulation is used for the power supply, and interference is eliminated by supplying power to each of digital, servo and analog circuits independently. The rectifier circuit and constant voltage circuit are also separated to provide a stable power supply.Newly developed lightweight pickup with improved signal reading accuracy is adopted.In addition, we have adopted a stabilizing wheel that equalizes the moment of inertia of the different 8 cm and 12 cm discs. By realizing stable rotation, the change of servo current is reduced and high sound quality is achieved.The chassis structure is a triple chassis with high-rigidity material between the bottom base and chassis base to disperse the resonance mode of the body. In addition, an insulator is installed between the pickup / mechanical base / chassis base, and in addition, a three layer suspension structure with a large insulation foot directly attached to the bottom base is adopted.The Triple A Ditto system is installed as a function used for tape editing, etc.In Mode 1 "Auto Edit", the A/B side of the tape is automatically programmed according to the order of songs on the disk. If there is a song that does not fit within the specified time, you can select a song that fits within the remaining songs.In Mode 2 "Program Edit", you can program the A/B side of the tape in the desired song order within a specified time. You can program without calculating the time by displaying the remaining time or flashing the number of songs that do not fit within the time.In Mode 3 "Multi Edit", you can program from multiple discs within a specified time. With this function, even if you replace the disc, the remaining time display for each selected song and the flashing display for the number of songs that do not fit within the time display operate.By adopting a remote bar for the power switch, the wiring route is minimized.Equipped with a display ON/OFF switch to eliminate digital noise.It is equipped with two digital outputs which are coaxial with the optical system.Remote control electric volume is adopted.Gold-plated output terminal is mounted.It is equipped with the function of selecting up to 32 random program songs, index search of 99 songs, repeat all songs / one song / program / between A and B.It is equipped with an auto space function that allows 4 seconds between songs.Equipped with a Compulink terminal for synchronized operation.Wireless remote control is included.

sections.title: VICTOR XL-Z701
sections.overview: This CD player pursues D/A independent separation design by optical transmission system and shield box structure.The digital / servo circuit and audio circuit are separated mechanically and electromagnetically by making them independent of each board. In addition, the audio board is covered with a shield case in a two box structure. This eliminates the influence of servo current noise and microcomputer clock pulses.In addition, the signal from the digital circuit is converted into light by the optic-link (optical transmission) method and transmitted to the audio circuit to electrically shut out digital noise.Equipped with two digital output terminals that are coaxial with the optical system.The D/A converter uses a newly developed 4-times over-sampling digital filter with 266 order operation order. By shifting the sampling frequency from 44.1 kHz to 176.4 kHz, interference in the audio band is almost eliminated. This digital filter has an out-of-band attenuation of more than 100 dB and an in-band ripple of less than   0.0001 dB.The D/A converter uses an LR-independent high-speed conversion type with less crosstalk and phase shift, enabling more faithful D/A conversion.The Dig-Richer circuit eliminates digital noise such as data switching signals incorporated into analog circuits immediately after D/A conversion. It employs a newly developed fine-dig-richer circuit that eliminates serial switching elements, thereby eliminating sound quality degradation caused by semiconductor elements.The servo circuit is equipped with VICTOR/JVC's original V servo system.The V servo is a circuit that uses a vibration detection element V sensor that detects sound pressure and disturbance vibration from speakers. By controlling the servo gain instantaneously only when vibration is detected, a stable trace is always achieved. At the same time, excessive servo current is prevented from affecting the music signal.High-precision 3-beam pickup is used for the pickup part.This pickup improves the response speed by shortening the beam interval, and reduces the mass of the moving part to 1/2 of the conventional one to improve the tracing performance and reduce the excess servo current to suppress servo noise.In order to eliminate vibration and resonance that adversely affect sound quality, it is equipped with a thick, high-rigidity solid base to lower the center of gravity of the entire body and form a strong casing.In addition, the for the heavy drive system, we pursue non-resonance and non-vibration by the IS mechanism which combines the base of damping steel plate and floating mount by special rubber.Equipped with editing function.This feature allows the microcomputer to automatically select the tape to fit within the recording time of the tape.The volume uses a motor drive system and the volume can be adjusted with a remote control.During operation, the LED flashes to indicate the volume change.Program playback of up to 32 songs is possible.Program functions can be performed while the tray is ejected and the disc is viewed, and additional memory is available during program performance.It has a random play function that the microcomputer automatically selects music.It is equipped with an intro-scan and a random intro-play function that plays the head of a song for about 15 seconds each.Equipped with 5 types of repeat functions.Equipped with a large FL display.Equipped with auto-space function for approximately 4 seconds.Equipped with a timer standby mechanism.Equipped with a sync terminal, recording and editing is possible in conjunction with JVC's sync compatible cassette deck.It comes with a wireless remote control that allows you to perform 10 key direct music selection, editing, programming, random play, introscan and more at hand.

sections.title: VICTOR XL-Z711
sections.overview: A CD player with K2 interface circuit.A K2 interface circuit is mounted to eliminate digital distortion.In the K2 interface circuit, in order to eliminate uncorrelated components such as jitters and ripples mixed in the digital signal processing section, a structurally and electrically independent block board is provided in the signal transmission process from the digital section to the analog section. In this board, the digital section and analog section are completely separated electrically by optical transmission using a Route 3 photocoupler and an independent power supply, and a digital code without uncorrelated components is generated in the analog section.The K2 interface employs a signal generation method in which only the signal is detected as a code by high-speed switching operation of a semiconductor from the digital signal transmitted by a photocoupler, etc., and a new digital waveform is created based on this information. Therefore, uncorrelated components are removed from the signal received by the analog section.The digital filter employs an 8 x oversampling digital filter. By shifting up the sampling frequency to 352.8 kHz, the adverse effects of digital noise are eliminated, and the low-pass filter characteristics after D/A conversion are made smooth.This improves the phase characteristics and distortion factor.The D/A converter uses a full-time 18-bit discrete 2 + 2D/A converter.This D/A converter has a structure in which 18-bit information is separated into upper 16 bits and lower 2 bits. In particular, the lower bit, which is difficult to pursue accuracy, is made into a discrete DAC structure. By adding current to the 16-bit DAC, high accuracy with excellent linearity is realized. This enables 18 bits to operate full-time from Riki Oire to large input, and signal resolution is 4 times higher than 16 bits at all times.In addition, a left and right independent configuration is adopted to eliminate mutual interference and phase shift between each channel.The digital circuit, K2 interface circuit, and analog circuit are independent for each board in order to eliminate the mutual interference of each circuit.It is equipped with two digital outputs which are coaxial with the optical system.A large FL display has been adopted.The FL ON/OFF switch also turns off the display during performance to prevent digital noise from the display. When not playing, the display returns automatically so that operability is not obstructed.The chassis has a W-chassis structure and is equipped with a second high-rigidity heavyweight chassis under the chassis base.The lower chassis is made of a composite material with high internal loss due to iron and resin. The uneven grid-like pattern effectively disperses and absorbs vibration. The structure supports both sides to form an extremely strong case.A triple suspension floating mechanism structure is adopted for the mechanism part.In order to protect the particularly important drive system from vibration and sound pressure, insulators are installed in the support parts of the foot, mechanical base and pickup base.Equipped with a multi-disc editing function that allows you to select songs from 6 discs while calculating the remaining time.Equipped with a CD disc memory function, you can input a message to the disc or each song and display it as text.It is equipped with functions such as program function of 32 songs, random play, intro play and 5 kinds of repeat.It uses a motor-driven remote control electric volume. This volume can also be used for headphones.The operation status can be confirmed by flashing lights.Uses a tray compatible with 8 cm single CD.Equipped with synchronous terminal.Wireless remote control is included.

sections.title: VICTOR XL-Z900
sections.overview: A top-loading CD player.In order to eliminate the adverse effects of external sound pressure and vibration on CD disks and pickups, we have eliminated the front loading tray, which is the source of such noise, and adopted a top-loading air tie and structure.This improves the confidentiality of the CD turntable and pickup section and prevents sound pressure from entering the chassis.The glass top is made of 8 mm thick soda-lime glass to reduce external vibration and unwanted resonance.By adopting a simple manual loading system, the disk clamper has been made into a large stabilizer by cutting out aluminum.A magnet is incorporated inside the disk and the disk is pressed to prevent vibration of the disk effectively.A 6   spindle equivalent to the XL-Z1000 is used to prevent twisting of the motor shaft if the motor torque is increased to obtain stable rotation.Twenty seven times the torsional strength of conventional products, eliminating the lag of the spindle against the rotation of the motor.We have also adopted highly reliable motors produced in-house to achieve high precision.In order to pursue structural freedom from vibration and resonance, we have adopted a center of gravity holding mechanism.The lens position is located on the center of gravity of the mechanical base when the pickup is on the inner side of the disk, and when it is on the outer side of the disk, it is designed to coincide with the center of gravity of the insulator that supports the chassis housing.As a result, the pickup is structurally traced in a line shape that is least affected by vibration, and adverse effects of vibration are prevented as much as possible.A double plate with copper-plated steel plates is used for the mechanical base of the pickup system.In pursuit of a mass that lowers the resonance frequency to the servo band, internal vibration is reduced and external vibration is cut off.In addition, we have adopted a structure in which the mechanical base is supported more firmly than the lower chassis by an insulator with increased damping effect by silicon oil and spring, and a structure in which the mechanical base is supported more firmly than the lower chassis by an acoustic cast iron block.In addition, a pure copper foot is used for the ground plane, and a thorough vibration-proof design is applied to reduce the effect of sound pressure.New DD converter is adopted.The D/A conversion method employs a 1-bit DAC method, which in principle does not cause unconformity distortion and distortion that are harmful to sound quality. In addition, the D/A conversion method realizes superior characteristics by improving the defect of the 1-bit DAC, which lacks resolution, with a fourth order noise shaper and a PEM circuit.In order to obtain more ideal conversion characteristics, the operation rate has been increased from 32 times over sampling to 64 times over sampling.As a result, the requantization noise in the entire band is reduced by approximately 10 dB, and noise is suppressed to twice the frequency band of the audio band without relying on a low-pass filter.In addition, by increasing the operation rate, the third harmonic which always occurs in 1-bit DAC has been reduced to 1/4.In addition to the D/A separation design that separates the digital circuit board, the digital and analog signal processing sections of the K2 interface, and the audio circuit board, not only separate the digital power supply and audio power supply, but also employ a thorough separation structure in which two transformers are placed independently of the power supply.In addition, we have reduced the size of the digital chip substrate and eliminated the influence of noise by minimizing the signal path. In addition, optical cables are used to transmit signals from the digital transmitter to the receiver, preventing noise from entering the digital transmission path and eliminating leakage of digital noise and power supply leakage.It is equipped with a K2 interface that removes digital distortion such as jitter and ripple from transmitted digital signals by a technique called code refinement.Furthermore, by entrusting the accuracy of code generation to the crystal oscillator, more ideal K2 interface operation is realized.The clock oscillator circuit is packaged in one chip to improve the accuracy and stability of the crystal oscillator used for timing control of picking up digital codes from CD disks, reference signal for analog conversion of DD converter, and code generation of K2 interface.In addition, the X-tal holding structure, which lowers the center of gravity by laying the oscillator horizontally instead of vertically, eliminates the vibration moment.In addition, the mass of the vibration itself is reduced to 1/2, and it is packaged with a ceramic base with high vibration resistance and a metal Kovar cover with high internal loss to reduce oscillation frequency fluctuations caused by external vibration and sound pressure.Synchronous input terminal is provided so that the drive unit can be connected to the external DAC unit at high level.For analog output, a balanced output terminal is also provided.It comes with a remote control equipped with a time search function that can call up the part you want to listen to in seconds, dimmer and display OFF switch.

sections.title: VICTOR XL-Z999EX
sections.overview: A CD player developed as a culmination of three K2 processors.In addition to the K2 interface, 20bitK2 super coding and 20bitK2 processing, which have improved sound quality by the cooperation of software and hardware of JVC, it is equipped with Extended K2 processing which has advanced further by the flow of high bit high sampling.In this technology, the input digital signal is assumed to be the music signal before band limitation, and is expanded to twice the sampling frequency and reproduced. This makes it possible to recover natural harmonic components close to the original music signal, reproducing subtle differences in sound quality, afterglow, and the atmosphere of the performance venue.The 4-power transformer 22 independent power supply system, 2-layer chassis and 3-block structure for mechanical arrangement to the center of gravity point, and the shortest signal path eliminate adverse effects due to mutual interference.In addition, we aim to reproduce high-purity music signals by connecting digital and analog boards with a high-speed balanced transmission circuit, and by adopting a K2 interface for high-speed balanced transmission that removes extraneous components such as jitter and ripple added to digital waveforms from the root.Equipped with 3fs-capable 20-bit K2 digital outputs and Route 3 inputs, you can not only play CDs, but also combine them with BS, MD, DAT and external processors.The CD transport section uses a top-loading system.In addition to the highly airtight air-tight structure, the top cover uses a metal-evaporated glass door to minimize adverse effects of electromagnetic waves and infrared rays.In addition, the drive system is equipped with a linear torque motor with an extremely thick spindle shaft with a diameter of 6 mm and a center-of-gravity point holding mechanism that stabilizes the operation of the pickup. This ensures high rigidity and high accuracy.Wireless remote control is included.There was a large diameter clamper as an option sold separately.

sections.title: VICTOR XD-Z505
sections.overview: DAT deck equipped with AA-DD converter.It is equipped with newly developed AA (analog-accurate) converter.This circuit is an A/D conversion application of the D/A conversion technology of 1-bit pulse-width modulation. It also performs fourth order noise shaping to increase the linearity at a minute level, and realizes excellent S/N and distortion factor.It uses the DD (Digital Direct) converter that is also installed in Victor's CD player.This circuit converts a digital signal into a pulse wave that varies based on an accurate crystal clock and directly converts it into an analog signal. There is no amplitude error caused by the accumulation of conventional bit quantities. This eliminates in principle the 0 cross distortion that could not be eliminated even with high bit.The mechanism uses a fine tracking mechanism and a double-scan system to improve the accuracy and driving stability of the mechanism and to minimize reading errors.Supports DAT-specific subcodes.In the XD-Z505, the keys to operate this subcode are deployed independently to improve usability.Equipped with Auto ID edit function.The start ID, which is automatically recorded during recording, senses the beginning of the song and is written. This results in a slight delay in the start of the song. To fix this with a simple operation, the Auto ID Edit function allows the microcomputer to search for the optimum start ID position and rerecord according to it.In addition, since the silence level of a song can be determined in three levels : -60dB, -50dB, and -40dB, it is possible to accurately search for a song that starts quietly, which is difficult to see between songs.Equipped with a sampling monitor function, the digital signal just before recording can be heard after D/A conversion, so that the sound quality and sound level can be checked without setting the recording pause state.Even when no tape is inserted, the analog input can be converted to digital output at all times, and the digital input can be converted to analog output. Therefore, it can be used as a D/A converter or an A/D converter.Equipped with a 20-dot digital meter with peak hold function.It is equipped with a repeat playback function for all songs / one song.Equipped with 2 digital input / output terminals for optical / coaxial systems.Equipped with a digital / analog source selector.Equipped with Compulink-1 / synchro terminal, recording operation linked with VICTOR/JVC's synchro compatible CD player is possible.Timer rerecording is supported.Equipped with a headphone port with volume.It comes with a wireless remote controller that allows direct music selection with 10 keys.

sections.title: VICTOR XD-Z707
sections.overview: DAT deck with AA converter.It is equipped with newly developed AA (analog-accurate) converter.This circuit is an A/D conversion application of the D/A conversion technology of 1-bit pulse-width modulation. It also performs fourth order noise shaping to increase the linearity at a minute level, and realizes excellent S/N and distortion factor.A 1-bit dual D/A converter is used for the D/A converter.In this circuit, the digital signal is first upsampled by a factor of 256 through an oversampling digital filter, then passed through a noise shaper to greatly shift the requantization noise, which adversely affects the audio band, out of the audible band. The resulting digital code is then converted an analog quantity by pulse density modulation.Since this method uses 1-bit data, there is no need for precision in the amplitude direction like the integration method. Since this method can be controlled only by a precise quartz clock in the time axis direction, linearity problems caused by amplitude errors and 0 cross distortion do not occur in principle, enabling D/A conversion with excellent resolution of minute signals.The drive train uses a fine tracking mechanism to ensure the highest possible accuracy and stability. In addition, Victor's unique double-scan method allows the recorded signal to be read twice during playback to minimize errors.As a result, a high-performance 32k-LP mode comparable to the 48k mode has been realized, enabling up to four hours of recording (when using R-120) while covering the dynamic range and frequency characteristics of the satellite broadcast A mode.It has a 5-block structure in which both A/D and D/A converters, mechanical part, power supply part, signal processing part and display part such as display are clearly separated, and the transformer eliminates interference and adverse effect on the audio circuit as an analog / digital separate winding.Furthermore, these constructions are installed on a 1 mm thick steel plate base incorporating rib structure, and vibration - and interference-free design is also realized to improve total sound quality.By using the shortest signal path design, input selectors and and volume are placed close to the input terminal, the signal line is as short as possible, and the board pattern is not wasted, which reduces loss and interference during transmission.Equipped with a digital mixing function, you can enjoy mixing the digital sound being played on the XD-Z707 with another sound. The input signal to be mixed is both analog and digital.It is equipped with a digital fade system in which smooth fade operations are memorized in a computer.5-second fade-in and 10-second fade-out can be done automatically with a single switch. Digital input can also be faded.When editing a CD, it is possible to automatically read the Q-code information of the CD and write the start ID just before the start of the song.In addition, it is equipped with Auto ID Edit which tells the position where the start ID is written by a computer, and it can be easily rewritten manually.Equipped with a sampling monitor, the digital input is also monitored by D/A conversion immediately before recording so that sound quality and level can be easily checked.It can also be used as an A/D / D/A converter unit because it can output after A/D / D/A conversion even without a tape.Cassette tray can be opened / closed by remote control.Equipped with a 20-dot digital meter with peak hold function.It has a direct selection function with 10 keys.Equipped with intro-scan.It is equipped with a repeat playback function for all songs / one song.It has a Queue & Review function.Equipped with P-time display function.Equipped with digital input / output of 2 optical / coaxial systems.Equipped with a digital / analog source selector.Equipped with Compulink-1 / synchro terminal, recording operation linked with VICTOR/JVC's synchro compatible CD player is possible.Equipped with timer recording and replay function.Equipped with a headphone port with volume.Gold-plated input / output terminal is mounted.Wireless remote control is included.

sections.title: VICTOR XD-Z909
sections.overview: DAT deck with K2 interface.It is equipped with a K2 interface that eliminates digital sound quality variation factors.This circuit has a structure that reads only the code information from the transmitted digital signal contaminated by out-of-code components such as jitter (time-difference distortion) and ripple (waveform distortion), and creates a pure digital signal at another location.In the XD-Z909, this K2 interface is installed just before the D/A converter to prevent the sound quality of the digital signal from changing.It is equipped with newly developed AA (analog-accurate) converter.The AA converter uses a 1-bit conversion method, replacing analog signals with pulse waves instead of bits, and directly converting the width of the waves into digital signals. This eliminates the need for precision in the direction of amplitude. Moreover, pulse waves that vary with time can be precisely controlled by a quartz clock, making it possible to perform digital conversion with excellent linearity.Furthermore, in order to reduce the conversion error, it is passed through a fourth order noise shaper to shift the sampling distortion out of the band, and this data is passed through a 64 x digital filter to almost completely remove noise outside the audible band.The D/A converter consists of an 18-bit digital bias D/A converter and an 18-bit active D/A converter. It uses an 8-times oversampling full-time 18-bit 4D/A converter.In this D/A converter, 18 bits are always fully operated from Oire power to large input. In addition, there is no 0 cross distortion by the digital bias operation, and the non-linear distortion of the DAC is randomized, so that the sound quality in the auditory sense becomes natural.Uses a fine tracking mechanism with a total weight of only 230g.The rotary head with this mechanism uses a TSS head with excellent recording and playback characteristics and high abrasion resistance for the double-scan system. The ultra-compact capstan DD motor uses a plunger brake to shorten the search time. In addition, a 28 mm diameter flywheel and a tension control mechanism have been introduced to achieve precise operation.A fully independent 5-block structure is adopted to eliminate mutual interference between each circuit.Both the A/D and D/A converters, the mechanical part, the power supply part, the signal processing part and the display part such as the display are separated by the board or by adopting the shield structure, and the analog / digital circuit is separated by installing the twin configuration power transformer.In consideration of the effect on sound quality, the signal transmission system is minimized and interference and vibration between fine parts and wires are eliminated thoroughly.In order to reduce the adverse effects of vibration, a solid base with optimum damping characteristics and heavy weight is placed further below the chassis base, eliminating vibration from the outside and effectively absorbing vibration from the inside.The wireless remote control is equipped with an FL display off function, which can turn off the FL display which is a source of digital noise.It is equipped with a microphone jack, and the microphone amplifier is a full-fledged low-noise type with an attenuator.In addition, it is a completely separate box design that is independently installed under the deck body.The input / output terminal is equipped with one optical / coaxial system for the digital system, and one variable output terminal in addition to one fixed input / output terminal for the analog system. The volume can be adjusted by remote control.The input can be switched by the selector on the front panel of the main unit.It uses a start ID recording function that automatically reads the Q code information of the CD, and accurate heading information can be written.In addition, manual rewriting can be easily performed by using Auto ID Edit, which searches the position where the start ID is written on a computer, and by using an independent subcode key.Equipped with a digital mixing function, it can mix not only analog but also digital input signals.You can also edit digital mixing by adding another DAT deck.Equipped with a digital fade function.The 5-second fade-in and 10-second fade-out functions are memorized in the computer, and one touch fade operation without failure is possible.Equipped with a sampling monitor function, the digital input is also D/A converted before recording so that the sound quality and level can be checked in advance. In addition, the digital input is A/D / D/A converted and output even without a tape, so it can be used as an A/D / D/A converter.Cassette tray can be opened / closed by remote control.Equipped with a 20-dot digital meter with peak hold function.Equipped with 10-key direct music selection function.Equipped with blank search, skip, and end search functions.Equipped with an intro-scan function.It is equipped with a repeat playback function for all songs / one song.It has a Queue & Review function.Equipped with P-time display function.Compulink-1 / Synchro terminal is mounted.Timer recording and playback are supported.Equipped with a headphone port with volume.Gold-plated input / output terminal is mounted.Wireless remote control is included.

sections.title: VICTOR XD-Z1100
sections.overview: The DAT deck was developed using Victor's tape audio and VHS technologies.The mechanism part adopts a fine tracking mechanism that pursues high precision of micron order.In this mechanism, we pursue micron-order precision for precision parts such as Sendust / ferrite composite heads and rotary drums. At the same time, we have developed original MR-type direct drive motors and drum direct drive motors to achieve stability and high precision of the drive system.In addition, VHS technology and know-how are applied to the M-type loading of the bending and extension two joint ring, which is patented by VICTOR/JVC. The angle of the inclined post that does not provide a stable tape path based on theoretical values alone, the angle at which the tape hits the head, and the mechanism for regulating the tape position. In addition, VHS technology and know-how are applied. In addition, VHS technology and know-how are applied to the angle of the inclined post and the control mechanism of the tape position. In addition, VHS technology and know-how are applied to the rotating head part. In addition, VHS technology and know-how are applied to the rotating head part. In addition, VHS technology and know-how are applied to the rotating head part. In addition, VHS technology and know-how are applied to the rotating head part. In addition, VHS technology and know-For DAT tapes, there are ATF areas on both sides of the PCM area in each track. The servo circuit reads the ATF signal that the head picks up during the trace to compensate for track deviation. The allowable range is   3 ? m.The XD-Z1100 uses a large flywheel with a diameter of 40 mm for its precise rotational head mechanism to reduce jitter and ensure that it receives ATF signals. Moreover, by introducing a powerful servo circuit, it achieves excellent characteristics with track deviation less than half of the reference value.In addition, in order to keep the tension of the tape constant, which is different at the beginning and the end of winding of the tape, a tension servo mechanism is installed, so that the drive system is always stabilized and the durability of the tape is also improved.The A/D converter employs a high-speed cascade-integration type A/D converter of one chip configuration with the same LR balance.The D/A converter is equipped with a newly developed digital filter for DAT with an overflow limiter and a 1-chip successive approximation D/A converter.The digital & servo system and analog system are completely separated, and the audio circuit is packaged on a single glass composite substrate and housed in a shield box. This reduces magnetic retention and induction noise and protects the audio circuit from microcomputer and servo system noise.In addition to analog input / output, coaxial and optical digital input / output terminals are mounted.In the power supply section, the three power supplies for the servo current section, audio section and digital section are separated from each other to eliminate electromagnetic effects.The analog power supply section uses a   2 power supply with a low impedance design with a ripple rejection rate of 74 dB, providing a stable power supply.In order to protect the mechanism from vibration, a non-resonance and non-vibration design is adopted.In addition to pursuing a low center of gravity and vibration control structure with a high-rigidity heavy solid base, a tough body is formed with aluminum top and side covers of 3 mm thickness.In addition, the large insulator suppresses external vibration of speakers, etc.In addition to 48kHz/16bit normal recording / rerecording, 32kHz/12bit long recording / rerecording is supported, and 4 hours recording / rerecording is possible with R-120 tape.It also supports two play-only modes for music tapes : 44.1 kHz / 16-bit standard and wide track.The cassette door has a gull-wing door that smoothly moves up and down to open and close the tape slot. Combined with the cassette holding mechanism of the motor drive, it holds the tape in place while maintaining the accuracy of the mechanism.Equipped with an after-sampling monitor, the digital input can be directly D/A converted and output to the analog terminal. In addition, the analog input can be monitored by D/A conversion immediately after A/D conversion. Therefore, it is possible to check the sound quality and level just before recording.It can be monitored continuously during recording, and after sampling can be monitored by pressing the Call / Monitor key at stop.Equipped with 3 x speed search by capstan drive, fast forward and rewind can be performed while listening to voice.It includes an active bit display that directly reads the active bit, an average / peak parallel display meter with peak hold, and a digital peak display that displays margins for full bit levels for precise adjustment of recording levels.It is equipped with a multi-mode display adopting a large FL tube.This display displays the overload indicator, level meter, digital peak display, memory indicator, repeat indicator, tape mode indicator, warning indicator, digital counter, counter mode indicator, program No display, subcode indicator, and after-sampling monitor indicator.Equipped with a digital input indicator.If this indicator is on, digital copying is possible, and if the PCM-ID contains a digital copy prohibited signal or a digital signal with a sampling frequency of 44.1 kHz, the PCM-ID will flash quickly.When there is no digital input signal, it blinks slowly.It supports DAT specific subcode system.As a result, the following functions are enabled : Start ID cue and direct selection by Program No., random access program for up to 50 songs, Skip function by Skip ID, Auto-rewind function which automatically stops at END information or at the end of tape winding and rewinds to the beginning of the tape, Intro-scan using Start ID, Blank search for END information or unrecorded portion, Repeat function for whole tape / desired song / 2 points.Equipped with auto REC mute which can make unrecorded part with one touch.Equipped with a timer start mechanism, you can turn on the power and start recording / playback at the desired time by using an optional timer together.Equipped with a sync terminal, it can be synchronized with JVC's sections.title: VICTOR EQ-7070
sections.overview: This is a Laboratory 7070 series phono equalizer using EL-FET.The EQ-7070 is a phono equalizer with many inputs and can be used as a control amplifier.The EQ 7070 is equipped with a newly developed EL-FET.The EL-FET has a very high mutual inductance Gm (I).DIt has a Gm of 55 m   at 10 mA, more than 8 times the conventional high GmFET) and can design an ultra-low noise amplifier. In addition to excellent S/N and compactness, it has a feature of ICL configuration without input capacitors. It can prevent low-frequency phase rotation by using a direct-coupled circuit.Five EL-FETs are connected in parallel in the first stage of the MC head amplifier and a bipolar power transistor with a cutoff frequency of 140 MHz is also used in the next stage to form an inverted Darlington connected SRPP output circuit with low distortion.In addition, high linearity is ensured by flowing a large current of 50 mA in one channel, and high S/N ratio is realized by sufficient high Gm and sufficient dynamic range.A newly developed EL-FET is also used in the first stage of the equalizer section. A high signal-to-noise ratio is achieved by combining it with a high-voltage bipolar transistor. The total gain of the equalizer including the MC head amplifier is 77 dB. Even when the equalizer output and power amplifier are connected directly without a flat amplifier, sufficient volume can be obtained.The flat amplifier is a symmetric push-pull drive circuit using a high voltage dual FET at the first stage.The gain is 16 dB.It is equipped with an auxiliary and tuner selector and an independent phono selector, which can switch between MC and MM without changing the connection of the rear panel.In the MM position, the cartridge load selector with 4-step switching of load resistance and load capacity is activated. The 100   position of the load resistance selector is for high-power MC cartridges.As a control amplifier, it is equipped with two tape monitor circuits and Aux and Tuner input terminals.Low distortion rate multi-contact 6-series volume is used for volume.This volume uses 14 high-precision multi-contact sliders and special shaped resistors to reduce distortion due to current concentration. Two series are for balance and the other four series are special 6-series volume that adjusts gain before and after the flat amplifier.The latter element works only at -30dB or less and reduces residual noise to improve the S/N of the hearing sense at low volume.In addition, the volume itself is resistant to external noise by adopting a die-cast cover, and crosstalk between channels is also improved.The power supply circuit employs a large-capacity left-and-right independently wound toroidal transformer with six double shields to completely remove leakage flux. In addition, by adding a constant voltage circuit using a wide-band transistor (ft 140 MHz) for signal circuits, the internal impedance is suppressed to less than 0.01   up to 100 kHz.We have adopted electrolytic capacitors with specially examined electrode materials and structures.There was a rack handle as an option sold separately.

sections.title: VICTOR TT-801
sections.overview: Turntable unit pursuing the ultimate of no resonance and no vibration.The turbo disk stabilizer system can be used by combining with the separately sold turbo disk stabilizer unit TS-1.In the TT 801, we have succeeded in making the inside of the center spindle an air passage. The air sucked from the eight intake holes of the turntable mat passes through the slits on the turntable and the center spindle and is guided to the outside of the unit. The air is then exhausted from the TS-1, which is connected to the unit via a 2m suction pipe. This TS-1 continues to operate while the record is rotating, and a constant suction force is always applied, so that the vibration state of the record does not change and stable playback sound can be obtained. This constant suction method is based on the same principle as the stabilizer method used in the cutting race of the original record. In addition, since all the operation of the TS-1 is controlled by the TT 801 side, there is no need to worry about restriction of the installation location due to ON-OFF operation.When the turbo disk stabilizer method is turned on, vibration generated in the middle and low frequencies is suppressed and vibration suppression effect of 20 dB or more is obtained. The relationship between the adsorption force of the stabilizer and the vibration characteristics of the record is measured. In order to obtain sufficient vibration suppression effect, the exhaust force of TS-1 is set to satisfy the adsorption force equivalent to 4 kg (70 mmAq).The drive motor is equipped with a newly developed low-vibration DC motor that uses a coreless structure without cocking and achieves a torque of 2.5kg-cm. In addition, it uses a double servo quartz circuit with 30 times higher quartz lock stability than the conventional one and a synthesizer system, enabling precise pick control up to   9.9% in 0.1% steps.In addition, it is equipped with a reset switch that can instantly return to standard speed.The turntable is a composite structure of dissimilar metals, with a die-cast aluminum body and double zinc rings attached to it, resulting in 400kg-cm.2Large inertia mass has been realized, and unnecessary resonance such as the hanging rattle phenomenon has been eliminated.Electronic brake quick stop mechanism using bi-directional servo with high rotational accuracy is adopted.An electronic display tube, Digitron, is used for the speed and quartz lock indicator.

sections.title: VICTOR DD-5
sections.overview: Cassette deck equipped with pulse servo DD motor.The mechanism section is equipped with a pulse servo DD motor developed for cassette decks based on DD phono motor technology.The basic shape of this motor is a 4-phase, 8-pole, flat-facing brushless, slotless, coreless, FG servo direct drive. The brushless structure developed by Victor Central R & D Laboratories, in which the Hall element switches polarity, eliminates mechanical contacts, improves the rotational accuracy and extends the life of the motor. The brushless, coreless, and slotless structures eliminate noise and rotational irregularities such as cocking.The pulse servo DD motor uses a frequency generator to detect the number of revolutions. sections.title: VICTOR DD-V7
sections.overview: Quick reverse deck with Fine Axis Reverse System.The read / write head uses a Senalloy head, and the erase head uses a 2-gap ferrite head.A rotary head type Fine Axis Reverse System is used for the reverse mechanism.This mechanism consists of a head mount base and a head holder for the rotating part. It uses a Jewel lock system to prevent distortion by pressing a ruby into the tip of the azimuth adjustment screw that receives the head holder. In addition, a stainless steel clamp plate is wound around the part of the head holder that is in contact with the ruby to improve abrasion resistance. The precision of all parts is on the order of 10 microns, and the precision of die-casting cannot be expected to exceed this precision.The rotating part uses a special fluorine resin coating with good sliding and excellent temperature characteristics. Unlike oil and grease, there is no change in the friction coefficient, and there is no play even in long-term use. In addition, the 2-point holding structure ensures smooth rotation while minimizing head tip fluctuation.In addition, the head is not fixed directly to the head holder, but is inserted into the head clamp and press fit into the head holder. This allows not only independent azimuth adjustment in both forward and reverse directions but also head height adjustment. The relative position between the head and tape can be accurately determined in both directions. As a result, the frequency characteristics in both forward and reverse directions and the high-frequency characteristics that tend to fluctuate are maintained in automatic operation.In addition, the azimuth adjustment screw and head height adjustment screw have adopted a screw pitch of 1 / 2 of the normal screw pitch, achieving high accuracy.Flipping the tape from A to B is done by an infrared sensor embedded in the guide pin of the tape.When the light emitted from the light-emitting device hits the splicing tape between the magnetic tape and the reader tape, the light-receiving device detects a change in the light and issues an inversion instruction, with a sound break of only 0.4 seconds.In addition, reliable operation is possible by judging by the microcomputer.The mechanism uses a 2-motor full logic and a silent mechanism with a mechanical drive motor. All modes are moved by detecting the position of the cam linked to the mechanical drive motor with a microcomputer.A pulse servo DD motor is used for the capstan motor.The servo circuit of this motor employs an FG servo that uses a frequency generator to detect rotation. The VICTOR/JVC method employs an all-around integration type of 160 poles and 80 pulses for this part, making detection errors difficult to occur even if positional deviation occurs. To prevent positional deviation, the FG magnet is coaxial with the capstan, and the magnet is magnetized after the center is held.In addition, in order to prevent the rotational accuracy from decreasing due to temperature changes and variations in parts, the multi-pride bridge drive circuit absorbs these effects and improves wow flutter.Equipped with auto REC mute.When this function is pressed in the REC mode, a silent space of approximately 4 to 5 seconds is automatically set to the REC standby mode. In addition, Victor's unique circuit design allows for no recording from the stop mode.It is equipped with an index scan, which allows you to scan the A and B sides one after another while playing the head part of the song for 10 seconds at a time.It is equipped with a blank search so that you can look for blank areas on the tape.If there is an unrecorded part for 12 seconds or more in the FF state, it is regarded as a blank, and it automatically returns to the end of the song, sends the blank part for about 4 seconds, and stops.Equipped with 2 memory functions of STOP and PLAY, block repeat between 2 points is possible by using both STOP and PLAY memory in addition to the normal STOP memory and PLAY memory.In combination with the reverse mode, block repeat across A and B faces is possible.Equipped with a 4-digital counter, it can be used as a function of direct reading of remaining time on the tape, 4-digit electronic counter, 20-song skip selection and stopwatch.With the tape remaining time direct reading function, when the tape is reversed, the remaining time on the B side is displayed as soon as it becomes 0 at the end of the tape on the A side and enters the B side, and the minute display flickers when less than 3 minutes.The 4-digit electronic counter is negative in the reverse direction so that the same number is displayed at the same position on the A side and the B side of the tape.This is a 20-song jump function. You can select up to 20 songs from both A and B sides. When you select one song, you do not need to specify the number of songs, and you can search directly with the Music Scan button.The stopwatch function is added across both A and B sides. The display time is automatically held when you stop or pause.As a noise reduction system, Dolby C NR is installed, and noise reduction effect and improvement of high frequency linearity are realized.The DD-V7 is also equipped with Dolby B NR and uses Dolby standard IC to improve operational stability.Equipped with an auto tape select function.Equipped with 2-color LED peak meter with peak hold.Equipped with timer start mechanism with safety lock.Remote control terminal is mounted.

sections.title: VICTOR DD-VR77
sections.overview: A quick reverse cassette deck which is the third generation of the fine axis reverse system with Jewel lock.A rotary head type fine axis system is adopted for the quick reverse mechanism.This system is a three layer die-cast structure, in which the head is not fixed directly to the head holder, but a head clamp is interposed between the head holder to enable height adjustment of the head. This enables accurate positioning of the head relative to the tape, so that both forward and backward frequency characteristics and high-frequency characteristics, which tend to fluctuate, are always maintained at the same level.In addition to the mechanism that maintains the initial performance, high precision is achieved by a highly durable molybdenum (baking) rotating part, a 2-point holding structure that minimizes head tip shake, and a 10 micron order parts system.The tape is inverted by an infrared sensor embedded in the guide pin of the tape. When the light emitted from the light-emitting element hits the splicing tape between the magnetic tape and the reader tape, the light-receiving element detects the change in the light and instructs the tape to be inverted.The mechanism uses a silent mechanism with a 2-motor full logic + mechanical drive motor. The microcomputer detects the position of the cam linked to the mechanical drive motor to move all modes.A pulse servo DD motor is used as the drive motor.This motor uses a 160 pole, 80-pulse, all-round integration type FG servo system. The comb-shaped pulse detection coil prevents the influence of external noise and the unique multi-pride bridge drive circuit reduces the influence of temperature changes on rotational accuracy.A ceramic guard SA head is used for the recording / reproducing head.This head was developed based on the SA head. By adopting a non-magnetic ceramic guard, the magnetization of the entire head is extremely reduced, the friction coefficient of the head surface is also reduced, and the total modulation noise is also reduced.The amplifier section has a DC amplifier configuration.A tracking regulator circuit is built into the power supply to stabilize the operation of the amplifier.Equipped with a digital peak function that digitally displays the maximum recording level with a microcomputer.The peak hold time is approximately 2 seconds. The maximum value is stored in the microcomputer and can be called arbitrarily by pressing the CALL button.Equipped with a 4-digital counter function, you can use 4 functions such as direct reading of remaining time on tape, 4-digit electronic counter, 20-pole skip selection, and stopwatch.Equipped with a multi-editor function.When you press the Fade button from the RecoPause state, recording starts with an automatic fade in in about 5 seconds. When you press the Fade button to fade out, the level automatically attenuates to 0 in about 2.5 seconds and the RecoPause state is set.When you want to fade in or fade out on a gentle curve, an in / out time of approximately 10 seconds is separately set. It can be used depending on the situation.The edit control control buttons, you can repeat partial forward and reverse playback at half and constant speeds to get the correct tape position.Equipped with after-fade and after-cut functions.After fading can be done by pressing the FORCE or BACK edit control button while holding down the Fade button, and after cutting can be done by pressing the REC button instead of the Fade button.By taking advantage of this function, you can cut or erase unnecessary parts of recorded tapes.Equipped with a PLAY/STOP2-point memory function that enables block repeat playback.Functions such as auto-REC mute, music scan, index scan, blank search and blank skip are included.Equipped with 2-color FL peak meter with peak hold.Equipped with a Dolby B/C NR system as a noise reduction system.Equipped with timer start mechanism with safety lock.Remote control terminal is mounted.

sections.title: VICTOR DD-VR77MKII
sections.overview: Improved cassette deck of DD-VR77.OFC material is used for the head winding, the rear Dwyer, and the amplifier substrate, and transmission capability is improved by making the front surface of the signal path OFC.The power supply circuit uses a   tracking shunt control power supply that locks the ground potential to 0.This circuit constantly compares the positive and negative potentials, which vary according to complex music signals, and keeps the midpoint at 0. In addition, stability is improved by combining a constant voltage circuit controlled by a shunt regulator, and the source impedance is reduced to 1 / 100 compared to the conventional one.The reverse mechanism uses Victor's proprietary Fine Axis Quick Reverse System.The rotation method of the 3-layer die-cast structure maintains accurate azimuth on the outward and return paths, and long-term reliability is obtained by the unique mechanism and 10 micron order component configuration.In addition, a microcomputer control is adopted for tape reversal to realize high-speed reversal.The SA head of the ceramic guard is adopted for the recording and reproducing head.This head does not magnetize the guard part, and has less surface friction and uneven wear. Moreover, harmful modulation noise is reduced by smooth tape running.The transport mechanism uses a silent mechanism with 2 motors, full logic + mechanical drive motor.In this mechanism, detection is performed at the position of an interlocking cam, and the mechanical mode is switched by a microcomputer controlled mechanical drive motor.All signal paths are DC amplifier configuration and capacitors are eliminated as much as possible to achieve low distortion factor and high linearity.A pulse servo DD motor is used as the drive motor.This motor adopts FG servo which is resistant to disturbance and temperature change and multi-pride bridge drive circuit, and has obtained high reliability.Equipped with 4 digital counter function which can use 4 display functions.You can use a stopwatch function that can be used for both recording and playback, a Remain time function that displays the remaining amount of the tape in minutes and seconds, a 4-digit electronic counter that allows you to specify memory play and repeat sections, and a program number that allows you to select up to 20 songs by skipping over both A and B sides.Equipped with a digital peak function that shows the maximum value of the signal level by microcomputer.The hold time is approximately 2 seconds, and the maximum value stored in the microcomputer can be called by pressing the CALL button.Equipped with multi-editor function, auto fade in / out and after fade / cut can be performed.When you press the Fade button from the REC pause state, recording starts with an auto fade of approximately 5 seconds. Similarly, when you press the Fade button, the REC pause state is set approximately 2.5 seconds later. The fade time can be set to approximately 10 seconds each.Equipped with edit control function, half speed / double speed is possible in both forward and reverse directions, and accurate heading is possible.Uses all-gold-plated input / output terminals with little aging variation.

sections.overview: Twin Quick Reverse Cassette Deck with twin DD motor configuration.The basic performance of the deck has been improved in a well-balanced manner in order to suppress the deterioration of sound quality during editing. In particular, a highly reliable pulse servo direct drive motor has been adopted for the first time in the twin deck for the mechanism motor of the deck heart, which affects sound quality.The Pulse Servo DD motor has a brushless structure, low bearing loss, low motor rotation speed and high structural reliability, and can be used stably for a long period.By improving the performance against load fluctuation, stable running from the beginning to the end of tape winding is realized. As a double deck, speed change during tape dubbing is suppressed and sound stability is improved.In addition, a special material (polyacetal resin) is used for the mechanical chassis, and vibration is suppressed by greatly improving vibration control characteristics.Fine Axis and Quick Reverse are used for the head.In this system, the read / write head and erase head are rotated together to achieve uniform travel in both forward and reverse directions.Equipped with bias calibration function, bias can be adjusted according to tape characteristics.Equipped with power eject door and half shell stabilizer as vibration and resonance countermeasures.Continuous recording of two tapes is possible, and alternate continuous recording is possible by switching the tapes to REC standby.In addition, two tapes can be recorded simultaneously.Equipped with double-speed and constant-speed synchronized dubbing function.Active and MAX level digital peak indicators make it easy to set the optimum recording level.Equipped with Dolby B/C NR as a noise reduction system.In addition, Dolby HX PRO is installed in the twin.It is equipped with multi-music scan and you can skip 9 songs before and after.It is equipped with an electronic linear counter (A/B deck 4-digit).Uses a power cord with polarity display.Equipped with timer start mechanism and can be linked with separately sold timer.Equipped with an auto tape selector.Equipped with Compulink 1 / Synchro terminal.Wireless remote control is included.

sections.title: VICTOR KD-2
sections.overview: Namalok deck pursuing operability and sound quality.The super ANRS is installed as a noise reduction system.The Super ANRS is an addition of a function to raise the high-frequency clipping level at high-level to the ANRS, which has a high-frequency noise reduction function at low-level, and expands the recording / reproducing dynamic range.A newly developed coreless motor is used as the drive motor.This motor is lighter than the KD-3 and KD-4 motors and can operate at 6 v. sections.title: VICTOR KD-3
sections.overview: The Namalok Deck, a sister aircraft of the KD-4.ANRS (Automatic Noise Reduction System) is installed as a noise reduction system.With ANRS, you can reduce up to 10 dB only the noise components that are likely to be heard in home recording and playback, such as tape hiss. It is also compatible with other noise reduction systems, so you can enjoy the effect of playing back Dolby B tapes and vice versa.A newly developed coreless motor is used as the drive motor to reduce power consumption and enable 12-hour continuous recording with six single dry batteries.In addition, coreless motors have a low moment of inertia and high efficiency, so the response speed to startup is fast and stable operation can be expected.An SA (Sen-alloy) head is used for the recording / reproducing head.This head adopts a structure in which a coil is wound around a permalloy laminated core and Sendust alloy is bonded at high temperature to the tape sliding part at the tip. The tape sliding part is made of Sendust alloy, so it has high hardness and can be used for a long time. In addition, there are few chips and cracks, which tend to occur in ferrite, and characteristics are also stable.In addition, since permalloy is used for the coil core and sendust alloy for the tape sliding part, the gap accuracy can be as high as that of ferrite, and the frequency characteristics are extended to the high frequency range. In addition, there is little recording distortion at large signals, and the characteristics are stable against temperature changes during use.The preamplifier section is designed with low noise and low distortion rate. In particular, the equalizer circuit uses a 2-stage direct-coupled NF type with negative feedback up to DC to improve the transient characteristics.A constant voltage DC-DC converter is used so that a stable voltage can always be supplied to the amplifier even if the battery voltage drops.As a result, a wide dynamic range is obtained without losing linearity of the amplifier section.In addition to the left and right independent recording volumes, a left and right linked recording master volume is installed.Equipped with a 3-stage switching mechanism of MIC/DIN, -20dB/ATT/MIC and LINE, this allows the input signal to be directly connected to the line amplifier regardless of the microphone amplifier when recording from the player or tuner.The microphone is equipped with a two stage switching type microphone attenuator of 0 dB and -20dB.The mechanism part adopts a full auto-stop mechanism with reed switch, and the mechanism automatically releases when the tape finishes winding in any mode.This prevents the battery from being consumed and reduces the extra load on the tape and mechanism. In particular, the energy of the plunger operation when the mechanism is released is the power that is charged to the capacitor for the amplifier power supply during rotation. This reduces the battery consumption and prevents accidental release due to voltage reduction.Equipped with a large VU meter.Comes with a shoulder belt.There were carrying cases and dedicated racks sold separately.
