It can accurately indicate the peak level of a complex music signal by lighting at each level of -10dB, -5dB, 0 dB, + 3 dB and + 6 dB one after another. In addition, this meter is designed so that the peak point can be clearly confirmed by extending the lighting time by setting the peak hold time.JVC's proprietary SA (Sen-Alloy) head, which guards the front surface of the permalloy core with high-hardness Sen-Dust alloy, is used for the recording / reproducing head. This head has wear resistance comparable to that of ferrite heads while maintaining the excellent magnetic properties of permalloy.It is equipped with JVC's original ANRS (Automatic Noise Reduction System) as a noise reduction system and reduces high-frequency noise such as tape hiss by up to 10 dB. In addition, the KD-71SA achieves high reliability by adopting a large IC circuit and a contactless electronic switch.The recording amplifier has a linearity of + 48 dB from the reference level before the volume and + 18 dB at the final stage, and the playback amplifier has a linearity of + 20 dB or more.As a result, sound quality is obtained with high input power and low distortion.It is equipped with Mic/DIN and Line input selectors, and the line input is guided to the recording circuit without passing through the microphone amplifier by switching the switch, thus improving the SN ratio and distortion factor of the line input.The mechanism is a direct view type that makes it easy to see the tape from the front. In addition, the capstan belt is an ID (Independent Drive) type that is independent of other drive systems to prevent interference from the take-up wheel and minimize wow and flutter.Equipped with a timer standby mechanism, and by connecting an optional timer, it is possible to record absence and play back alarm clock.It uses a removable soft touch air dump type cassette door.A bias equalizer independent switching system is used for various types of tapes.Uses a full auto-stop mechanism that works in all driving modes.Equipped with a monitor volume.Running operation which can be switched from FF and REW to direct play is possible.

sections.title: VICTOR KD-75SA
sections.overview: This cassette deck was developed to pursue the limit of 1-motor component type cassette deck.It has acquired basic performance that clears DIN45500, the West German Hi-Fi standard.An SA (Sen-alloy) head is used for the recording / reproducing head.Sen-alloy has features such as high maximum magnetic flux density, low Barkhausen noise, high Curie point and stable temperature characteristics, and little degradation of material properties. However, when used in block cores, head loss such as eddy current loss is large, so high-frequency characteristics tend to deteriorate, and it is too rigid for permalloy laminate.The SA head has a composite structure in which a Sen-Alloy chip is bonded at high temperature to the tape sliding surface of a Permalloy laminated laminate core to realize a Sen-Alloy head, enabling excellent regeneration.Double-gap ferrite head is used for the erasing head.Equipped with a 5-point peak indicator, it is also possible to monitor pulse input signals with sharp rise.Equipped with a 5-step recording equalizer switch, you can correct high-frequency characteristics that are impossible with sensitivity adjustment.An ID mechanism using a FG servo DC motor is adopted for the mechanism part.ANRS and Super ANRS are installed as noise reduction systems.Equipped with dual ball cassette holder and kangaroo type air dump cassette door.The rack handle is optional and sold separately.

sections.title: VICTOR KD-85SA
sections.overview: Stereo cassette deck equipped with spectro-peak indicator and SA (Senalloy) head.Uses Sen-alloy head for the head.This head has a structure in which a Sendust chip is bonded at high temperature to the tape sliding surface of a core laminated with six layers of Permalloy. It has excellent characteristics by maintaining high gap accuracy while taking advantage of multi-layer with low overcurrent loss and good high-frequency characteristics.Equipped with a spectro-peak indicator which is a further development of the 5-point peak indicator.This peak indicator divides the frequency band into five sections and displays the peak components of each center frequency (100 Hz, 300 Hz, 1 kHz, 3 kHz, and 10 kHz) with five square LEDs for a total of 25. This makes it easy to check the presence or absence of recording input, frequency distribution, and peak level.In addition, by checking the spectrum peak indicator, it is possible to adjust the recording level with higher sound quality. For music with little undulation (chamber music, BGM, etc.), the 100 Hz to 3 kHz indicator is set to + 3 dB, the 10 kHz indicator is set to -5dB at the maximum, and the VU meter needle is set to + 2 dB as a guide. For music with loud impact (rock, jazz, etc.), the signal level indicated by the VU meter is set to + 3 dB at 3 kHz or less, and 0 dB at 10 kHz is set to light occasionally, and the average signal level indicated by the VU meter is set to 0 dB at the maximum.The head amplifier is a PNP-NPN2-stage direct connection DC feedback amplifier. In addition, the playback equalizer and microphone amplifier are independent from each other and the optimum circuit constant is selected to improve the characteristics.A carefully selected low-noise IC is used for the IC, and an operational amplifier with a large amplification factor is used for the headphone amplifier.In order to eliminate high-frequency noise such as tape hiss regardless of the performance of the head or amplifier, the ANRS automatic noise reduction device developed by JVC is mounted. In this circuit, the high-frequency range of the input signal is raised in advance during recording, and only the level of the tape hiss is relatively lowered by flattening it during playback.In addition, by further developing the principle of ANRS, it is equipped with a SuperANRS which greatly improves the lack of high-frequency linearity and narrow dynamic range. By adopting an IC circuit, sound quality and reliability are improved.The BIAS and EQ can be adjusted independently in three stages, allowing you to select a position that matches the characteristics of the tape.In addition, the BIAS and EQ selector switches are equipped with REC and EQ switches to more precisely correct the high-frequency characteristics, which are not sufficient with the BIAS and EQ selector switches alone. The frequency characteristics during recording can be changed in five steps from -3dB to + 3 dB in 1.5 dB steps at 10 kHz, making it possible to record more flatly.The mechanism section employs a 2-motor ID (Independent Drive) mechanism with dedicated motors for the capstan drive (FG servo motor) and reel drive (DC motor). This reduces mutual interference caused by delicate vibrations from the rotating system, simplifies the transmission mechanism, and improves stability and durability.Moreover, we have achieved a wow flutter of 0.05% by using high-precision parts such as 80 mm flywheels with accurate dynamic balance and capstan shafts with a roundness of 0.1 ?.Full logic control using IC and MSI (medium-scale integrated circuit) is adopted.The cassette door employs a combination of a gear and an oil dump. When it is opened, it can be opened slowly at constant speed, and when it is closed, it can be closed lightly by canceling this mechanism.In addition, there is a remaining tape light which can check the remaining tape amount.Uses a pure electronic auto-stop mechanism that detects electromotive force with a Hall element.Equipped with a continuous timer standby mechanism capable of recording the absence and playing the alarm clock.A memory counter, output volume, MIC/DIN and LINE input selector switch are provided.There was a special rack handle sold separately.

sections.title: VICTOR KD-95SA
sections.overview: A stereo cassette cassette deck developed by combining JVC's technologies.Equipped with a bias equalizer independent switching mechanism and tape sensitivity compensation function.By installing a 400 Hz oscillator and calibration volume in addition to the conventional tape selector function, it is possible to accurately correct the difference in sensitivity depending on the type of tape and draw out the performance of the tape.Equipped with a recording equalizer switch, the 5-step recording equalizer switch allows you to adjust the high-frequency characteristics that are impossible with sensitivity adjustment. This function enables you to change the frequency characteristics at 10 kHz in   3 dB steps or in 1.5 dB steps, depending on the characteristics of the tape, making it possible to record sound closer to the original sound.The mechanism uses a 2-motor ID (Independent Drive) mechanism. By making the drive belt of the capstan independent from other drive systems, interference from the take-up wheel is effectively cut off and tape travel is stabilized. The KD-95SA uses a dedicated FG servo DC-motor to drive the capstan, thereby achieving excellent wow and flutter and improving operability through electronic logic operation.The cassette half uses a dual-ball system with an ejection mechanism that firmly supports the tape.An SA (Sen-alloy) head is used for the recording / reproducing head.Sen-alloy has features such as high maximum magnetic flux density, low Barkhausen noise, high Curie point and stable temperature characteristics, and little degradation of material properties. However, when used in block cores, head loss such as eddy current loss is large, so high-frequency characteristics tend to deteriorate, and it is too rigid for permalloy laminate.The SA head has a composite structure in which a Sen-Alloy chip is bonded at high temperature to the tape sliding surface of a Permalloy laminated laminate core to realize a Sen-Alloy head, enabling excellent regeneration.ANRS and Super ANRS are installed as noise reduction systems.ANRS improves the signal-to-noise ratio by raising the high-frequency range of the input signal at the time of recording and returning it to the original level at the time of playback to make it flat, thereby relatively reducing only the tape-hiss level. Super ANRS is a further development of the principle of ANRS, and improves frequency characteristics and distortion factor in addition to noise reduction effect.High reliability has also been achieved through the use of IC circuits.Equipped with a high-speed response 5-point peak indicator using LED.Equipped with an ON/OFF switch.Equipped with a high precision large VU meter of mirror scale.Mix recording of microphone / DIN and line is possible.An air dump type cassette door is adopted.Equipped with photoelectric full auto-stop mechanism and memory counter.Equipped with timer standby mechanism, recording of absence and alarm clock playback are possible by combining with an optional timer.The rack handle is optional and sold separately.

sections.overview: Flat stereo cassette deck equipped with Super ANRS.It is equipped with ANRS and Super ANRS as VICTOR/JVC's original noise reduction system.ANRS improves the signal-to-noise ratio by raising the high-frequency range of the input signal at the time of recording and returning it to the original level at the time of playback to make it flat, thereby relatively reducing only the tape-hiss level. Super ANRS further develops the principle of ANRS by improving the frequency characteristics and distortion factor in addition to the noise reduction effect.An SA (Sen-alloy) head is used for the recording / reproducing head.Sen-alloy has features such as high maximum magnetic flux density, low Barkhausen noise, high Curie point and stable temperature characteristics, and little degradation of material properties. However, when used in block cores, head loss such as eddy current loss is large, so high-frequency characteristics tend to deteriorate, and it is too rigid for permalloy laminate.The SA head has a composite structure in which a Sen-Alloy chip is bonded at high temperature to the tape sliding surface of a Permalloy laminated laminate core to realize a Sen-Alloy head, enabling excellent regeneration.ID mechanism using FG servo DC motor is adopted for the mechanism.In this system, the drive belt of the capstan is made independent from other drive systems, so that interference from the take-up wheel and other devices is effectively cut off and tape travel is stabilized.Equipped with a 5-point peak indicator.There was a dust cover sold separately.

sections.title: VICTOR KD-950
sections.overview: Cassette deck with vertical type precision ID mechanism.It uses a vertical ID mechanism that allows you to see the tape running at a glance. It also uses JVC's original drive system in which the reel base drive and capstan drive belts are independent, reducing wow flutter.The cassette door is detachable so that it is easy to clean and demagnetize the head.As a noise reduction system, it is equipped with Victor's original ANRS (Automatic Noise Reduction System).ANRS does not work when recording at a high volume, but only when recording at a low volume by increasing the recording level at a constant rate. During playback, ANRS reverses the sound from the source to the original sound, thereby reducing noise components such as tape hiss by up to 10 dB.ANRS also supports Dolby B tapes.The 3-stage amplified CR type equalizer circuit realizes low distortion rate and wide bandwidth.It also uses an IC line amplifier with an input margin of + 20 dB.The mechanism is equipped with buttons for ease of use.Uses a high-precision VU meter conforming to the BTS standard.Equipped with line and microphone input selectors.The recording / reproducing head uses a Cronios head made of hard permalloy material.Equipped with a two step switching type tape selector with independent bias and equalizer.In addition, the Chrometape equalizer uses a new time constant to improve not only the SN ratio and linearity in the high range but also the linearity in the low range.Equipped with independent recording volumes for left and right, and also equipped with a dedicated playback volume.Equipped with photoelectric full auto-stop mechanism.Equipped with a beatcut switch for AM broadcast recording.Equipped with an AC outlet.

sections.title: VICTOR KD-970SA
sections.overview: Stereo cassette deck equipped with Senalloy head.An SA (Sen-alloy) head is used for the recording / reproducing head.Senalloy is a permalloy core with a high-hardness Sendust alloy bonded to the front surface of the permalloy core. It has abrasion resistance equivalent to ferrite, and has excellent magnetic properties of permalloy with less risk of cracks and chips.Equipped with an ANRS automatic noise reduction device integrated into an IC, various characteristics are improved by all-stage direct connection circuit and distortion correction circuit, and reliability is improved by using a non-contact electronic switch inside the recording / re-switching IC.The amplifier circuit is designed with an emphasis on linearity in all stages, including the 3-stage amplified CR type equalizer. The line amplifier uses an IC circuit that can withstand a large input of + 18 dB above the reference level.In addition, the amplifier circuit on a unit board has many variable points and is carefully adjusted one by one. The use of wires for communication between boards is avoided as much as possible, and printed resistance is used for the line board to reduce the number of soldering points. Reliability and uniform quality are emphasized.The line input can be adjusted by an independent volume without passing through a microphone amplifier.The VU meter is driven by an IC circuit with low output impedance, and by using a meter with good accuracy and damping characteristics, the indication at 20 kHz is within -2dB.Also, by switching the switch, it can be operated as a peak check type which can follow the pulse input.Equipped with a tape selector that can switch the bias and equalizer independently.The chrome-biased position has a recording sensitivity compensation circuit and is designed for use with Ferrichrome tapes. The chrome-equalizer has a time constant of 3180 ? S-70 ? S to improve linearity not only in the high-frequency range but also in the low-frequency range.The mechanism part is a slant mechanism that is tilted 30 degrees to make the tape easier to see, and a DC servo motor with a built-in frequency generator is used for the motor.In addition, the combination of a capstan, a large flywheel, and a neoprene rubber belt made by Schmerg of Germany, which boasts a high roundness of 0.1 micron, realizes low wow, flutter and stable driving.Equipped with photoelectric full auto-stop mechanism using CDs photocell.The cassette door adopts an air dump mechanism to realize soft opening and closing.Equipped with a timer recording mechanism combining a pause mechanism and electromagnetic solenoid.SK steel is used for the mechanism operation lever.The power supply circuit is stabilized by using a stabilized power source, and the transformer uses an Orient Core type.Equipped with a pure electronic tape run indicator that does not prevent tape running.Equipped with a memory counter.It has a read-only volume.Equipped with AC outlet.There was a special wood case sold separately.

sections.title: VICTOR KD-D55
sections.overview: A 3-head cassette deck equipped with Dolby C NR and 4-digital counter.Equipped with multi-functional 4-digital counter.This counter can display the remaining time of the tape in minutes and seconds. The remaining 6 minutes are displayed in minutes, and the remaining 5 minutes and 59 seconds are automatically switched to minutes and seconds. This circuit is structured to detect the rotation speed of the hub on the feeding side of the cassette half by magnet and Hall element. As the remaining amount of the tape decreases, the rotation speed of the hub is detected by pulse, and the remaining time is calculated by microcomputer. In addition, there is a switch for C46 large tape / C46 / C60/C90/C120 to reduce the fluctuation of the remaining time due to the difference in the hub size and tape thickness of the cassette half. The metal tape is different in tape thickness from other tapes, but it can be automatically handled by setting the tape select switch to the metal position.With this function, it can be used as a 4-digit electronic counter linked with 20-song jump selection, stopwatch and memory switch.Equipped with Dolby C NR and ANRS (Dolby B NR) as noise reduction systems.The Dolby C uses a 2-stage sliding band system, which changes the frequency of compression and expansion according to the signal level. The sliding band is effective in reducing bleeding and has excellent S / N ratio and transient characteristics when there is a signal.The noise reduction band is wider than in the past over the middle and high frequency band to obtain a high noise reduction effect. It also has a function to improve the high-frequency linearity to further improve the high-frequency characteristics.In addition, by adopting the newly developed Dolby C standard IC, operation is more stable and reliability is improved.An electronically controlled DC motor is used for the mechanism.A combination head using a meta-palm head is used for recording and reproducing heads.Also, a 2-gap ferrite head is used for the erasing head.Equipped with an output volume.Equipped with a rec mute mechanism.Equipped with full logic control.Equipped with a timer start mechanism.Equipped with a peak display type 7-point LED level indicator.Equipped with headphone port and microphone port.

sections.title: VICTOR KD-V4
sections.overview: A quick reverse deck with Dolby C and auto REC mute.The recording / reproducing head uses a meta-palm head, and the erasing head uses a 2-gap ferrite head.A rotary head type Fine Axis Reverse System is used for the reverse mechanism.This mechanism consists of a head mount base and a head holder for the rotating part. It uses a Jewel lock system to prevent distortion by pressing a ruby into the tip of the azimuth adjustment screw that receives the head holder. In addition, a stainless steel clamp plate is wound around the part of the head holder that is in contact with the ruby to improve abrasion resistance. The precision of all parts is on the order of 10 microns, and the precision of die-casting cannot be expected to exceed this precision.The rotating part uses a special fluorine resin coating with good sliding and excellent temperature characteristics. Unlike oil and grease, there is no change in the friction coefficient, and there is no play even in long-term use. In addition, the 2-point holding structure ensures smooth rotation while minimizing head tip fluctuation.In addition, the head is not fixed directly to the head holder, but is inserted into the head clamp and press fit into the head holder. This allows not only independent azimuth adjustment in both forward and reverse directions but also head height adjustment. The relative position between the head and tape can be accurately determined in both directions. As a result, the frequency characteristics in both forward and reverse directions and the high-frequency characteristics that tend to fluctuate are maintained in automatic operation.In addition, the azimuth adjustment screw and head height adjustment screw have adopted a screw pitch of 1 / 2 of the normal screw pitch, achieving high accuracy.Flipping the tape from A to B is done by an infrared sensor embedded in the guide pin of the tape.When the light emitted from the light-emitting element hits the splicing tape between the magnetic tape and the reader tape, the light-receiving element detects the change in the light and gives an inversion instruction. The microcomputer also makes judgment and reliable operation possible.The mechanism uses a 2-motor full logic and a silent mechanism with a mechanical drive motor. All modes are moved by detecting the position of the cam linked to the mechanical drive motor with a microcomputer.Equipped with auto REC mute.When this function is pressed in the REC mode, a silent space of approximately 4 to 5 seconds is automatically set to the REC standby mode. In addition, Victor's unique circuit design allows for no recording from the stop mode.As a noise reduction system, Dolby C NR is installed, and noise reduction effect and improvement of high frequency linearity are realized.The DD-V7 is also equipped with Dolby B NR and uses Dolby standard IC to improve operational stability.Equipped with a music scan function.Equipped with timer start mechanism, recording of absence and alarm clock playback are possible by combining with optional timer.Equipped with a running indicator that can check the running status of the tape.Equipped with 2-color LED peak meter.It has a headphone port and microphone port.

The solid block absorbs microvibration to further stabilize running performance, prevent modulation noise, and improve high-frequency characteristics.The mechanism uses a 2-motor full logic and a silent mechanism with a mechanical drive motor. sections.overview: This is a double reverse cassette deck that can record 3 hours of consecutive absence.Continuous recording between Deck I and Deck II is possible by microcomputer control.In addition, by combining a tuner and a timer, it is possible to record continuously for 3 hours.You can record two tapes two tapes simultaneously at one time.Dubbing and editing can be done easily with the dubbing start & stop button and the synchrorec mute.Equipped with a long-time non-stop easy listening function for full playback of the A/B side of Deck I and Deck II.You can play one deck while playing back the other deck.Equipped with Dolby B/C NR as a noise reduction system.The DD-VR9 is equipped with an MPX filter to prevent malfunctions.Equipped with auto REC mute.When this function is pressed in the REC mode, a silent space of approximately 4 to 5 seconds is automatically set to the REC standby mode. In addition, Victor's unique circuit design allows for no recording from the stop mode.Equipped with Music Scan (Deck I, 1 song before and after).Equipped with an auto tape select function.Equipped with a running indicator that shows the tape running mode at a glance.Equipped with a timer start mechanism.The reverse mechanism uses a rotary head type Fine Axis Reverse System with a 3-layer die-cast structure.This mechanism consists of a head mount base and a head holder for the rotating part. It uses a Jewel lock system to prevent distortion by pressing a ruby into the tip of the azimuth adjustment screw that receives the head holder. In addition, a stainless steel clamp plate is wound around the part of the head holder that is in contact with the ruby to improve abrasion resistance. The precision of all parts is on the order of 10 microns, and the die casting precision is ultra-precision processing.The rotating part has been given molybdenum (baking) processing with good sliding and excellent temperature characteristics. There is no change in friction coefficient, smooth rotation can be ensured, and there is no play even in long-term use. In addition, we pursue accuracy by adopting a 2-point holding structure to minimize head tip fluctuation, and adopting a screw pitch of 1 / 2 of the normal screw pitch for azimuth adjustment and head height adjustment.In addition, the head is not fixed directly to the head holder, but is inserted into the head clamp and press fit into the head holder. This allows not only independent azimuth adjustment in both forward and reverse directions but also head height adjustment. The relative position between the head and tape can be accurately determined in both directions. As a result, the frequency characteristics in both forward and reverse directions and the high-frequency characteristics that tend to fluctuate are maintained in automatic operation.Flipping the tape from A to B is done by an infrared sensor embedded in the guide pin of the tape.When the light emitted from the light-emitting device hits the splicing tape between the magnetic tape and the reader tape, the light-receiving device detects a change in the light and issues an inversion instruction, with a sound break of only 0.4 seconds.The mechanism uses a 2-motor full logic and a silent mechanism with a mechanical drive motor. All modes are moved by detecting the position of the cam linked to the mechanical drive motor with a microcomputer.

sections.title: VICTOR TD-R631
sections.overview: This quick-reverse cassette deck is designed to improve sound quality by refining basic technology and thoroughly reviewing sound quality.In order to improve the fluctuation of the frequency characteristics of the outward and return path caused by the slight gap between the tape and the head, the relative position of the head and the tape can be adjusted, and the rotation speed (axis) position of the head with respect to the tape is accurately maintained. By adopting a fine axis quick reverse mechanism, we have succeeded in always maintaining the same high-frequency characteristics.In addition, a 2-point holding structure is adopted to minimize head tip vibration during rotation. In addition, an aluminum die-cast base is adopted at the heart of the mechanism to cut unnecessary vibration. This greatly improves running performance and vibration resistance.The mechanism uses a twin belt drive system that uses two belts to provide a stable driving force.In addition, by adopting a silent mechanism consisting of a two motor full logic and three motors for driving the mechanism, the tape reversal is judged at high speed by a microcomputer, and smooth head reversal has been achieved.It is equipped with the Dolby HX PRO, which produces flat frequency characteristics by varying the bias amount according to the change of the music signal during recording. This reduces the level change and distortion of the high-frequency signal and realizes more natural sound.In addition, Dolby B/C NR is also installed, and by using it together, more faithful recording and playback become possible.A heavy solid base is used for the lower part of the body to reduce the vibration of the body.In addition, the cassette itself is equipped with half-shell stabilizers to prevent vibration, and a thick aluminum cassette lid is used for the entire surface to ensure thorough earthquake-resistant structure.The internal structure consists of a two box layout with separate amplifier and control sections, a remote bar with a short signal path to eliminate noise contamination, and a CD direct input terminal, all of which are designed with an emphasis on sound quality.The head is equipped with a fine amorphous head with excellent high-frequency characteristics, excellent magnetic balance, and long life. The head winding uses PC-OCC (single-crystal high-purity oxygen-free copper material) for pure transmission.It is equipped with functions such as 9-track jump selection, remaining time display, memory stop, blank skip, block repeat, timer start, bias adjustment, etc.Wireless remote control is included.In addition to the black model TD-R631, we also have the gun metallic finish TD-R631GM.

sections.overview: Stereo cassette deck with pure independent 3 heads.The head part is equipped with 3 independent heads, and by enabling the azimuth adjustment of the head independently for recording and playback, the stability of the stereo is made clearer and superior high frequency characteristics are realized.In addition, a separator is installed between the recording head and the reproducing head to eliminate not only the magnetic cross field generated between the heads but also the electrical cross field generated by the head wiring.The head material is amorphous, which has excellent high-frequency characteristics, and fine amorphous, which combines the characteristics of a wire alloy head, which has excellent magnetic characteristics and abrasion resistance. Moreover, signal loss is greatly reduced by using PC-OCC for the coil winding and lead wire of the head.An arc base is installed in the lower part of the chassis to eliminate the influence on the sound caused by vibration when the mechanism operates and resonance generated by external sound.This arc base is a high-density compression molded board made by compressing and pressing needle material of about 1 kg which is resistant to vibration and resonance. By mounting mechanism and transformer directly on it, each weight is increased equivalently, and operating vibration and external vibration are absorbed.It is equipped with a newly developed Airtight electric cassette door to cope with external sound pressure from the opening.It is equipped with an ultra-fine artificial leather Airtight liner that absorbs vibration without natural vibration in order to increase the adhesion with the body. It is opened and closed electrically to further increase the adhesion and block the sound from the speaker.In addition, the vibration of the cassette half itself is held by the half shell stabilizer, and acoustic modulation noise is greatly reduced to realize clearer sound.Closed-loop dual capstan system is adopted for the mechanism part.Capstan and pinch rollers are arranged on both sides of the independent head, and by keeping the tension from the beginning to the end of winding the tape constant, a stable head touch is always obtained. By combining this method with DD motor, sound loss such as stability of head touch, uneven rotation, noise reduction during rotation, etc. is suppressed.In addition, zinc die-cast is used for the mechanical base to increase the durability of the mechanism itself and greatly improve the verticality, parallelism, and vibration resistance of the capstan and pinch roller shaft. In addition, total modulation noise is reduced by using the vibration control capstan base and die-cast head base.As for tape running accuracy, a 3-phase 6-coil Ceralock servo direct drive motor realizes low wow flutter.The direct input reduces the influence of the circuit when recording sound from a source such as CD.To prevent noise from entering the signal path and degradation of the signal, a remote bar is used for the selector so that the front panel operation is directly controlled near the rear panel input terminal.As a noise reduction system, in addition to Dolby B/C NR, Dolby HX PRO is installed.The Dolby HX PRO is a system that controls the effective bias to be constant according to the fluctuation of the input signal during recording. It greatly improves the high-frequency dynamic range. It is effective even when played on devices that do not have the Dolby HX PRO.In order to solve this problem, the digital part of the operation system is concentrated in one place and separated from the analog part, and the whole analog part is shielded by BOX to prevent interference.The control system also has a function to turn off the display during recording and playback. Even when the display is off, it turns on during stop, fast forward, rewind, or pause, and turns off automatically when recording or playback starts.Equipped with an oscillator, level bias adjustment suitable for tape characteristics can be easily performed.The audio circuit is composed of   2 power supply DC amplifier without condenser as much as possible for both recording and reproduction.The recording amplifier uses a high-bias method (210 kHz) to prevent interference with the bias frequency from adversely affecting the music signal.Equipped with an auto monitor.During recording, the sound of the recorded tape is automatically switched, and during pause standby, the sound of the source is automatically switched.Equipped with an automatic music selection function.Uses an OFC power cord with polarity indication.Uses gold-plated output terminal.Equipped with timer start function, it is possible to combine with separately sold timer.Equipped with a headphone port with volume.Equipped with a memory button.Equipped with an auto tape selector.Wireless remote control is included.

sections.title: VICTOR TD-V711
sections.overview: A stereo cassette deck that pursues pure and direct design and uses PCOCC for the wire material.Three independent heads are used in the head section. The recording head is an SA head with high magnetic flux density and excellent magnetic saturation characteristics, and the reproducing head is an amorphous head with excellent high-frequency characteristics.In addition, PCOCC (single-crystal high-purity oxygen-free copper) is used for the coil winding and signal cable, and OFC (oxygen-free copper material) patterns are used for the substrate to pursue the reproduction of clear sound.The tape drive unit uses a closed-loop dual capstan system with direct drive by a high-precision motor. With capstan and pinch rollers on both sides of an independent head, the tension of the tape is kept constant from the beginning to the end of winding, ensuring constant head touch. Moreover, disturbance vibrations are hardly transmitted, and modulation noise is effectively reduced.A 3-phase 6-coil Ceralock servo DD motor is used as the drive motor.In order to prevent adverse effects on sound quality due to mutual interference of internal circuits, a 3-block independent structure is adopted in which the amplifier, control and power supply are separated.In this structure, the microcomputer display is concentrated in one place, and each circuit board is separated by the delicate amplifier and inner chassis. In addition, the power supply is separated by the center chassis in order to eliminate magnetic retention from power transformers.The power supply section employs a low-output impedance power supply with   tracking control using a large transformer and a large capacitor. In this circuit, the positive and negative sides work together so that the ground potential becomes 0, thereby maintaining the stability of the amplifier.We have also succeeded in reducing the output impedance to less than 1m   in the audio frequency band by combining a high-gain voltage comparison circuit and a constant-current control circuit with excellent high-frequency characteristics. In addition, the power supply is supplied to each circuit through a dedicated line to suppress current fluctuations, making it a highly stable power source resistant to complex changes in music signals, disturbance noise, and mutual interference.The audio circuit has a DC amplifier configuration with capacitors removed from the circuit as much as possible for both recording and playback systems to improve phase characteristics, distortion factor, and linearity. Moreover, each circuit has an independent structure arranged on separate substrates to shut out interference between the amplifiers. Furthermore, the L/R-symmetric configuration eliminates interference between channels to improve separation.In order to prevent unnecessary vibration, the inner chassis firmly reinforces the body from the inside. In addition, the lower part of the body is based on a high rigidity heavy solid base to pursue a low center of gravity and vibration control structure.In addition, the large insulation foot eliminates disturbance vibration, and the under chassis is copper plated to reduce magnetic strain.In order to input the music source at the shortest distance, it is equipped with a direct input terminal that can be directly connected to a CD player.The front panel power switch, input selector, and input level volume are designed to be switched and controlled near the rear panel input terminal via the remote bar, and the transmission route of each circuit block is designed to be shortest.Equipped with Dolby B/C NR as a noise reduction system.Equipped with the Dolby HX-PRO system, the bias amount during recording can be adjusted according to changes in the music signal to obtain flat frequency characteristics. In addition, the high-frequency characteristics, which had been limited for cassette tapes, have been greatly improved.It is equipped with a large FL display, which is equipped with a digital peak that can read the peak level numerically.It also has a memory stop mechanism that automatically stops when the memory button is pressed and displays the remaining amount of tape.Equipped with an auto monitor function, you can automatically switch and output the sound of the tape immediately after recording when recording, and the sound of the source when waiting in pause.Equipped with an automatic music selection function.Equipped with a bias adjustment function.Equipped with timer start mechanism (recording / playback).Equipped with a headphone port with volume.Equipped with a synchronous recording terminal, it can record in sync with a Victor CD player.Uses a thick power cord with polarity display and gold-plated input / output terminal.Wireless remote control is included.In addition to basic operation, this remote control is equipped with a tape / source monitor switching function for recording and a digital peak call function.

This head combines the characteristics of SA head with excellent magnetic characteristics and abrasion resistance with amorphous with excellent high-frequency characteristics to achieve well-balanced head characteristics.In addition, PC-OCC (single-crystal high-purity oxygen-free copper material) is used for the coil winding and lead wire of the head to greatly reduce signal loss.Closed-loop dual capstan system is adopted for the mechanism part.In this method, the tension of the tape is kept constant from the beginning to the end by arranging capstan and pinch roller on both sides of the independent head, and the head touch is always stabilized. Moreover, the tape is held between the two capstan, and disturbance vibration is hardly transmitted.In addition, aluminum die-cast is used for the mechanical base, greatly improving the verticality, parallelism, and vibration resistance of the capstan and pinch roller shafts. In addition, steel plates are stacked on the motor substrate to cope with mechanical vibration. This effectively reduces total modulation noise, including acoustic modulation noise caused by external vibration.A 3-phase 6-coil Ceralock servo direct drive motor is used as the drive motor.A DC servo amplifier is used in the amplifier section to improve the S/N ratio by 3 to 4 dB in the low range and 1 to 2 dB in the high range.In addition to the use of carefully selected high-quality parts, the OFC board with high transmission efficiency is used for the signal board.The bias frequency is set to 210 kHz (erase 105 kHz) to suppress the beat with the signal current.The signal path is designed to be as short as possible in order to prevent noise contamination and degradation of characteristics due to routing of the signal path.The front panel power switch, input selector and input level volume are connected via a remote bar so that they can be controlled close to the rear panel input terminal.The power supply section employs a low output impedance power supply with   tracking control using a large transformer with OFC winding and a large capacitor. In this circuit, the positive and negative sides work together so that the ground potential is always 0, thereby maintaining the stability of the amplifier. Moreover, by combining a high-gain voltage comparison circuit and a constant-current control circuit with excellent high-frequency characteristics, the output impedance is reduced to less than 1m   in the audio frequency band. This realizes a stabilized power supply resistant to complex disturbance noise.In addition, by supplying power to each circuit through a dedicated line, mutual interference between circuits is eliminated.It has a structure in which three blocks, power supply, recording / re-independent amplifier, and control are separated independently.In the TD-V721, the microcomputer and display parts are concentrated in one place, and each board is separated by an inner chassis. In addition, in order to eliminate magnetic retention from power transformers, etc., the recording and reproduction systems of the amplifier are separated and shielded by a special copper-plated chassis, thereby eliminating interference from the recording system.The FL display, which is a source of digital noise, can be turned off during recording and playback.Even when it is OFF, it lights up during stop, fast forward, rewind, or pause. It is automatically turned OFF when recording or playback starts. After recording, you can call up the maximum peak numerically using the Digital Peak Call button.In order to reduce acoustic modulation noise caused by external vibration, the front panel uses a high-density mold base with a specific gravity of approximately 1.5 times and a rigidity of approximately 1.7 times. Switches and mechanical buttons are also made of aluminum material. The lower body is equipped with a high-rigidity heavyweight solid base, which realizes low center of gravity and vibration control structure.Equipped with a half-shell stabilizer to prevent vibration of the cassette itself.Equipped with Dolby B/C NR as a noise reduction system.Equipped with Dolby HX-PRO.This circuit controls the effective bias to be constant according to the fluctuation of the input signal during recording. This circuit can greatly improve the high-frequency dynamic range. Since this system operates only during recording, recorded tapes can be played in high quality on other decks.The Dolby B/C NR and Dolby HX-PRO can be removed from the circuit by switching the switch.Equipped with a direct input terminal for direct connection to digital sources such as CDs.For direct input, direct recording is performed without passing through the balance volume, and even the bias and wrap (for NR OFF playback) are separated in TD-V721.Equipped with an auto monitor function, you can automatically switch and output the sound of the tape immediately after recording during recording, and the sound of the source during pause standby.Equipped with an automatic music selection function.Uses an OFC thick power cord with polarity indication.Uses gold-plated input / output terminals.Equipped with REC calibration function (level bias).Equipped with timer start mechanism, recording and playback are possible by connecting an optional timer.Equipped with a headphone port with volume.Wireless remote control is included.

sections.title: VICTOR TD-W511
sections.overview: Double Quick Reverse Deck with multi-functional remote control.If you place tapes in both Deck A and Deck B and set the reverse mode for playback, you can play back for a long time as if two tapes were connected together. For example, A side of Deck A ? B side ? A side of Deck B ? B side ? A side of Deck A.It is also possible to exchange the other tape during playback.It is equipped with a synchronous REC start function. When the playback side Deck A is music scanned or stopped, the recording side Deck B automatically makes a 4-second blank and waits in a pause state. Dubbing can also be restarted with one touch.Also, it is equipped with a synchronized dubbing stop function that stops Deck A at the same time when Deck B finishes recording.In addition, during dubbing in repeat mode, Deck A repeats playback until recording on both sides A and B of Deck B is completed.These functions are available at both double speed and constant speed.The drive train is equipped with a fine axis and quick reverse mechanism.The head, which affects sound quality, rotates together with the recording / reproducing / erasing head to enable independent adjustment of azimuth and cassette half guide height in both forward and reverse directions to improve sound quality.In addition, accurate, speedy and quiet reverse operation is realized by the tape reversal detection by microcomputer control and 2-motor full logic + mechanical drive exclusive motor.The amplifier circuit has a DC configuration that eliminates the capacitor from the circuit to achieve low distortion and high linearity.Equipped with Dolby B/C NR as noise reduction.It comes with a wireless remote control so that you can operate the deck from a distance.It is possible to switch between independent operation keys for Deck A and B, synchronized dubbing keys, digital counter display, digital peak display, etc.The display can display a mode indicator to indicate driving conditions, a 7-part LCD peak meter and a 4-digit digital tape counter.It is equipped with an independent operation button so that operations such as music scan and rewind can be performed independently on the other deck during recording and playback.Equipped with a music scan function that allows you to find the beginning of one song before and after.Equipped with a synchro terminal, it can be combined with a CD player equipped with a synchro terminal and one touch dubbing is possible.Equipped with auto REC mute.Timer start is possible by combining with a timer.Equipped with an auto tape selector that automatically detects the type of tape.

sections.title: VICTOR TD-WR99
sections.overview: Twin recording and quick reverse deck equipped with auto editor function.It is equipped with an auto editor function which is a further development of the multi editor function adopted in the DD-VR77.This feature allows you to automatically erase an unwanted part of a recorded tape by specifying a distance between two points : after fade-out ? fade-in, cutout ? cut-in, or a combination of fade and cut.When the electronic counter is in editor mode, the program buttons 0, 1, 5 0, 1, 5, and 6 function as a fade-out button, fade-in button, cutout button, and cut-in button, respectively. While playing the tape, when an unnecessary part comes in, stop and press the fade-out (or cutout) button. when the necessary part comes in, stop and press the fade-in (or cut-in) button. When the start button is pressed, the tape is automatically rewound to the point where the fade-out button was pressed, and the unnecessary part is erased.Fade-out and fade-in times are approximately 5 seconds (Deck I) with metal tape.Tape A/B side It is equipped with a random access program music selection mechanism that can play up to 15 songs each and 30 songs in total.This mechanism is equipped with an alternate designation function. It can be designated from A-plane to B-plane or from B-plane to A-plane. Each time the A/B plane is switched during playback, it does not return to the beginning of the tape. Once the track is in place, it is completely memorized and goes straight to that track in the order in which it was programmed.Dubbing from Deck I to Deck II can be done with one touch for both constant speed and double speed.You can also copy a random program by pressing the dubbing button after selecting a random program (Deck II).It has adopted twin quick reverse mechanism, and it is possible to record continuously for 3 hours (C-90x2 pieces), alternate continuous recording for Deck I / Deck II, simultaneous recording for Deck I / Deck II.The reverse mechanism adopts a fine-axis reverse system, and it is equipped with accurate azimuth adjustment for outward and return paths, reliable reverse operation by microcomputer, and durability to maintain initial performance for a long period.The amplifier circuit uses a DC amplifier configuration.Equipped with a Dolby B/C NR system as a noise reduction system.It is equipped with a newly developed electronic counter that can switch between 3 modes with one touch operation.In the counter mode, the display can be changed by operating the Deck I / Deck II changeover switch. The deck that is not displayed is also counted by the internal counter.In program mode, various information about the random access program is displayed. In addition, program index scanning is also possible by using the shift button together.In Editor mode, you can check the operation status of Auto Editor.Equipped with computer shift control function to change mechanical operation by shift button.You can auto-fade by pressing the Rec Mute button while pressing the Shift button. The fade-in / out time is approximately 5 seconds.When the shift button and FF button are pressed simultaneously, it becomes an index scan, and the head of the song can be played for about 10 seconds one after another. You can also set the playback time as desired if it is 9 seconds or less.If you press the Play button while holding down the Shift button, blank skipping occurs. If there is a blank for more than approximately 10 seconds during playback, the FF scan is used to fast-forward.If you press REW while holding down the Shift button, rewinding autoplay is performed, and playback starts from the beginning of the first song after rewinding.Pressing the Shift button and the Pause button simultaneously results in a blank search. If a 14-second blank is found in the FF state, the program returns to the end of the previous song, plays the 4-second blank, and stops.

sections.title: VICTOR TD-WR521
sections.overview: Twin Quick Reverse Cassette Deck capable of recording and playback on Deck 1 and Deck 2 respectively.You can record and play back both Deck 1 and Deck 2 for long-time recording and playback. You can record the same source simultaneously on both Deck 1 and 2, and you can record continuously for three hours (two 90-minute tapes), which is convenient for air checking.Equipped with a continuous play function.Equipped with synchronized dubbing function, dubbing from Deck 1 to Deck 2 can be done with one touch.Dubbing is equipped with two speeds, constant speed and double speed. During recording, when Deck 1 on the playback side is stopped, or when music is selected by Music Scan, Deck 2 is equipped with a synchronous recording mute function that automatically waits from recording mute state to pause state.In addition, Deck 1 can be stopped at the same time as Deck 2 finishes recording, and Deck 1 can continue playing until A/B side recording of Deck 2 finishes during dubbing in round-trip mode.The reverse mechanism uses a fine axis quick reverse mechanism.In this mechanism, the recording / reproducing head and the erasing head are rotated together to improve sound quality by enabling independent adjustment of the azimuth in both forward and reverse directions and the height of the cassette half guide.In addition, a quick reverse mechanism has been adopted for reverse operation on both decks 1 and 2, and an infrared sensor detects the reader tape at both ends of the cassette tape to realize quick reverse operation.2-motor full logic + mechanical drive motor realizes quiet reverse operation.A DC amplifier configuration is adopted in which a capacitor is removed from the circuit of the amplifier section.Equipped with Dolby B/C NR as a noise reduction system.Equipped with a large multi-mode display, you can check at a glance information such as a 2-color peak level meter that can check the recording level in 13 divisions from -20dB to + 10 dB, a 3-digit digital counter that can be switched to display the number of songs selected, and a mechanical mode that lets you know the.A tape counter is installed on each deck 1/2 and can be displayed independently.Both decks 1 and 2 are equipped with a Music Scan capable of tracking 9 songs in front and back.With this function, the microcomputer automatically detects the unrecorded part for more than 4-5 seconds, and you can skip up to 9 songs before and after the song you are listening to.Equipped with a sync terminal, synchronized recording is possible by connecting with VICTOR/JVC's CD player.Equipped with auto REC mute function.Equipped with timer start mechanism, timer playback and continuous 3 hour (90 minute 2 tapes) recording can be performed by connecting an optional timer.Equipped with an auto tape selector that automatically detects the type of tape.Power cord with polarity display is used.It comes with a wireless remote control that can operate Deck 1 and Deck 2 independently.This remote control is equipped with functions such as synchronized dubbing and reset of digital counter.

sections.title: VICTOR TD-WR531
sections.overview: Twin Quick Reverse Cassette Deck with Dolby HX-PRO.Both Deck 1 and Deck 2 have built-in recording capabilities for alternate continuous recording, 3-hour voice recording (two 90-minute tapes), simultaneous recording on Deck 1 and Deck 2, and 3-hour recording across two stations with a combination of program tuner and timer.It is also equipped with a continuous play function that automatically returns to the beginning when the second tape ends during playback.The Dolby HX-PRO, which greatly improves the high-frequency dynamic range, is installed independently on Deck 1 and Deck 2.As a noise reduction system, Dolby B/C NR is also installed.Equipped with synchronized dubbing function, dubbing from Deck 1 to Deck 2 can be done with one touch.Dubbing is available in two speeds, constant speed and double speed. In addition, it is equipped with a synchronous recording mute function. If you stop Deck 1 on the playback side during dubbing or select a song by Music Scan, Deck 2 automatically waits from Rec Mute to a pause state. When recording on Deck 2 ends, Deck 1 also stops. In round-trip mode, during dubbing, Deck 1 continues to play until you finish recording on both sides A and B of Deck 2.The reverse mechanism employs a fine axis quick reverse mechanism in which the read / write head and erase head rotate together.With this mechanism, the azimuth in both forward and reverse directions can be adjusted independently, and sound quality is pursued by equalizing driving performance.Both decks 1 and 2 are equipped with a quick reverse mechanism that detects the reader tape at both ends of the cassette tape by infrared sensors and quickly reverses the tape. In addition, accurate, quick and quiet reverse operation is realized by 2-motor full logic and mechanical drive motor.Both decks 1 and 2 have half-shell stabilizers to reduce the effect on sound quality caused by microvibration of the cassette half. In addition, vibration is eliminated from the cassette half locked only on one side, is locked firmly at both ends to eliminate vibration from the cassette half body.In addition, the accuracy of the rotary system such as the pinch roller and belt has been greatly improved, and by adopting a large flywheel with high stability, rotational unevenness has been reduced.A DC amplifier configuration is adopted in which the condenser is removed from the circuit of the amplifier section, and low distortion factor and high linearity are realized.Equipped with a synchro terminal, recording can be automatically started at the start of CD playback by connecting with VICTOR/JVC's CD player equipped with a synchro terminal.Equipped with multi-music multi-music scanning function of 9 songs before and after.This function allows the microcomputer to automatically detect the unrecorded portion (4-5 seconds or more) between songs, and to skip up to 9 songs before and after the current song and play them at the beginning.It is equipped with FL display, and deck 1 and 2 are equipped with independent 4-digit electronic counter.Equipped with a timer start mechanism, and by connecting an optional timer, it is possible to record absence and play an alarm clock.Equipped with an auto tape selector that automatically detects the type of tape.Equipped with automatic recording mute function.It comes with a wireless remote control that can also operate music scanning.

sections.title: VICTOR TD-4000SA
sections.overview: Stereo tape deck with X cutSA head.Newly developed X-cut SA (Senalloy) head is used for recording and reproducing heads.In the X-cut SA head, the Sendust tip of the tape sliding surface is processed into a special shape and bonded to the permalloy laminated core at high temperature, so that the waviness (contour) of the low-frequency characteristics is greatly improved without changing the high frequency characteristics.It is equipped with an automatic tension control system to improve the stability of tape running by keeping the back tension constant.In this circuit, the rotational speed of the supply reel is counted by a photoelectric pulse detection mechanism, and the drive current of the motor is controlled according to the remaining amount of the tape. As a result, the tension, which normally fluctuates nearly three times in the case of No. 7 reel, is almost equalized, and tape damage caused by excessive tension is prevented.In addition to a purely electronic IC logic control circuit, it also incorporates a motion sensor circuit that allows for an immediate transition from FF/REW to PLAY. By using the pulse detector of the automatic tension control, the circuit operates as soon as the supply reel stops, allowing for a transition to PLAY without a time lag.Equipped with a bias adjustment mechanism with a built-in 1 kHz oscillator.Equipped with a one touch reel adapter.Uses a 3-motor mechanism.Equipped with a continuous timer standby mechanism.

sections.title: VICTOR TD-5000SA
sections.overview: Stereo tape deck with SA head.SA (Sen-alloy) heads are used for recording and playback heads.This head is an extension of the SF head supplied for commercial use. By depositing a high-hardness Sendust alloy on the tape sliding surface of the permalloy core, it achieves both magnetic characteristics and abrasion resistance, which have been considered extremely difficult until now.A high linearity design has been adopted in which all circuits have sufficient allowance for the dynamic range of the tape, including a microphone amplifier circuit that can withstand a large input of + 55 dB of the reference input.The 38cm/sec recording equalizer uses an IEC curve with an excellent signal-to-noise ratio, which is widely used in European commercial equipment. The playback equalizer is a two step switching type between IEC and NAB.It is equipped with an automatic tension control system to improve the stability of tape running by keeping the back tension constant.In this circuit, the rotational speed of the supply reel is counted by a photoelectric pulse detection mechanism, and the drive current of the motor is controlled according to the remaining amount of the tape. As a result, the tension, which normally fluctuates nearly three times in the case of No. 7 reel, is almost equalized, and tape damage caused by excessive tension is prevented.In addition to a purely electronic IC logic control circuit, it also incorporates a motion sensor circuit that allows for an immediate transition from FF/REW to PLAY. By using the pulse detector of the automatic tension control, the circuit operates as soon as the supply reel stops, allowing for a transition to PLAY without a time lag.A one way dump tension arm is used for the supply side, and a double action tension arm is used for the take-up side. Both tension arms have locks for easy tape mounting and editing.Upper and lower double support capstan is adopted to improve stability.It is equipped with a normal / variable switching type bias adjustment system with a built-in reference oscillator.Mic/Line addition type OP amplifier / mixer circuit without level interference is adopted.Equipped with a VU meter with a wide-scale mirror of -30dB to + 10 db.Equipped with a new No. 10 reel adapter that does not require height correction.

sections.title: VICTOR 4TD-405
sections.overview: 4ch/2ch compatible tape deck developed based on 2 ch tape deck TD-450.The mechanism is equipped with a center floating 4-pole, 4-pole, Kinden-Ser advanced phase induction motor with less vibration and noise.Equipped with a mechanical auto-stop mechanism, the operation lever automatically returns to the stop when the tape is finished winding, and stops at the same time as releasing the mechanism, thereby suppressing deformation of the pinch roller.An EL drive system has been adopted, and the pinch roller is moved below the panel surface when stopped, making it easy to attach the tape.It uses a 4-ch head that combines four channels into one. This head can be divided into 1-3 ch and 2-4 ch and can be used as a conventional 2-ch stereo.The head is designed with less contour effects in order to improve the low-frequency characteristics, and with a uniform narrow gap finish, the high-frequency characteristics and the quality per channel are improved and the phase shift is reduced.In the equalizer amplifier section, the 3-stage direct-coupled E-E feedback circuit is compactly integrated and replaced with an IC.For volume adjustment, there is a master volume as well as a volume that can be adjusted independently for each channel.In order to support not only normal tapes but also SH tapes, it is equipped with a tape selector which can switch the equalizer.It is equipped with 4 ch microphone input and 4 ch headphone terminal which is separated into front and rear.A tape cleaner is mounted next to the head. The running tape passes through this cleaner first and touches the head to prevent the characteristics from being degraded by dust and dirt on the tape.It is equipped with a reclining stand so that it can be used in horizontal, vertical and inclined styles.In addition, roller casters are also provided for storing in narrow places such as the deck storage part of the separate stereo.

sections.title: VICTOR MTR-10M
sections.overview: A compatible tape deck capable of both 4-channel playback and 2-channel recording and playback.The 4-channel head system is an inline type and can be used for overseas 4-channel music tapes. The tape head used has excellent characteristics, and the shield system between tracks is designed in a special shape to minimize crosstalk by more than 50 dB and obtain good separation.The equalizer section of the preamp uses a direct 3-stage NF type.It can be connected to a general amplifier and also has a built-in Treble/Bass control amplifier. sections.title: VICTOR HM-200
sections.overview: The world's first binaural headphone microphone that allows you to monitor binaural recording.The human ear has an accurate sense of direction and distance to sound. This is done by both ears. This effect is called binaural and is used to mean that both ears listen to sound. The sound that reaches the human ear causes diffraction and resonance due to the presence of the head and pinna, and the sound pressure, phase (time difference), and frequency characteristics are different on the left and right sides. By this, humans recognize the difference that changes depending on the angle of incidence from experience and judge the direction up and down, left and right, and forward and backward directions. However, this kind of directional orientation information cannot be recorded with a one focus microphone or a multi-microphone.In order to obtain playback sound in the same state as when actually heard by the ear, we devised a dummy head recording method that records and plays back sound at the same position as the human ear.The HM-200 has evolved from the use of a dummy head to incorporate a microphone into the headphone itself for easy binaural recording. In addition, the microphone is embedded into the headphone shaped like a human ear, making it possible to record with a more human and natural listening feeling than with a dummy head.Comes with a dummy head for binaural recording without putting it on your head.

sections.title: VICTOR A-X55
sections.overview: This pre-main amplifier pursues linear transmission and mounting performance.The configuration is almost the same as the high-end model A-X77, and the parts change and output are different.It uses a simple 2-amp configuration, high-gain MC / MM/DC servo equalizer, and dynamic super A power amplifier for A-class operation.The power amplifier section uses Super A, which eliminates switching distortion, crossover distortion, TIM distortion, etc. while maintaining high efficiency and high power comparable to B-class amplifiers. The addition of pure NFB, which does not damage the bare characteristics of transistors, extends the effect of NFB to the ultra-high frequency range and flattens the characteristics of the audible band.The A-X55 adds two additional technologies to improve speaker dynamics : an isolated drive circuit and a wave collection processor.The isolated drive circuit is inserted between the pre-drive stage and the power stage. This circuit eliminates dynamic interference between the pre-drive stage and the power stage or the speaker, and is a type of impedance conversion circuit that takes advantage of FET characteristics.In a general power amplifier, the power stage is driven by a constant current with a pre-drive stage having a high output impedance. However, in this method, the influence of the operation fluctuation of the power stage due to the music signal and the influence of the speaker load is fed back to the pre-drive stage and large interference distortion is generated. In the power stage, the high output impedance of the pre-drive stage and the signal source impedance of the phase correction capacitor have frequency characteristics. The lower the frequency, the higher the impedance.The impedance conversion by the isolated drive circuit can suppress these interference distortion very effectively. The pre-drive stage is free from the influence of the power stage and the speaker load, and stable operation with less distortion is possible. The power stage is driven at a constant voltage with a constant low impedance, so the output impedance is low and flat over a wide range. This improves the damping factor characteristics and enhances the driving force of the speakers.In addition, most of the back electromotive force of the speaker is absorbed by the power stage, which prevents IIM (Interface Inter Modulation) distortion.The Wave Collection Processor is a compensation circuit that attempts to return the power stage signal voltage waveform corrected by the Super A Bias Circuit to a complete original waveform by applying waveform manipulation with current. It performs extremely stable and wide-band distortion reduction operation without any operational disadvantages.Together with the isolated drive circuit and newly developed Super A IC with high-speed operation and high linearity, the distortion reduction effect before applying NFB is improved by 20 to 40 dB compared to the conventional Super A. In particular, the characteristics of the important fundamental frequency band below 1 kHz are improved. This wave collection processor ensures that the linearity of the power stage is sufficient for use as a non-feedback amplifier.The newly developed dynamic Super A dedicated IC has been adopted to improve the high-speed response and linearity while inheriting the conventional Super A operation.The distortion factor characteristics of the equalizer amplifier section when using MC has been greatly improved.This is due to the synergistic effect of the active broad added in the first stage and the pure NFB similar to the power amplifier section. sections.title: VICTOR A-X77
sections.overview: This pre-main amplifier pursues linear transmission and mounting performance.It uses a simple 2-amp configuration, high-gain MC / MM/DC servo equalizer, and dynamic super A power amplifier for A-class operation.The power amplifier section uses Super A, which eliminates switching distortion, crossover distortion, TIM distortion, etc. while maintaining high efficiency and high power comparable to B-class amplifiers. The addition of pure NFB, which does not damage the bare characteristics of transistors, extends the effect of NFB to the ultra-high frequency range and flattens the characteristics of the audible band.The A-X77 adds two additional technologies to improve speaker dynamics : an isolated drive circuit and a wave collection processor.The isolated drive circuit is inserted between the pre-drive stage and the power stage. This circuit eliminates dynamic interference between the pre-drive stage and the power stage or the speaker, and is a type of impedance conversion circuit that takes advantage of FET characteristics.In a general power amplifier, the power stage is driven by a constant current with a pre-drive stage having a high output impedance. However, in this method, the influence of the operation fluctuation of the power stage due to the music signal and the influence of the speaker load is fed back to the pre-drive stage and large interference distortion is generated. In the power stage, the high output impedance of the pre-drive stage and the signal source impedance of the phase correction capacitor have frequency characteristics. The lower the frequency, the higher the impedance.The impedance conversion by the isolated drive circuit can suppress these interference distortion very effectively. The pre-drive stage is free from the influence of the power stage and the speaker load, and stable operation with less distortion is possible. The power stage is driven at a constant voltage with a constant low impedance, so the output impedance is low and flat over a wide range. This improves the damping factor characteristics and enhances the driving force of the speakers.In addition, most of the back electromotive force of the speaker is absorbed by the power stage, which prevents IIM (Interface Inter Modulation) distortion.The Wave Collection Processor is a compensation circuit that attempts to return the power stage signal voltage waveform corrected by the Super A Bias Circuit to a complete original waveform by applying waveform manipulation with current. It performs extremely stable and wide-band distortion reduction operation without any operational disadvantages.Together with the isolated drive circuit and newly developed Super A IC with high-speed operation and high linearity, the distortion reduction effect before applying NFB is improved by 20 to 40 dB compared to the conventional Super A. In particular, the characteristics of the important fundamental frequency band below 1 kHz are improved. This wave collection processor ensures that the linearity of the power stage is sufficient for use as a non-feedback amplifier.The newly developed dynamic Super A dedicated IC has been adopted to improve the high-speed response and linearity while inheriting the conventional Super A operation.The distortion factor characteristics of the equalizer amplifier section when using MC has been greatly improved.This is due to the synergistic effect of the active broad added in the first stage and the pure NFB similar to the power amplifier section. This is achieved by increasing the open-loop gain and applying the necessary and sufficient negative feedback from low to high frequencies.In addition to the general tandem constant voltage circuit, a shunt type constant voltage circuit is also used for the power supply circuit. While the power supply voltage is locked double, the current in the power supply line is kept constant regardless of the signal level to eliminate interference distortion between the signal path and the power supply path. This interference distortion is caused by a potential difference in the ground line. sections.title: VICTOR A-X110+
sections.overview: Pre-main amplifier using dynamic super A method.The A-X110 + uses a dynamic Super A, which combines Victor's original Super A circuit with a newly developed Gm driver.The Gm Driver is an application of an amplifier circuit based on the Gm processor, a voltage-current conversion amplifier module developed for the P-L10 type pre-amplifier of the Laboratory Series. It is a highly reliable design with all circuits integrated into hybrid ICs. The Gm Driver is a unique circuit method that converts signal voltage into current, amplifies it, and drives the power amplifier stage with low impedance when it returns to voltage. This improves the speaker drive power of the power stage, suppresses adverse effects such as back electromotive force, and reduces nonlinear distortion of the power transistor.Stable dynamic characteristics are realized by this Gm driver and Super A circuit which always operates the power stage.The power supply section is equipped with a large 4.8 kg power transformer that reduces the winding resistance by more than 30% compared to conventional same class amplifiers.We have also adopted a newly developed wide-band low-impedance capacitor for the electrolytic capacitor.Elements such as high-speed diodes and low-noise zener diodes are used.A band pass filter of 20 Hz to 15 kHz to 3 dB is inserted into the Aux2 jack to cut out unwanted signals that may be contained in keyboards, rhythm boxes and microcomputer devices.The signal circuit consists of two simple amplifiers consisting only of a dynamic super A power amplifier and an ICL high-gain equalizer with a low-noise EL-FET input.The equalizer circuit can also be connected directly to an MC cartridge.A subsonic filter is installed in the equalizer circuit to cut out ultra-low frequency noise when playing back records.Equipped with a two system tape circuit and a recording-out selector.In addition to silver, there was also a black color variation model.

sections.overview: Integrated amplifier with the concept of non-interference energy amplification from input to output.The signal flow is thoroughly verified, and construction according to the energy level of the music signal and the energy level of the interference signal is pursued, and independent 3-block construction is adopted.This structure clearly separates the preamplifier section, control section and power amplifier section, and the signal length inside the chassis is reduced to 1/3 compared with the conventional Victor model.In addition, the volume and function by remote control are used to achieve a thorough non-interference design.In order to eliminate the effect of the chassis on sound quality, high carbon cast iron, which is the most acoustically excellent cast iron, is used in the chassis base to achieve excellent vibration damping characteristics.Parts that are sources of vibration such as power transformers and heat sinks are firmly fixed with through bolts.We pay attention to the fact that the transistor is a current amplifier, and all necessary voltage amplification is done in the preamplifier section.As a result, the preamp itself acts as a volume, so more the volume is reduced, the less residual noise.It consists of a power amplifier with a "voltage amplification factor of 0 dB" that feeds back the current generated by the difference between the input signal and the output signal to the predriver.Victor's original Super A has been improved to Advanced Super A.The output device is narrowed down to 3 para PP, which can be called single PP, and 200W/3   is realized.Equipped with a phono amplifier.It is equipped with a high gain equalizer of 1 kHz and 60 dB. Various cartridges can be connected directly, from MC cartridge with 0.2 mV sensitivity to MM cartridge with 5 mV sensitivity.In addition, when any input other than the phono input is selected, the power supply of the phono circuit is automatically cut off, and we are particular about improving the sound quality of the line system such as CD.

sections.overview: This pre-main amplifier was developed based on the concept and technology of cleanly extracting music signals from various disturbance elements and transmitting them to speakers.The P.S. R.
