sections.title: VICTOR AX-1100
sections.overview: This pre-main amplifier is not only high power, low distortion rate, and high S/N, but also supports digital audio in a higher dimension by reexamining the interface between the amplifier and peripheral devices and adopting 4-block construction with less mutual interference.The internal section is divided into four sections : a preamplifier section, a control section, a power amplifier section, and a power supply section. Each section functions without being affected by others, and a 4-block construction is adopted to ensure smooth signal transfer.The P.S. R. (Pure Signal Receiving) circuit is installed as a digital technology, and a differential amplifier is arranged on two digital source input systems to cancel common-mode noise flowing from the ground line.In addition, by connecting the ground terminal of the input device with a ground wire, no noise current other than the input signal flows through the signal cable, and the circuit configuration enables more accurate and pure signal delivery.The source of vibration, such as the power supply and output stage heat sink, is mounted on a 1.6 mm thick damping steel plate.In addition, H. S. (High Solidity) construction with elaborate vibration countermeasures such as high rigidity of the whole chassis and addition of double structure bottom plate and damping plate eliminates extraneous vibration.In order to suppress the rectification noise radiated from the connection line between the power transformer and the diode, the rectifier circuit is connected directly to the transformer and is made into one block. In addition, electromagnetic interference to the signal circuit is completely eliminated by shielding the entire power supply in an independent box.In addition, the power transformer's special balanced winding structure reduces the normal mode noise from the AC power line over a wide band.In addition, it is a Clean & Dynamic (C & D) power supply with low impedance due to large-capacity capacitors and copper plate earth plates.The power stage is a parallel P. P. configuration, and it is an H. D. (high drivability) Gm circuit that adopts Gm Driver II that can maintain the required drive voltage regardless of load impedance. The structure is strong against low impedance loads.All circuits use Victor's original voltage-to-current feedback amplified Gm circuits.In particular, the Gm volume and Gm selector are very powerful. By changing the amplification of the amplifier itself, the change in sound quality depending on the volume position is minimized.Equipped with a DC servo type Gm equalizer.It is a direct circuit without a coupling capacitor, and MC cartridge can also be connected directly.A total of eight gold-plated terminals including a digital source compatible Route 3 are installed.Equipped with a 6-position full REC selector.Equipped with a line direct switch that guides all inputs to the power amplifier along the shortest path.

sections.title: VICTOR AX-S5
sections.overview: This is an integrated amplifier that eliminates ground line noise and pursues higher quality playback.In conventional signal transmission, the noise component on the ground line is amplified as it is, but by installing a differential amplification transmission circuit, the differential signal transmission line is set separately from the ground line, and pure reproduction without noise is realized.The variable bias type output circuit Super A originally developed by JVC is improved, and the Advanced Super A system is installed, which eliminates crossover distortion, switching distortion, and nonlinear distortion of the output transistor.We consider the power supply circuit as part of the signal path and focus on the mechanism of the transformer. We have adopted a core bobbin transformer that eliminates the internal space of the transformer.As a result, we succeeded in eliminating the air gap that vibrates and adversely affects the signal system.In the power amplifier section, all stages from input to output are separated into left and right, and mutual interference is suppressed.It is equipped with a CD differential input terminal that eliminates digital noise and power supply noise flowing in the cable between the CD player and amplifier.This eliminates noise back to the output line of the CD player.Equipped with a phono equalizer amplifier for MM/MC.All source input / output terminals are gold-plated in order to suppress sound quality degradation caused by contacts, and speaker terminals compatible with banana plug for linear connection of speaker cord are used.

sections.title: VICTOR AX-S9
sections.overview: Integrated amplifier with all-stage differential signal transmission.We focus on differential signal transmission, which can cancel noise components generated in digital devices and amplifiers and amplify only music signals, and we have adopted this method in all stages.The ground line, through which signal current and noise current used to flow in common, is separated into a dedicated music signal line and a dedicated noise line, and the music signal line is independent from the input terminal to the power amplifier section, including the volume control. This makes it possible to transmit music signals with higher purity.In addition, the high-power transistor is a parallel push-pull type with four single-channel high-power transistors, while reducing the rated output to give priority to quality.The Advanced Super A is a further evolution of Victor's original Super A to bring out the characteristics of a transistor, which is a current amplifying element.The effect of secondary distortion of the power supply current is suppressed.In order to eliminate vibration of the transformer itself, we have developed and adopted a transformer base made of high carbon cast iron with high damping capacity.The transformer base not only functions as a base for the transformer, but also penetrates through the base plate and serves as a foot for the amplifier body.In addition, the transformer itself is polished as the path of the music signal, and a core bobbin transformer is adopted. There is no gap in the coil and vibration inside the transformer is eliminated.In order to solve the problem at once, we have adopted the all-input relay switching source selector in order to solve the problem of the source selector, which has caused the complexity of signal lines and the deterioration of sound quality due to contact points due to the concentration of various input signals.The relay uses a gold-clad silver-palladium contact and has a completely sealed structure, eliminating the deterioration of sound quality and aging due to contact.Power amplifier section with L/R separation configuration up to the power amplifier board to completely eliminate mutual interference.Equipped with a CD differential input terminal (with a selector button) that eliminates noise upstream from the CD player.Equipped with a phono equalizer amplifier for MM/MC.Equipped with speaker terminal for gold plated banana plug.

sections.title: VICTOR AX-Z911
sections.overview: Pre-main amplifier equipped with digital pure A circuit.In addition to the built-in D/A converter, we focus on the pure A-class operation of the amplifier and realize the pure A-class operation in order to review the fundamental quality so that it can be applied to digital sources.Pure A-class operation does not perform signal synthesis like B-class operation, so switching distortion and crossover distortion do not occur in principle. However, pure A-class operation requires a huge power supply because the output current required for full-power operation is always kept constant. Moreover, heat generation is high and efficiency is low.In order to solve these problems, the AX-Z911 is equipped with a digital pure A signal prediction circuit that quickly judges the magnitude of the input digital signal and supplies the corresponding power supply voltage to the amplifier only when necessary. This enables high-efficiency pure A-class operation without wasting power.The D/A converter section uses a digital filter with 4 x oversampling.In order to cut off the audio section from the digital section and power supply section, which are sources of noise, the digital signal processing section is shielded by a plate, and the board is separated from the analog signal processing section by a large heat sink.In addition, the top plate of 3.2 mm thickness and the bottom plate of 1.6 mm thickness are adopted, and adverse effects caused by interference from structure and material are suppressed.The transmission lines in the circuit are completely short and the contact points are reduced. Relay and electronic switch are used to suppress the routing of the input signal, and only one speaker terminal is used.In addition, if the DAC direct switch is turned on until the digital signal is just before the D/A converter, the wiring length becomes only 0.5m and the number of contacts becomes only one. We are trying to simplify the circuit as much as possible.When an analog source is played back, the digital clock operation is automatically stopped to suppress the influence of digital noise.Uses a 2-point support volume with an excellent S / N ratio.Built-in MC head amplifier.A remote control is included.

sections.title: VICTOR AX-Z921
sections.overview: This pre-main amplifier is equipped with a D/A converter using Victor's original K2 interface.In order to realize higher quality D/A conversion, it is equipped with K2 interface for the first time as an amplifier.The K2 interface has a structure that detects only code information from input digital signal waveforms by high-speed switching operation of semiconductors, and creates new digital waveforms in separate blocks based on the information.By changing waveform transmission by electric signal to code transmission once, the out of code component contained before passing through K2 interface is electrically cut.As for the timing of the high-speed switch that detects code information, two PLL circuits are installed to generate a stable clock signal based on the input signal waveform and use it as the master clock.First, the 1 stPLL circuit follows the fluctuation of the input digital signal to capture the timing, and then the 2 ndPLL circuit creates a synchronous signal based on this information and oscillates as a master clock.The D/A converter section, which converts digital signals into analog signals, is equipped with a digital filter with 8 times oversampling, and the D/A converter is equipped with a full-time 18-bit left / right independent combination 4 dac, which separates low-order bits and adds current to high-order bits.It can be operated with 18 bits at all times to pursue high resolution at a minute level.The power amplifier section is equipped with a double pure A type II circuit, which is an advanced version of A class and high power.Just before the input digital signal enters the D/A converter, the magnitude of the signal is predicted and the idle current is set to the optimum level that matches the input signal.In addition, analog input signals are controlled by an optical bias circuit so that the relationship between output current and operating current is always optimized, thereby achieving high efficiency while suppressing wasteful current consumption.A large transformer is used for the power supply, balanced winding and low impedance structure for higher sound quality, and mounted on a high-rigidity plate with dimple structure for superior damping characteristics to eliminate adverse effects of vibration.To prevent interference between the audio and digital sections, the digital signal processing section is shielded by a plate, and the entire board is separated from the analog signal processing section by a large heat sink.In order to simplify the signal path, we have adopted an independent two relay system for switching speakers.In addition, the analog signal path after the DAC greatly reduces the number of contacts and wiring length. When the DAC direct switch is turned on, the wiring length becomes only 0.5m.A remote control is included.In order to support bi-wiring, two types of speaker terminals are installed.It is equipped with automatic sampling frequency selection and MC/MM phono equalizer amplifier.

sections.overview: This is a pre-main amplifier with not only general characteristics but also a design concept that emphasizes transient response.All main circuits are designed with an emphasis on transient response to suppress electrical shock by applying a large amount of negative feedback from ultra-high frequency to DC.As a result, stable operation is realized even for complex musical waveforms in the real world and sharp pulse input such as noise.The equalizer uses carefully selected low-noise PNP silicon transistors for the first and second stages. The final stage uses high-voltage, low-noise NPN silicon transistors that can withstand up to 250 V. A hybrid C-E feedback 3-stage direct coupling type is used for the final stage. High voltage as high as 85 V is applied.The power section uses a direct-coupled circuit that does not use a coupling capacitor between the amplifiers.As a result, a large amount of negative feedback can be applied over a wide range, there is no impedance swell from low to high range, and the damping factor is flat over the whole range.In addition, stable operation with less low-frequency distortion due to 2-power supply system operation is realized.7-element SEA is used for tone control.The SEA system does not change the low and high ranges as in general tone control, but divides the audible band into seven sections, each of which can be changed by   12 dB. sections.title: VICTOR JA-S41DC
sections.overview: A pre-main amplifier based on JA-S41 with a fully DC power amplifier.By making the power amplifier fully DC, the low-frequency time constant is eliminated from the signal circuit, and the frequency characteristics are extended. Moreover, the effect of the phase shift does not reach the audible frequency band.The JA-S41DC uses two independent high-performance A and B power supplies as the base and a dual FET in the first stage circuit of the power amplifier in order to stabilize the midpoint potential which is an essential condition of a DC amplifier. This dual FET contains two low-noise FETs with uniform characteristics in a single package in order to put them under exactly the same condition against heat, and can reduce drift due to temperature change.In addition, the transistor differential circuit and double differential common-mode feedback circuit of the next stage are constructed, and all the power supplies for the class A amplifier stage are made constant voltage to achieve high stability and low noise.In order to eliminate the dynamic interference distortion that occurs when the power supply voltage of the class A amplifier stage changes due to the dynamic fluctuation of tone level, the power supply circuit for the class A amplifier stage and that for the class B amplifier stage circuits for the class A amplifier stage and for the class B amplifier stage are independent.The equalizer circuit uses a 3-stage ICL cascode directly connected to the DC circuit. The first stage uses a differential circuit using an FET with an excellent noise figure. The FET is a voltage amplifier with a high input impedance, so the output voltage of the cartridge is directly amplified. Moreover, since the input impedance is high, even if the signal source impedance changes with frequency, the operation of the circuit is not affected.A 4-channel twin volume is used to increase the sound S/N at low volume levels. By using this volume, two volumes can be placed behind the equalizer circuit and behind the tone control circuit to reduce the noise generated by the preamplifier.The Tape2 terminal is mounted on the front panel.By adopting a design with as few shield wires as possible, the high-frequency reproduction capability is enhanced.A 3-stage relay protection circuit protects the speakers and power transistor in the event of an accident while preventing shock noise and overloads during power on / off.It is possible to remove the front panel on the front panel and install an optional handle.

sections.title: VICTOR JA-S75
sections.overview: Pre-main amplifier with AB / LR independent power supply system.An AB and LR independent power source system is adopted to integrate VICTOR/JVC's power-oriented design, reducing dynamic interference distortion caused by power supply voltage fluctuations.JA-S-S75 uses separate power transformers for Class B and Class A stages, which have large current changes. This prevents voltage fluctuations from becoming a type of input signal in the Class A amplifier circuit before the pre-driver stage and being amplified as distortion components.In addition, in JA-S75, the power transformer for the class B amplifier stage is dedicated to the left and right, thereby eliminating interference between the left and right channels.The equalizer circuit of the pre-amplifier section is equipped with a low-noise FET and employs a 3-stage cascode-connected ICL configuration that eliminates the input capacitor. In addition to eliminating the effect of the input capacitor, the ICL-FET eliminates the pop noise and dynamic range at the time of input selector switching.The tone control circuit uses a 2-stage NF type direct-coupled high-gain amplifier to obtain high linearity and low distortion factor.The volume uses a High Legh near-volume with a special structure. This volume uses a resistor that improves distortion and high-frequency characteristics at low volume levels by changing the area of the uniform material. In addition, the S/N ratio at low volume levels is greatly improved by using a twin volume system that is placed at the front and back of the tone control circuit.In addition, the latest low-distortion condenser is used for the main signal system to improve sound quality.The front panel is equipped with cartridge load switching function, and load resistance and capacity can be selected in 3 stages respectively.The wood case was sold separately as an option.

sections.overview: A pre-main amplifier with a tri-DC configuration in which all blocks of the equalizer, tone amplifier, and power amplifier are converted into DC.The power amplifier section consists of a complete DC amplifier using a low-noise dual FET at the first stage.In addition, class A and class B independent two power supply system is adopted. The double differential input stage with the common-phase feedback constant current circuit to the pre-drive stage is class A operation, and a constant voltage power supply is supplied from a transformer different from class B disconnection of the Darlington connection. Thus, stability of the midpoint potential is improved.As the power amplifier section becomes DC, the preamplifier section is also DC.The EQ circuit configuration consists of a first stage FET / ICL double differential input and a collector-follower pure complimentary service push-pull output. sections.title: VICTOR JT-V77
sections.overview: FM/AM tuner using newly developed PTL (Phase Tracking Loop) system.The newly developed PTL method is adopted for the FM detection circuit.Most common tuners use a method called quadrature detection, in which the signal from the IF stage is divided into two. One of the two signals is sent directly to the detection circuit, and the other signal is sent through a 90-degree phase shifter (phase-change circuit). The two signals are compared and a detection output corresponding to the difference is obtained.In PTL detection, by adding a tracking filter to the phase comparison circuit, the entire detection circuit is contained in a feedback loop, making it a kind of NFB detection circuit. The demodulation output from the loop filter drives the tracking filter, and changes the center frequency of the filter according to the phase change of the input IF signal.This PTL detection has excellent linearity (differential gain characteristics) over a wide band, low distortion rate, high resistance to overmodulation, extremely broad tuning dependence, and high stability over a long period of time can be maintained by absorbing deviations caused by temperature and aging. In addition, by improving the threshold characteristics of the detection circuit itself, the SN ratio in a weak electric field can be increased, and high characteristics such as rejection of interfering signals and AM suppression capability are realized.The IF stage combines single-peak 1-resonator type and double-peak 4-resonator type ceramic filters to achieve both high selectivity and flat group delay characteristics.The MPX circuit uses NFB, PLL, MPX, and IC, and combines a stereo pilot signal extraction circuit, a decoder designed to reduce distortion by NFB, and a PLL circuit for generating switching signals into a single package.Equipped with FM auto-tuning hold circuit to prevent drift of tuning point.This circuit is an automated circuit that is held a few seconds after accurate tuning and released immediately upon detuning.If the timer is set after synchronizing during recording and confirming that the hold indicator lights up, the camera will be restored to the hold state even after the power is turned off.An equalizer IC is used for the output amplifier.Built-in recording level calibrator corresponding to 50% modulation signal.The front panel is equipped with output level volume.Equipped with F-type connector for coaxial cable.There was a rack handle sold separately.

sections.title: VICTOR T-2020
sections.overview: 2020 series FM/AM tuners.In T-2020, a PLL is introduced into the FM detection circuit. The PLL detection circuit consists of a loop composed of a phase comparator, a low-noise filter, and a VCO so that the detection output is always locked in the phase of the input signal.In addition to maintaining high stability over a long period of time by absorbing slight deviations due to temperature and aging, we have achieved detection characteristics that cannot be obtained with conventional methods. For example, we have a filter effect for signals with frequencies outside the lock range, the lock range changes according to the strength of the input signal and the bandwidth automatically narrows for weak signals, increasing the interference rejection capability, and the AM suppression capability of the circuit itself.The MPX demodulation circuit employs a high-integration IC that combines a pilot extraction circuit, a decoder designed for low distortion by NFB, and a PLL circuit for generating switching signals into a single package.In this IC, the pilot pull-out circuit is controlled by PLL, and the 19 kHz stereo pilot signal is canceled by faithfully following the signal level change. This simplifies the low-pass filter in the latter stage and improves the frequency and phase characteristics of the audio band.An FM auto-tuning hold circuit is mounted to prevent drift of the tuning point.This circuit is held several seconds after accurate tuning, and is released immediately after detuning. Therefore, even when the power is turned off and then turned on again, it automatically returns to the held state as long as the tuning knob is not moved.Equipped with a tuning indicator and a signal indicator, each of which shows tuning state and electric field strength with 5 lighting points.The FM front end consists of a five link varicon, two dual-gate MOS FETs, and a buffered local oscillator.The output amplifier uses an equalizer IC to obtain a wide dynamic range.Equipped with a reference level oscillator for air check.Equipped with double muting circuit.Equipped with F-type connector for coaxial cable.

sections.title: VICTOR T-X5
sections.overview: FM/AM tuner with enhanced interference rejection capability.The T-X5 adopts JVC's original PTL (Phase Tracking Loop) detection circuit, which received the Excellence Award from the US IEEE.In conventional FM IF circuits, there was a problem that increasing the noise and adjacent signal rejection capability narrows the band and adversely affects sound quality, while increasing the band and improving sound quality lowers the interference rejection capability.In PTL detection, a filter with a narrow band follows the input signal and moves over a wide band. This filter can accurately exclude interfering signals that are in the immediate vicinity of the desired signal. Moreover, the detection band is wide enough to prevent the sound quality from deteriorating.This greatly improves the S / N ratio in a weak electric field and increases the practical sensitivity. At the same time, it also increases the interference rejection capability of adjacent stations in a strong electric field.Equipped with Quitting slope control.If this circuit is set to AUTO, it automatically reduces noise when the antenna input drops below a certain level, enabling comfortable stereo reception even in weak electric fields.A newly developed low-noise J-FET is used in parallel in the front-end antenna input circuit to reduce noise, increase gain and improve reception sensitivity.Equipped with an FM auto-tuning hold, it automatically holds the tuning state after a few seconds when it is tuned. Moreover, since the center of the radio wave does not escape, it is combined with the PTL detection of the input tracking method so that accurate reception is always possible.It is equipped with an LR-independent 100% NFB-PLL-MPX circuit incorporating a new 19 khz pilot cancel circuit.This drastically reduces the beat noise caused by the stereo pilot signal and ensures excellent audio performance by installing a low-pass filter with good phase characteristics.All LED display is adopted.Uses Matte Aluminum Dial Scale.

sections.title: VICTOR T-X55
sections.overview: FM/AM tuner with improved operability by microcomputer control control system while improving basic performance.The front-end mixer circuit is the first in the world to use a gallium arsenide (GaAs) FET.The gallium arsenide FET is a wide-band, high-linearity device with electrons moving at about six times faster than a general Silicone MOS FET and with almost no stray capacitance. By using this FET in a mixer circuit, which tends to generate interference signals called RF intermodulation, we have improved the interference rejection capability without loss of sensitivity.The RF-intermodulation can also be reduced by increasing the selectivity of the tuning circuit in front of the mixer circuit. In the synthesizer tuner, varicaps (variable capacitance elements) are used to determine the selectivity of this part. The T-X55 uses a newly developed high-voltage high-Q varicap, which greatly increases the selectivity compared to the conventional single-type varicap, and also improves the linearity at the time of Dainyu Chikara, which tends to cause interference.We have also improved the SN ratio and distortion factor of the local oscillator circuit by adopting a copper frame, making the oscillation transistor low-noise, and inserting a buffer circuit.Equipped with FM and SENS functions, 3-stage switching of RF gain is possible and intermodulation interference can be effectively suppressed.In order to eliminate the adverse effect of the lighting noise of the FL (fluorescent tube) display system, we have adopted a unique static drive lighting system, which eliminates the noise from the display system and improves the SN ratio.The T-X-X55 reduces noise generation by making the key input part of the microcomputer static.In the conventional synthesizer tuner, the microcomputer operates every several ? sec while checking the input key settings such as the FM / AM distinction and station number, and generates a pulse-like noise each time it is checked.The T-X55 uses a system in which a large microcomputer stores data in its own memory circuit, and noise is suppressed by checking the status of the key only once.The computer control system improves operability.This circuit detects the presence or absence of interfering waves adjacent vertically and vertically to the field strength of the desired station and detects the field strength within approximately 200 msec. It also automatically sets the FM ? SENS (RF attenuator), IF bandwidth, and QSC (Quitting slope control) so that the tuner can operate under the most appropriate conditions according to the radio wave conditions. For example, -10dB and -15dB attenuators are inserted into the mixer circuit and high-frequency amplifier circuit respectively when the input is over. Based on precise field strength detection in 1 dB steps, the level is lowered to -10dB or -25dB to control signal transmission under the best conditions. When there is strong adjacent interference, the IF bandwidth is narrowed to increase selectivity.These operations can also be manually switched. The QSC is a circuit that reduces the noise level by approximately 6 dB when a weak Birdie is received in stereo. However, the switching operation is automated along with an anti-electric noise filter that cuts out 9.5 kHz beat noise.The IF circuit is equipped with a linear-phase ceramic filter with excellent phase characteristics, and the new quadrature detector circuit is used to improve the detection power level and linearity to achieve a total low distortion rate and high S/N.DC configuration is used for the audio stage.Eight preset memories are installed for each FM and AM.In addition to the usual manual presets, memory sets can also be automatically scanned for automatic memory. Especially in FM mode, the computer control system is activated and the sensitivity, IF bandwidth and QSC are all set to the optimum mode for memory.By using both a timer and a tape deck, up to six FM/AM stations can be recorded at random, and the sequence of programmed stations can be monitored in advance.The AM tuner section employs a double-balanced AM mixer, combined with a high-sensitivity -sensitivity, low-impedance loop antenna and a tone selection switch, enables high-quality AM reception.The frequency display can display the electric field strength by switching the switch.Equipped with a 333 Hz recording calibrator.The AM loop antenna is detachable.

sections.title: VICTOR T-50F
sections.overview: FM stereo tuner equipped with PTL (Phase Tracking Loop) detection circuit.PTL detection of input tracking method is adopted.PTL detection is an application of technology developed to reduce noise and improve sound quality of CD-4. It has a structure in which the center frequency of the narrow-band filter moves following changes in the input IF signal. In PTL detection, sufficient bandwidth is provided up to the IF stage, and the bandwidth is determined by the detection circuit. Therefore, changes in the IF input signal, which constantly fluctuates around 10.7 MHz, can be detected instantaneously. By tracking with a sharp synchronous filter with a narrow band, interfering waves that deviate even a little in frequency do not pass through, and the target signal can be selected with extremely high efficiency.The tracking operation of the PTL detection is based on feedback (NFB) control. As a result, various advantages such as flat detection characteristics over a wide band, strong resistance to temperature change and aging, good S/N in weak electric field, and AM suppression ability according to the response speed of the feedback loop.The MPX stage and post-amplifier, including the preamp, are all DC-integrated, and high audio performance is pursued by NFB, PLL, MPX, IC with built-in pilot cancellation and low-pass filter with improved phase delay characteristics.Equipped with auto-tuning hold function with LED indicator.Equipped with a recording level calibrator and a front power level volume.Equipped with signal (5 points) and tuning (3 points) indicators using LED.Equipped with F-type connector for coaxial cable.

sections.title: VICTOR T-7070
sections.overview: This is the world's first FM stereo tuner in the Laboratory 7070 series that uses PLL circuits in three stages.The T-7070 consists of three main circuits with PLLs. In addition to the MPX circuit, the local oscillator circuit and the detection circuit are PLLs.The PLL detection circuit consists of a loop consisting of a phase comparator circuit, a low-pass filter, and a VCO (voltage controlled oscillator). The detection output is always synchronized with the phase of the IF signal. Since the PLL detection circuit operates in response to changes in the IF signal, it is hardly affected by temperature aging. Moreover, the differential gain characteristic (linearity of the detection characteristic) is flat within the lock range of the PLL regardless of the input level. Therefore, the output with less distortion can be obtained. In addition, the filter characteristic detects only signals within the lock range. The lock range automatically changes according to the input strength. The selectivity of weak signals can be increased without switching the bandwidth of the IF stage. There is AM suppression capability. It has advantages that cannot be obtained with conventional methods.In addition, the T-7070 uses a local oscillator circuit as a PLL synthesizer and locks the IF signal, resulting in high fidelity and stability.A newly developed SAW (Surface Acoustic Wave) filter is used for the selection element of the IF stage.This filter applies the principle of transmitting a signal by means of vibration waves propagating on the surface of a piezoelectric element. The linear part of the group delay characteristic is twice as wide as that of a ceramic filter, and has the same selectivity.The MPX stage has a built-in pilot cancellation circuit. In this circuit, a PLL circuit generates a pilot signal of opposite phase in order to remove the switching signal which is unnecessary for the decoder, and cancels it between the preamplifier and the decoder. This eliminates the need to attenuate 19 kHz with a low-pass filter for removing the unnecessary signal at the decoder output, thus improving the frequency and phase characteristics of the audio band.In addition, the decoder circuit is reduced in distortion rate by NFB, and the filter characteristic of PLL which only has to respond to 19 kHz is improved.It has a 7-station memory function.This function is retained even if the power switch is turned off.Equipped with a recording level calibrator for air check.There was a rack handle sold separately.

sections.title: VICTOR XP-DA1000
sections.overview: D/A converter of the laboratory ratory series.Equipped with Victor's original K2 interface.The K2 interface is a circuit that pays attention to the fact that out-of-code components such as jitter and ripple have a great effect on sound quality. It is designed to eliminate these out-of-code components just before D/A conversion.The principle of this circuit is to first detect only the code information from the waveform of the digital input signal by high-speed switching operation of the semiconductor. Then, based on this information, a new digital waveform is created on another block. By this circuit, the waveform transmission by the electric signal is changed to the code transmission once, and the non-code component contained before passing through the K2 interface is electrically cut off.The XP-DA1000 detects the clock from the digital input signal and controls the K2 interface circuit by generating a stable master clock based on the clock detected by the digital input signal and using the PLL circuit with an extremely high oscillation precision to control the K2 interface circuit. This enables extremely accurate code detection. In addition, it is equipped with a sync terminal that supplies a high-precision master clock. When combined with a CD player that supports generator lock, the digital signal pickup can be controlled by the master clock of the XP-DA1000 without using the clock generation circuit on the player side.This full synchronization allows the K2 interface to run ideally.Although the code data is transmitted digitally, the time data that controls the timing of the code is analog transmission. If these two signals are transmitted as an input digital signal on a single line, interference between D and A may occur.To solve this problem, the XP-DA1000 uses a method of separating the input digital signal into code data and time data and transmitting it to the K2 interface via two optical cables.In addition, the optical cable is installed in a spiral shape to attenuate high-order reflection modes and eliminate time lag of transmission signals.The D/A converter uses an 8 fs full-time 20-bit combination 4 dac.In the XP-DA1000, the quality is improved by the orthodox current addition method in which the low-order bit which is difficult to pursue the accuracy is made into the discrete structure. Moreover, the full-time 20 bit is realized while theoretically eliminating the 0 cross distortion by the total 4 combination DACs in which the LR is made to be independent. Furthermore, in order to always operate the full-bit correctly, the manual labor is added. The bit adjustment is done carefully one by one, and the minute resolution of the full-time 20 bit is achieved in actual operation, and the quantization noise is reduced as much as possible.The output of the D/A converter uses a current transmission method with an excellent S / N ratio. When a pulse voltage is applied to both electrodes at the same time, the gas in the electrodes causes a discharge phenomenon, generating a large number of ion-electron pairs (plasma), which emit light when they collide.In addition to features such as high-speed response of 0.02 msec or less and no indication inertia such as tracking delay and overshoot, this system has advantages such as easy multi-point display, free shape of the light emitting part and memory, high brightness and high construction, no parallax from an oblique direction because the light emitting part and scale can be placed on the same plane, low power consumption, and super life.The DS 7070 plasma display device covers a wide range of 43 points, from + 10 dB to -50dB, with 1 dB steps from + 10 dB to -20dB, and 2.5 dB steps from -20dB to -50dB.The sensitivity can also be increased by 20 dB by switching the front panel switch.There are four display functions. VU meets BTS (JIS) standard of 0.3   0.03 se rise time, and DIN and NBA standard of 10 msec peak time. Both tone burst response accurately meet the standard.In addition, the DIN standard specifies that the peak fall time is 1.5 sec. In the DS 7070, this is followed by the Peak Slow position and the Peak Fast position of 0.3 sec. so that the valley of continuous pulses can be monitored.In addition, a 4  , 8   and 16   impedance selection switch is mounted in order to correspond to the power level which changes according to the speaker impedance in average power and peak power display.The 0 dB scale is 100W, and the total indication range is 1 kW to 1 mW.To facilitate reading of fluctuating tip level, it is equipped with an instantaneous lock function. It is also equipped with a memory function that keeps showing maximum level while displaying real-time fluctuation level.The memory is retained until the power is turned off, but it can be erased by turning off the memory switch.There was a rack handle sold separately.

sections.title: VICTOR CF-7070
sections.overview: A crossover network employing a composite amplitude characteristic flat system.The composite amplitude characteristic flattening method uses a filter array method different from the conventional method, and at the same time, the phase change characteristics of all channels are made equal by inserting a phase shooter circuit, thereby realizing the amplitude characteristic (frequency characteristic) after the composite.Since the filter characteristics themselves are not different, this method can be changed to a conventional method by simply changing the arrangement of each block, and the best result can be selected according to the characteristics of the speaker system.The circuit uses an all-stage discrete ICL circuit including a high-Gm low-noise FET.Sound quality is also improved by using carefully selected circuit elements and large-capacity, low-impedance, wide-band power supplies.The low-pass and high-pass independent 11-point crossover allows the slope characteristics to be switched between 6dB/oct. and 12dB/oct.When the slope selector is in the OFF position, the signal of all channels is cut off is cut off, and when it is in the PASS position, a flat signal that does not pass the filter is sent out.The Q selector switches the crossover depth between -3dB (Q = 0.5) and -3dB (Q = 0.7) depending on the characteristics of the speakers.If you need a frequency other than the preset crossover frequency, you can add a filter capacitor to the internal AUX circuit board and switch the AUX switch.In this case, the low-pass and high-pass frequencies can be selected independently.The rear panel is equipped with a filter mode switch that can select three positions : HPF-LPF, BPF, and 3D.The HPF-LPF provides both low and high sound output, and allows 2-way configuration with one unit. The BPF is a band-pass filter that provides the medium sound output, and the other unit can be combined with the HPF-LPF to make 3-way configuration. Using this method, you can freely increase the number of channels by combining three or more units.In the 3D position, the 3D-type center woofer output can be obtained, and three slope characteristics of 24, 12 and 6dB/oct. can be selected.The input mode switch can connect or disconnect the input terminals of the low-pass and high-pass sides internally, and is used at the SEPATED position when the composite amplitude characteristic flat method is used.There was a rack handle as an option sold separately.

sections.title: VICTOR CD4-1000
sections.overview: A CD-4 demodulator of the Laboratory 1000 series specially developed for professional use such as studios.The Laboratory 1000 Series was designed and manufactured by selected staff members of the Victor Laboratory Center. The characteristics of the Series are compensated by the measured data of all the machines, and the specifications can be changed slightly according to the purpose.In addition to using highly reliable parts for all parts, it is checked up to one resistance and one knob.It is equipped with an automatic noise reduction circuit ANRS in order to improve the S / N ratio by suppressing mid - and high-frequency noise generated from the record in the CD-4 system.In addition, the ANRS ON/OFF switch is mounted on the rear panel so that the entire ANRS circuit can be lost.The rear panel has a DET BAND CONTROL switch.When this switch is in the Auto position, the demodulation detection band of the sub-channel is automatically changed according to the input, and high-blend operation is added to maintain noise-free and stable operation.When the switch is in the Fix position, these actions are not performed and it is fixed to the maximum lock range. Therefore, it can be used for noise checking of records or listening test of cartridges.The CD-4 recording circuit is designed to delay the main channel by 40 ? s in order to compensate for the delay time of the sub channel caused by the cartridge and demodulator during demodulation. In addition, the CD4-1000 takes into consideration the variation in the delay characteristics of the cartridge, and the delay time can be finely selected within   25 ? s with an 11-step switch. The channel separation of 30 dB or more can be obtained in the record operation state.In addition, it is equipped with a cross-modulation reduction circuit that reduces distortion caused by crosstalk in the cartridge, a demodulation circuit using a High Legh near PLL circuit that is a mixture of ICs and discrete devices, and an ANRS circuit that is completely symmetrical with the recording system. It pursues low distortion rate, high S/N and high separation.All of these circuits are plug-in units, and the structure of maintenance is excellent.The RIAA equalizer circuit uses a   2 power supply differential input Darlington class A operation circuit.In addition, the cartridge load resistance change-over switch is mounted on the rear panel, and the input resistance of Phono1 and 2 can be changed independently.It uses a 4-strand master trimming volume that combines the advantages of volume and attenuator.This volume is the same as the JP-V1000 model.The CD4-1000 is equipped with two pre-set circuits that can adjust the separation level, the delay time of the sum signal band, and the channel level of each of the two types of cartridges.In addition to using 4ch/2ch by switching the function selector, it is also possible to bypass the entire demodulator circuit and send the input directly.Equipped with a level check meter, the carrier level, separation, 4 ch level balance, etc. can be accurately adjusted by the signal from the attached test record.This meter is a high-precision vertical type meter similar to JP-V1000.Equipped with a subsonic filter and noise filter.The noise filter is a high-cut filter that works only on sub-channels. It effectively cuts noise while reducing the effect of frequency response on audio output.A cast-aluminum side frame is used to increase the rigidity of the body and achieve stable rack-mounting.The mount size is BTS standard and can be changed to RCA type by order.The power supply is a universal system of 100 V, 117 V, 220 V and 240 V. It can be used overseas simply by changing internal connections.

sections.title: VICTOR SX-L7
sections.overview:
230,000 (1 unit, released in November 2001)

This is a speaker system that uses JVC's proprietary technology to support ultra-high-frequency playback of DVD audio and other audio.In the SX-L7, the sound is created from the pure reproduction of upper and lower 2 octaves centered on the frequency of 440 Hz which is the sound of A used as the standard pitch of concert.In addition, in order to meet the high specifications of digital sound sources such as DVD audio, we are also pursuing the quality of ultra-high sound range as well.The unit layout has a structure called oblique omni array, and the voice coil is set in the direction in which the two woofer unit are closest to each other and the tweeter is placed between the woofer.As a result, we have obtained natural characteristics like a good full-range speaker.Two 18 cm oblicorn type woofers are installed in the lower range.A balanced metal oblicorn is used for the diaphragm, and an of recap with a center cap with a shifted top is attached.An aluminum die-cast frame is used for the frame, and a quick response Bakelite spider suspension is used for the damper. This unique structure realizes ideal medium and low frequency playback.A 3 cm oblidome type tweeter is installed in the high range.The diaphragm is made of hemp, which has the highest tensile strength among natural materials, and is rubberized using Victor's traditional method.The magnetic circuit uses an alnico magnet with a bulb-shaped yoke, and the frame uses an aluminum die-cast frame.It is equipped with a 1.9 cm hard dome type super tweeter for super high frequency band.The diaphragm is made of aluminum dome and plated with pure gold. The magnetic circuit is made of rare-earth neodymium magnet to obtain strong magnetic flux density.In addition, the unit is housed in a separate small cabinet with no dilution and ideal radiation characteristics, which improves the directivity in the ultrasonic band. This cabinet is made of solid Mizkie wood, which is high-density, has little change over time, and is acoustically superior, and is carved out with a potter's wheel.Each part is carefully selected for the network part, and the crossover frequencies are set with an emphasis on the centrodesmus range of music that plays the upper and lower two octaves of the A sound in one unit.The enclosure uses a bass reflex system.30 mm thick MDF is used for the front baffle, 25 mm thick for the side plate, top plate and bottom plate, and 18 mm thick particleboards for the back plate.In addition, the sound quality is improved by sticking a single maple board not only on the front side but also on the back side. sections.title: VICTOR SX-L9
sections.overview:
630,000 (1 unit, released in December 2003)

A speaker system developed by combining JVC's speaker technology.A 30 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.SP pulp cone, which realizes lightweight and high rigidity, is adopted for the diaphragm, and it is compatible with large input, and the diaphragm with foamed rubber edge is adopted for the edge.The magnetic circuit uses a long voice coil of   50 mm and a magnet exceeding 12,000 gauss.The mid-range is equipped with 18 cm cone type mid-range.A pure aluminum oblicorn diaphragm is used for the diaphragm and an of recap is used for the center cap. The resonance of the material is dispersed by the shape with the center offset. In addition, it is plated with pure gold for sound quality tuning. In addition, a foamed rubber edge is used for the edge part.This diaphragm is supported by a unique spider suspension with excellent linearity and an aluminum die-cast frame.The magnetic circuit is driven by a   50 mm edgewise wound voice coil and a 13,000 gauss ring type alnico magnet.A 2.5 cm dome-shaped tweeter is installed in the high range.The diaphragm is a oblidome diaphragm made of carbon graphite, which has a hardness close to that of diamond. It is plated with pure gold like the mid-range, giving it a natural sound connection with the mid-range.This diaphragm is driven by a 15,500 gauss magnetic circuit with an internal Alnico magnet.In the network section, we use silicon-core coils wound with oxygen-free copper wires and electrolytic capacitors made of plain foils. These parts are firmly fixed to the mounting board instead of the printed circuit board. Film capacitors and other components are directly connected by three dimensional wiring. This minimizes the deterioration of sound quality caused by unwanted vibrations.The enclosure uses a sealed system using a pressure equalizing tube.The conventional bass reflex method cannot avoid the effect of the resonance frequency of the port, which is different from the development intention of the SX-L9 which wants to construct the base tone with the correct pitch. In addition, the conventional sealed method produces a sound with a strong back pressure. In order to solve these problems, a pressure equalizing tube that adjusts only the DC component of the strong back pressure is used. sections.overview:

This speaker system was developed using the technologies obtained in the development of the SX-L9 and SX-LT55 Limited.The SX-L77 uses a layout in which the tweeter is sandwiched between the upper middle and low band woofer and the lower bottom woofer.The upper and lower units look the same, but they are completely different units. Wb.In order to enhance the effect of the oblique omni array arrangement, the center cap has also shifted the vertex and uses aluminum of recap of the same diameter with pure gold plating.An 18 cm oblicorn type unit is installed in the middle and low range.This unit is a full-range basic design with medium and low frequencies. The diaphragm is a dynamically balanced aluminum oblicorn diaphragm. The resonance of the material is dispersed by offsetting the driving point. This diaphragm is plated with pure gold.The edge low loss EPDM foam rubber edge is used for the edge part, and spider suspension with excellent linearity is used for the damper.The drive section is driven by an internal magnetic dual alnico magnetic circuit with a magnetic flux density of 900 mt (Tesla) and a total magnetic flux of 1,740 ? Wb, and a 50 mm diameter voice coil.Aluminum die-cast frame is used for the frame.A 2.5 cm oblidome type tweeter is installed in the high range.It uses a oblidome diaphragm with a carbon graphite dome whose top is shifted, eliminating the coloring of the material.An internal magnetic alnico magnetic circuit with a magnetic flux density of 1,550 mT is used for the magnetic circuit.Carefully selected parts are used for the network part.The crossover frequencies are determined with an emphasis on the centrodesmus range of the music, and the optimum attenuation characteristics are set for both the woofer and tweeter.The enclosure uses a bass reflex system.The SX-L77 uses a staggered bass reflex system. The low and mid-range sections consist of an 18-liter cabinet with the tuning frequency of the port set to 42 Hz, and the bottom woofer section consists of a 33-liter cabinet with the tuning frequency set to 29 Hz. sections.overview: This is the first single speaker model using a wood cone.The development of the Wood Cone was started with the idea that "speakers should be musical instruments." sections.overview: A record player with a high-torque motor.The drive motor uses the same DC-type 12-pole 24-slot all-round integral detection FG servo motor used for the turntable TT-71/TT-81. By adding a spare drive circuit and power supply circuit to this motor, quick start-up characteristics and torque of 1 kg ? cm or more are obtained.The FG velocity detector is built into the motor and consists of a magnetic disk with 180 detection grooves and 180 printed coils facing each other. With this, 180 pulses are generated in the coil in one rotation, and the total detection output appears in the form of integrating the output of the entire coil corresponding to 180. Thus, high detection accuracy is obtained so that errors in the detection output can be practically ignored.A turntable of 2.15 kg including rubber covering is adopted, and inertial mass is 350 kg ? cm.2We have achieved.33 1/3rpm flash is engraved on the outer circumference. The 45 rpm speed is adjusted to 33 1/3rpm in advance so that it will automatically fit. However, it is designed so that it can be directly checked with the center plate type flash.New Gimbal Support System has been adopted for the bearing of the tone arm. This system has a structure in which micron-precision radial bearings are symmetrically arranged at equal distances from the center point of the arm shaft. It has the advantages of both the gimbal system and the one point system by making the operation equivalent to the one point support at the center point.The inside of the arm pipe is filled with anti-vibration material to reduce cavity resonance.The anti-skating mechanism adopts a click-equipped system, and the operability is improved by adopting a large knob.The cartridge connector uses a new chucking lock type connector that prevents looseness by tightening a tapered cylinder with a plug-in nut.The head shell forged head shell is used for the head shell part.This product is made by forging molten pure aluminum. The density is increased by eliminating the internal cavity and resonance is eliminated.The cartridge is equipped with the Z-1S cartridge which inherits the design content of the highest quality cartridge X-1.A large howling margin is obtained by adopting a double structure with less internal space for the cabinet.In addition, the exterior is finished in Rosewood-style.Arm sub-weight was available as an option sold separately.

sections.title: VICTOR QL-7R
sections.overview: A record player equipped with a turntable TT-71.Quartz Lock DD Turntable TT-71 sold as a stand-alone product is mounted on the turntable part. The drive motor is equipped with an FG servo system of full circumference integral detection type with torque of 1 kg ? cm or more.This speed detection mechanism consists of a ring magnet, a magnetic disk with 180 slots (FG yoke), and 180 power generation print coils (FG substrate). Together with the motor, when the magnetic disk makes one revolution, 180 pulses are generated for each of 180 coils. Therefore, the total detection output appears in the form of integrating the outputs of the whole circumference of 180 coils. There are few detection errors, and the absurdity of generating the cause of wow and flutter by the servo system itself can be almost eliminated.In addition, a turntable with a total weight of 2.2 kg including rubber covering has been adopted, and a quartz lock has been added to improve overall rotational accuracy.The quartz lock circuit compares the phase of the reference signal based on the accurate oscillation frequency of the crystal with that of the signal sent from the speed detector of the motor. When there is a difference, the driving voltage of the motor is automatically changed. The QL-7R uses a sample-and-hold circuit for this part to improve the accuracy and speed of the servo response.A touch sensor system is used for the rotation number changeover switch and stop switch.In addition, a brake mechanism using an electromagnetic solenoid is linked to the stop switch so that it can stop smoothly within 1.6 seconds.The flash is powered by the oscillation frequency of the crystal, enabling accurate speed monitoring.The tone arm uses Victor's original new gimbal system, which pursues the sensitivity of the one point support system and the stability superior to the gimbal system. The tone arm also uses a chucking lock type head connector, which prevents the arm pipe and shell with anti-vibration material from rattling, and a molten metal forged head shell to further improve sound quality.The cabinet is designed to eliminate resonance and vibration by theoretical analysis and measurement of vibration loop.The foot uses a newly developed parallel isolator that incorporates coil springs and rubber into the die-cast housing. This structure reduces lateral vibration while achieving a high vibration isolation effect. In addition, this isolator is height adjustable.Arm sub-weight was sold separately.

sections.overview: A record player that uses an arm pipe exchange system.The tone arm part uses a pipe replacement system with a robust screw fastening connector.The QL-A75 is equipped with a high-rigidity lowmass tapered straight pipe that has been carefully treated for vibration isolation and an S-shaped universal pipe (with a non-resonance seeking locking lock head connector). sections.title: VICTOR QL-A95
sections.overview: A quartz lock player system for record absorption, inheriting the technology of the TT Model 801 DD turntable.It can be used as a turbo disk stabilizer system by using TS-1 which is sold separately.In this system, the air between the record and the turntable is removed so that the entire sound groove portion is uniformly adhered to the turntable at atmospheric pressure. This reduces the vibration of the record and eliminates needle skipping due to warping of the record, which could not be solved with a weight-type stabilizer.The tone arm adopts a pipe exchange system, and the special high rigidity material Lummus tapered straight pipe utilizing the light needle pressure cartridge and the universal S-shaped pipe can be freely replaced and used.Tapered straight pipe not only realizes the optimization of low-frequency resonance frequency, but also has high stress against torsion and deflection, and electrical contact of signal system is reduced. Also, the head shell part is carefully treated for vibration isolation.The S-shaped s-shaped pipe is designed to be non-resonant by sealing anti-vibration material or by using a type of chucking lock head connector.The rotary bearing employs a new gimbal support system with a highly sensitive and stable virtual one point support structure developed by JVC. The turntable base and arm base are integrated by a docking plate to adjust the phase of the vibration propagation loop and eliminate harmful intermodulation distortion.The counter weight of the tone arm has a dynamic Q-dump mechanism that cancels the resonance of the arm by a multi-resonance system. The weight shaft is firmly fixed to the bearing block without using rubber, etc. This suppresses the resonance of the arm part and the counter weight, etc. and reduces the cross modulation distortion that impairs sound quality.A spare weight for heavy-duty cartridges is included, and various combinations of straight pipes, S-shaped pipes and sub-weights can be used to pursue optimum matching for a wide range of cartridges.A coreless DC servo motor is used as the drive motor.In addition to no vibrations caused by cocking, a high torque of up to 3.0kg-cm is achieved by a powerful driving circuit. In addition, a double-servo quartz lock circuit with 30 times higher lock stability is used for rotation control.In addition, the electronic brake utilizing the   bi-directional servo system with high rotational accuracy makes it possible to switch and stop the rotational speed very smoothly and quickly.The turntable weighs 3.05 kg including the mat and has an inertial mass of 470kg-cm.2In addition to a zinc vibration-proof ring on the back side, an elastic ring is fitted inside the rim part to completely eliminate resonance.Excellent sound quality has been obtained by combining with a large motor with a shaft diameter of 14 mm and a die-cast base.The cabinet uses a solid material laminated cabinet with no resonance and vibration. The exterior is finished with a rose-style real wood finish.The low center of gravity type of the insulator is adopted, and the supporting point position is raised as much as possible to suppress the fluctuation of the cabinet. This insulator is firmly attached to the cabinet via a lead base.Equipped with an auto stop up mechanism, the arm automatically lifts when the needle tip enters the inner lead groove of the record and stops the rotation of the turntable.This mechanism is a non-contact speed detection system that does not apply side pressure to the arm, and does not adversely affect sound quality.There was a special high rigidity tapered straight arm pipe with black finish as an option sold separately, and the included S-shaped universal arm pipe was also sold separately.High rigidity light alloy tapered straight pipe PH-100 for QL-A75 can also be used.

sections.title: VICTOR QL-Y77F
sections.overview: A record player with an ED servo tone arm.A microcomputer-controlled ED servo tone arm has been adopted in pursuit of zero resonance and zero vibration.The ED servo tone arm is a system that electronically and contactlessly suppresses the peak of fo, which is harmful to sound quality, without using mechanical friction such as oil dump. Two pairs of coreless linear motors directly connected to the horizontal and vertical bearings of the arm detect arm vibration purely electronically and cancel the vibration by feedback control using a microcomputer.In the QL-Y77F, this double direct drive ED servo tone arm has been further improved. By strictly examining the mounting position of the coreless coil and improving the bearing accuracy, the servo gain has been increased to approximately five times that of the conventional one, and stable high-speed feedback operation has been strengthened.In addition, the arm operates normally even when the player is tilted because both horizontal and vertical directions are symmetrical and dynamic balance system.A pipe replacement system is adopted to eliminate play at the head shell mounting part.A tapered straight pipe with high rigidity and light mass is used for the pipe. However, the cartridge can be easily replaced by adding an optional spare pipe or universal S-shaped pipe. The optional S-shaped pipe is equipped with anti-vibration material and a chucking lock head connector to eliminate resonance. The pipe replacement method and low center of gravity TH (tracing hold) structure enable optimum tracing for various cartridges.In addition, by rigidly joining the arm base and turntable base with a docking plate, the phase of each vibration is matched, and intermodulation distortion is suppressed.Operability has been improved by gathering the control part of the tone arm in one place in the right front of the cabinet.In this control section, the Q-dump adjustment of fo, needle pressure application, and anti-skating adjustment are all electronically controlled by volume, and the movement of the tone arm and operation of the full auto function are all controlled by the control section.A double servo quartz circuit with 30 times higher quartz lock stability is used for the drive part, and a low-vibration coreless structure without cocking is used for the motor. Inertia mass is 350kg-cm with a torque of 1.8kg-cm.2A turntable weighing 2.35 kg including mat is locked in at constant speed without 1/4 rotation.A quick stop with an electronic brake is also used to stop the turntable.An elastic ring has been added to the turntable to reduce resonance.The cabinet is made of high-density solid material with a rosewood-like mirror finish.In addition, a low center of gravity type has been adopted for the insulator to raise the fulcrum position as much as possible to improve the stability of the cabinet. This insulator is height adjustable.

sections.title: VICTOR BLA-255
sections.overview: A speaker system developed based on the design details of the BLA 405 and 305 models.A 25 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.The cone paper used in this unit is newly developed KP-3. This diaphragm is made with new fibers and a special material processing method using a vacuum press method. It features dense fibers and a high Young's modulus.In addition, a 4-layer voice coil has been adopted for the voice coil, eliminating the deterioration of transients caused by the reproduction of heavy bass.A 12 cm cone type squaker is installed in the middle range and a multi-cellar horn type tweeter is installed in the high range.We use conifer for the front baffle and back plate of the enclosure. Conifer has coarse and dense parts in the material, and the propagation speed of sound differs between the flat grain direction and the cross direction. Therefore, we use seven layers of conifer to compensate for the difference in speed, and combine it with a propagation rod called a sound stick (spruce material) to improve musical performance.We have also increased the sound absorption coefficient by using a newly developed sound absorbing material that is specially processed from animal fiber (55% wool) and chemical fiber (45% ester), both of which contain complex cellulose.Equipped with 2ch/3ch terminals for multi-amplifier.Equipped with a level control on the front, you can adjust the tweeter and the squaker respectively.

sections.overview: This is a 2-way floor type speaker system that uses a backloading CW horn for high efficiency and transient.A 20 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.The diaphragm of this woofer uses the hardest and lightest cone manufactured by Horley in the United States. A magnet with a diameter of 120 mm is used to increase braking force.In addition, aluminum die-cast is used for the frame.A 6 cm cone type tweeter is installed in the high range.A cone made by Horley Co. is used in the same way as Woofer, and superhard duralumin with special vapor deposition processing is used for the center cap to obtain high sound with high efficiency and good transient.Back Loading CW Horn is an abbreviation of Constant Width, meaning a horn with a constant width and a wide width. In the FB-5, the back loading type CW horn is folded into a floor type enclosure. In this type, the horn load (resistance control) is applied only to the low range. Therefore, the high range is cut by the equivalent mass of the speaker and the back chamber, and only the low range is emitted from the horn, and the higher frequency is emitted directly from the front of the speaker.The horn of the FB-5 uses Victor's original shape determined by thorough computer analysis. It reproduces sound from 45 Hz to around 150 Hz and gradually attenuates beyond that. The cut-off frequency on the lower band side is 25 Hz. The total length of the horn is 1.8m, so the sound emitted from the horn is about 5 ms behind the sound emitted directly.The upper part of the enclosure structure, which forms a curved surface, is made of thermo-molded plywood. Except for the curved surface part, a newly developed high-density chip board made of conifer wood is used. This chip board is mainly made of karamatsu and is approximately 40% heavier than conventional chip boards.

sections.overview: A speaker system designed to take advantage of the capabilities of a professional unit without compromise.Units developed independently for business use are used. By combining a light vibration system with an equivalent mass of less than 35g with an internal magnetic circuit using an Alnico V ring magnet with a total magnetic flux of 339,000 maxwell and a magnetic flux density of 12,000 gauss, a high-efficiency unit with excellent linearity of minute input is realized.The voice coil employs an edge-wised voice coil that reduces current distortion by heat treatment to obtain a low-distortion driving force. In addition, unique know-how is also utilized in the integrally molded bottom yoke of special casting and aluminum die-cast frame.A horn type tweeter is installed in the high range.This unit is a compression type with a cut-off frequency of 1 kHz and a large exponential aluminum horn with an aperture of 100 mm. The diameter is 33 mm.The magnetic circuit uses a bottom yoke type Alnico V magnet similar to Woofer, and the magnetic flux density reaches 14,000 gauss.The opening of the horn is equipped with a drip type equalizer. This water-drop type equalizer is placed opposite to the normal throat equalizer and has the function of pulling the sound center close to the leading edge of the horn. This eliminates the discomfort of hearing sound from the back of the throat, which is often seen in large horns, and advances the sound image without losing the excellent transient and frequency characteristics of the compression driver.The network section uses low-loss high-Q coils with a silicon-steel core and capacitors designed specifically for the network.Film capacitors with dielectric loss of 1/100 of that of non-polar Chemi-Con and 1/10 of that of ordinary film capacitors are used Shinkai for high-pass filters in particular.Equipped with level control.The enclosure is a backloading CW horn with a cutoff frequency of 35 Hz.It has been processed with an accuracy of 0.01 mm by a computer-controlled NC router and assembled accurately.Equipped with casters convenient for movement.

sections.title: VICTOR SX-3
sections.overview:
27,900 (1 unit, around 1973)  29,800 (1 unit, around November 1973)  32,800 (1 unit, around 1974)

This speaker system was released as the first product of the SX series of Victor Speakers.The woofer is equipped with 25 cm cone type woofer.The cone paper of this unit uses KDU cone paper made by German Kurt Muller.A 5 cm soft dome type tweeter is installed in the middle and high area.The soft dome diaphragm has a highly flexible dome-like structure that realizes a spherical wave shape that could not be achieved with a hard diaphragm. The dome material is made of uniformly woven fabric so that it does not stretch.In addition, by using a flexible rubber-based dump material, it has a feature that it does not have the natural resonance of a hard diaphragm.The front of the tweeter is equipped with a one touch removable diffuser.A silicon-steel core coil is used in the network to reduce non-linear strain in the Dainyu force. The DC resistance value is designed to be 1/20 or less of the speaker resistance value to prevent the loss of damping of the amplifier.The cabinet uses North American Douglas-fir plywood for the front and rear baffles, and a soundbar to equalize the sound propagation speed in the vertical and horizontal directions of the cabinet, making it a cabinet with beautiful sound.In addition, ester wool, which has a sound absorption coefficient of less than 1 kHz two to three times that of conventional glass wool, is used for the sound absorbing material inside.The exterior is finished with spruce, and the high solid, flat and clear coating prevents scratches.

sections.title: VICTOR SX-3II
sections.overview: This speaker system is based on the SX-3 model and is more complete.A 25 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.The diaphragm uses KDU cone paper, which is also used for SX-3.A 5 cm soft dome type tweeter is installed in the high range.This unit is based on the SX-3 soft dome type tweeter and further improved. By adding a new back cavity, fo and Qo of the unit are kept low, and the crossover frequency is lowered by 200 Hz.In addition, a copper cap is used for the magnetic circuit to reduce current distortion.Both the high-cut woofer and the low-cut tweeter are designed at 12dB/oct.In addition, a compensation circuit is built in as a countermeasure against loss before the cutoff of the woofer and resonance near the cutoff, which are likely to be caused by inductance components, to realize a smoother high-cut.The coil is made of silicon steel plate core, which is resistant to large input power.The enclosure uses SX-3 Yuzuri specifications, North American conifer Douglas-fir plywood for the front and rear baffles, and sound-absorbers and ester wool sound-absorbing materials for the interior.

sections.title: VICTOR SX-3III
sections.overview: Based on the SX-3II, this is a speaker system that goes back to the origin of the speaker and carefully refines the details.A 25 cm cone type woofer made of KDU cone paper developed jointly by Kurt Muller and Victor Company of Japan, Ltd. is installed in the lower range. In addition, an aluminum die-cast frame is adopted to take advantage of the diaphragm features. In combination with a rubber ring, parasitic vibration is reduced and magnetic efficiency is improved.In addition, the sound quality of the KDU cone is further improved by increasing the size of the damper and reducing current distortion by heat treatment of the magnetic circuit.A 5 cm soft dome type tweeter is installed in the high range.This unit has been revised to improve the efficiency of the magnetic circuit by the adoption of a edge wound voice coil, mid-range transient characteristics by changing the material and dimensions of the back cavity cover, and improve the opening efficiency of the front dome cover.The cabinet is made of North American Douglas-fir plywood and high density particleboards with a spruce finish similar to the face plate of a stringed instrument on all surfaces except the rear baffle.In addition, the inner side of the rear baffle has a soundbar with a concave R that takes advantage of the structure of the musical instrument. By applying tension to the rear baffle, the natural sound of the Douglas-fir plywood is further enhanced.In addition, we have adopted an ester wool sound-absorbing material that has approximately twice the sound absorption rate of glass wool.The front baffle can be equipped with an optional accessory RUNNET sold separately.

sections.title: VICTOR SX-5
sections.overview:
47,900 (1 unit, released in 1973)  52,800 (1 unit, around 1974)

This 3-way speaker system was developed as a mid-size model of the SX series.A 25 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.Kurt Mueller's KDU cone paper is used for the diaphragm, and the magnetic circuit of the SX-3 has been further enhanced to enhance the low-frequency reproduction capability.Equipped with 6.5 cm soft dome type skoker in the middle area.In addition to the excellent directional characteristics of the dome type, the soft dome has a sound with less distortion by eliminating the division vibration due to the soft material. Victor was quick to notice this feature and incorporated it into the Tweeter in the SX-3. In the SX-5, a soft dome type unit is also used in the mid-range to enhance the mid-range.The diaphragm is made of hemp cloth and coated with rubber-based damping material to create a flexible diaphragm. The magnetic circuit uses a 120 mm wet Ba-ferrite magnet and a copper cap to reduce current distortion and obtain good transient characteristics. The voice coil uses aluminum foam and a newly developed thermosetting adhesive to achieve input resistance at a maximum instantaneous input power of 150W.The frame is made of ABS resin, which does not have the unique sound of metal frame, and suppresses the unique sound of metal frame.A back cavity filled with sound absorbing material is adopted at the back of the unit to realize low fo and Q dump.A 3.0 cm soft dome type tweeter is installed in the high range.The network uses a silicon-steel core developed by VICTOR/JVC to suppress the increase of strain even at large input power.The front and rear baffle plates of the enclosure are made of Douglas-fir plywood, a North American conifer that is also used as piano wood and has excellent vibration damping waveform characteristics.In addition, sound propagation is regulated by adopting a sound absorber inside the cabinet, and an ester wool sound absorbing material with a sound absorption coefficient twice as high as that of general glass wool is used for the sound absorbing material.The net grill uses ester jersey net and can be put on and taken off.

sections.title: VICTOR SX-5II
sections.overview: This speaker system was developed by introducing the technology and know-how of the SX-7 model.A 25 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.As for the cone paper of Woofer, KDU cone paper which is common to the SX series is adopted. In addition, a felt ring is inserted in the voice coil bobbin to prevent bobbin division vibration and improve the middle and low frequency range.6.5 cm soft dome type mid-range is adopted for the mid-range.The soft dome diaphragm is woven with carefully selected vegetable fiber in a loose bind that does not stretch. The damping material is also made of newly developed synthetic rubber based damping material without the common bis-colloid. The advantage of the soft dome is brought out. In addition, the input resistance is improved by the adoption of aluminum bobbin and thermosetting resin wound voice coil.In the SX-5II, the dimensional accuracy of the magnetic circuit is improved, and the efficiency of the unit is improved by approximately 2 dB by driving down the size of the gap.The 3 cm soft dome type tweeter for SX-7 type is installed as it is in the high range.This unit uses an equalizer to adjust the phase disturbance in the high-frequency range.Three units use a magnetic circuit with a copper cap to reduce current distortion.A silicon steel core is used in the network section so that the strain does not increase even with large input power.The front and rear baffles of the enclosure are made of Douglas-fir plywood, a North American conifer with excellent vibration damping characteristics, and the side plates are made of high-density chipboards. In addition, soundbars are used inside the cabinet to regulate sound propagation, and the cabinet is filled with ester wool sound-absorbing material mainly made of animal fiber.
