sections.title: VICTOR SX-7
sections.overview:
Released in 1973  79,000 (1 unit, around 1974)

This is an SX series speaker system equipped with a soft dome unit in the mid-range area.A 30 cm cone type woofer using KDU cone paper made by Kurt Mueller is mounted in the low range.KDU cone paper is an excellent material with high Young's modulus, elasticity, and strong reaction.In addition, in order to reduce the split vibration of the cone paper, which is a problem with large-diameter woofers, we have adopted five Konica Le Dome for the woofer, which reduces the distortion of the woofer.The edge uses a roll-shaped sandwiched dumped edge.The magnetic circuit uses a Cu cap structure to reduce current distortion. The voice coil uses a long travel type to eliminate amplitude distortion. In addition, the phenolic resin winding allows for high input power and realizes a maximum input power of 100W for the system.A 7.5 cm soft dome unit is installed in the middle area.The diaphragm of this unit emphasizes uniformity and flexibility. The dome is made of carefully woven loose-bound hemp cloth, and the entire dome is molded homogeneously. The voice coil is wound with aluminum bobbin and newly developed thermosetting adhesive, and is strong enough to withstand an instantaneous maximum input power of 150W.The magnetic circuit uses a large 120 mm diameter wet Ba-ferrite magnet and a copper cap to reduce current distortion.The back of the soft dome is a sealed type with a moderate back cavity filled with sufficient sound-absorbing material. This structure and the soft dome fully dumped with rubber-based dump material achieve a low fo of 200 Hz.A 3 cm soft dome type tweeter is installed in the high range.The dome is made of vegetable fiber with a uniform loose binding that does not prevent expansion and contraction. It is also coated with rubber-based dump material, giving it excellent flexibility and quality. In addition, a copper cap is used in the magnetic circuit to achieve low distortion.The front and back of the cabinet are covered with Douglas-fir plywood, a North American conifer that has a simple vibration damping waveform and is also used for piano.In addition is not only for reinforcement, but also for sound propagation of the cabinet by using sound absorbers learned from the structure of musical instruments such as piano.The sound-absorbing material is an ester wool sound-absorbing material made mainly of animal fiber, which has a much higher sound absorption coefficient than ordinary glass wool.The network is a 12-dB / oct dividing network with crossover points of 500 Hz and 5000 Hz.The core of the network is a silicon-steel core developed by JVC.The level control is mounted on the high-range and mid-range units to enable attenuation from normal position to -50dB.

sections.title: VICTOR SX-7II
sections.overview: This speaker system combines the spirit of thorough handcraft with the results of the latest electronics technology, and seeks performance quality suitable for recording technology.A 30 cm cone type unit made of Kurt Mueller's KDU cone paper is used for the low range. The cone paper is a new type of cone paper that reexamines the internal loss and enhances the beautiful sound.We pursue better sound quality by adopting Konica Le Dome to prevent split vibration and newly designed magnetic circuit with low distortion factor.The unit is protected by a perforated metal cover.Soft dome type units of 7.5 cm and 3 cm are used for the middle and high frequencies.Several hundred kinds of experiments have been repeated for each of them, and all improvements have been made from the dome base fabric to the molding method and the material of the viscoelastic coating agent.The magnetic circuit is also strengthened, and linearity and input resistance are improved.In order to obtain clean wave front transmission without interference near the crossover frequency, more than ten different unit configurations were tested and measured. After adjusting the positional relationship in millimeters, left and right channel target configurations were adopted to improve sound field reproducibility and sound image localization.In addition, the front baffle uses a lumber core made of coniferous forest Douglas-fur produced in North America to make the most of the sound of muku material.A soundbar with a concave R is added to the rear baffle to apply tension to the plate and improve vibration damping characteristics.

sections.overview: Double number series bookshelf type speaker system.A 30 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.A KDU cone manufactured by Kurt Muller is used for the diaphragm, and five Konica Le Dome are added to the cone to propose split resonance. A felt cap is used for the center cap to improve response and transient in the mid-frequency range.It is equipped with a 6.5 cm soft dome type squaker in the middle range and a 3 cm soft dome type tweeter in the high range.These units were designed by reexamining the special fabric base material of the dome using accumulated know-how, and by improving the viscoelastic impregnation agent, natural resonance is reduced, and elastic wide-directional diaphragm is formed.In addition, a large magnetic circuit with high magnetic flux density and a high input resistant voice coil using different bobbin materials for a squaker and a tweeter are taken into consideration in order to take advantage of the soft dome performance.In addition, an aluminum dieeach unit is equipped with an aluminum die-cast Definition Equalizer with six strong fins that also act as protectors. sections.title: VICTOR SX-211
sections.overview:
27,000 (1 unit, released in October 1988)

As a sister machine to the SX 311, this compact 2-way speaker system is designed to be easier to use.Each unit uses a diaphragm made by Kurt Mueller in West Germany.The diaphragm is made with a consistent emphasis on lightness. It produces clear resolutions and rich sound fields. In particular, it has high resolution in the case of Tsutomu Oire, so it has high reproduction power even at the level of sound you normally listen to.A 16 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.An alnico magnet is used for the magnetic circuit to improve sound quality, and a bulb-shaped yoke provides excellent response to minute signal input.A 3-cm dome type tweeter is installed in the high range.The tweeter uses a double magnet system to prevent magnetic leakage to the outside.The cabinet has adopted a design method that combines the sound of the cabinet itself with the harmony of the speaker unit while suppressing unnecessary vibrations that muddy the sound, improving the sense of scale and expressive power of the sound field.The cabinet is made of carefully selected high-density conifer materials with appropriate vibration damping characteristics, and is assembled using a unique high-speed and high-pressure assembly method that instantly connects all six surfaces at a high pressure of approximately 1 ton. This gives the joined surface high strength while realizing the beautiful sound of the baffle surface.The G-line unit layout is determined by the sound intensity method in which the computer designs the optimum mounting position of each speaker unit.In addition, the directivity is also improved by adopting the super elliptical baffle.The sound absorbing material inside the cabinet is made of 100% wool with superior acoustic S/N.There were two types of exterior finishes : gray finish and walnut open pore finish.

sections.title: VICTOR SX-500II
sections.overview:
90,000 (a set of two cars, around 1989)

This is a speaker system that was completed by further polishing the SX 500, which was made by Victor with particular attention to natural sound.A 20 cm cone unit made by Kurt Mueller is used for the low frequency range. This cone is strongly reproduced by an Alnico magnet with a high flux and low leakage inner magnetic structure.The low-range magnet is made of iron that has been annealed (special heat) for a long time at a high temperature of around 700 ? as the material of the pole piece, bringing out the good characteristics of Alnico.Oxygen-free copper wire is used for the voice coil.A 3.5 cm soft dome unit made of habutae silk laminated with thin rubber film is adopted for the high range.A high-purity 6N copper wire with a purity of 99.999% is used for the voice coil, and an internal magnet type alnico magnet is used for the magnetic circuit.The front baffle, which has a significant effect on sound quality, is made of laminated maple with moderate internal loss and sound velocity. The new G-line unit layout is adopted using Victor's unique sound intensity method. The super elliptical baffle improves directivity.In consideration of sound quality, 100% wool sound absorbing material is used inside the cabinet.In addition, the finish is 6-all-wood finish.Bi-wiring compatible input terminal is used to prevent back electromotive force.The two single-channel speaker cables are connected independently to the woofer and tweeter to improve the coverage and multi-drive for upgrade.The capacitor of the network uses a separator paper made of silk blend paper, which reduces the vibration energy generated between the electrodes in the capacitor and provides smooth sound quality.

sections.title: VICTOR SX-511
sections.overview:
59,800 (1 unit, released in October 1987)

A 3-way speaker system that uses Alnico for the magnetic circuit in the middle range.A 31.5 cm cone woofer with a cross-carbon diaphragm is mounted in the low range.In this unit, high-quality cross-carbon is laminated with high-internal loss sheets to obtain moderate internal loss in addition to the characteristics of cross-carbon.Equipped with a 12.0 cm cone type squaker in the middle area.The diaphragm of this unit is a hybrid structure using fine cross carbon and carbon sheet, and clear sound quality with less distortion is obtained.The Alnico magnet is used for the magnetic circuit. It is an alloy made of nickel, cobalt, iron, and other materials. Compared to conventional ferrite magnets, it has a higher density and more uniform magnetic flux distribution. It has an electrical resistivity of 45 ?   cm, which is about 1/200 of that of conventional ferrite (10,000 ?   cm). Moreover, it has a small magneto-resistance of about 1/4, and the braking force is extremely high. Therefore, the back electromotive force of the voice coil is strongly cancelled out. In addition, the sound quality is improved by using a full-fledged tsubo-type yoke, which has less magneto-resistance than conventional rectangular yokes.A 3.0 cm dome type tweeter is installed in the high range.The diaphragm of this unit is made by depositing amorphous diamond on a titanium substrate using a unique chemical vapor deposition (CVD) method, and achieves sound velocity comparable to diamond.The frame of each unit is made of solid aluminum die cast with rib structure to increase rigidity.In particular, the weight class for the woofer is 2.1 kg, double that of the conventional model. Moreover, the front baffle, which tends to be less rigid, is reinforced with the frame by mounting it securely with 8 screws.A three part network is used for the network section. High, middle, and low frequency circuits are separated to eliminate mutual interference. In addition, solderless caulking is used for the wiring connection section, and adhesive is used to completely seal the wiring connection section to prevent deterioration of sound quality due to aging.High-sound condenser and coil are used for parts.The cabinet uses a full-cleat system. The 25 mm thick front and rear baffles have a structure in which piles (cleat) are placed at all bonding points. In addition, a unique high-speed and high-pressure assembly method has been introduced for the assembly of the cabinet, and it is a sturdy structure in which all six surfaces are bonded instantly at a high pressure of approximately 1 ton. In this method, the bonding surface does not undergo heat treatment to weaken, so the aging is less.Carefully selected high-density conifer wood is used for the material while realizing high strength, it realizes a cabinet with beautiful sound.The unit layout adopts a sound intensity method in which the optimum mounting position is designed by a computer, and realizes a new G-line unit layout close to the ideal.In addition, we have adopted a super elliptical baffle that radiates sound energy evenly to the listening room by improving directivity.

sections.title: VICTOR SX-521
sections.overview:
62,000 (1 unit, on sale in November 1988)  57,700 (1 unit, around 1990)

This is a 3-way speaker system that uses alnico magnet and natural materials and pursues high sound quality in an orthodox way.A 31.5 cm cone type woofer using cone paper made by Kurt Mueller is mounted in the low range.Equipped with 12 cm cone type skoker in the middle area.Similar to Woofer, this unit uses Kurt Mueller cone paper. In addition, Alnico magnet is used for the magnetic circuit, and a ring type with a hole in the pole piece to eliminate the back pressure in the magnetic circuit. As a result, the diaphragm has a response with excellent linearity.A 3.5 cm soft dome type tweeter is installed in the high range.In order to match the sound quality to the mid-range and low-range diaphragm made of natural materials, we have adopted a diaphragm made of silk habutae laminated with thin-curtain rubber.The network section is designed with consideration given to the arrangement of high, middle and low frequency network elements to eliminate mutual interference. In addition, solderless caulking is adopted for the wiring connection part, and in addition, sound quality degradation is prevented by sealing with adhesive.We are also working to further improve sound quality by using high-tone condensers and coils.The cabinet is made of carefully selected high-density conifer materials with beautiful sound.In addition, in order to realize a cabinet with high strength, we have adopted a cleat method for joining the front baffle using a pile (cleat). In addition, all six surfaces are assembled instantly at a high pressure of approximately 1 ton using our unique high-speed high-pressure assembly method. This method does not require heat treatment to weaken the adhesive surface, thus realizing a highly reliable cabinet.The unit layout uses a new G-line unit layout based on the sound intensity method to realize a natural sound field. In addition, the super elliptical baffle improves directivity as well as clear sound image localization.The input terminal for bi-wiring connection is adopted, and interference due to back electromotive force can be suppressed.

sections.title: VICTOR SX-1000
sections.overview:
450,000 (1 unit, on sale in 1987)  419,000 (1 unit, around 1989)

This is a large speaker system developed with the utmost technology and know-how to combine the resolution of the Zero Series with the sound field of the SX Series.Alnico magnet is used for the magnetic circuit of all units.Alnico is an alloy composed of nickel, cobalt, iron, aluminum, etc., and has excellent magnetic properties with a conductivity of more than 200 times and a magneto-resistance of about 1/4 compared to ferrite magnets. By this, the counter-electromotive current generated in the voice coil is strongly canceled, and a faithful response to the input signal is produced.In addition, the pot-type internal magnetic circuit, which realizes high magnetic flux and low leakage from the structure itself, acquires stronger drive energy.A 31.5 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.The diaphragm of this unit uses a new structure of fine cross-carbon cone that completely reduces the physical property degradation caused by epoxy binder.An 8 cm dome type skoker using fine diamond ceramics is mounted in the middle area.In this unit, we succeeded for the first time in converting a large diameter dome with a diameter of 6.5 cm into a pure fine ceramic, and at the same time, by coating this base substrate with amorphous diamond, we have achieved high sound velocity over a wide band.A 3-cm dome type tweeter is installed in the high range.The diaphragm of this unit is made of pure diamond ceramics with thin film coating of crystal diamond on alumina polycrystal fired dome. It realizes the highest level of propagation sound speed of 11,000m/sec. and the upper limit frequency characteristic is expanded to 2.24 times that of titanium.The frame of all units is made of high-rigidity round solid aluminum die-cast material with no meat escaping, and mounting to the baffle board is also carefully and evenly tightened to reduce harmful vibrations.In order to avoid interference and adverse effects of vibration, the network section uses a 3-division configuration with high input resistance and low distortion rate network. In addition, the devices are connected by a caulking method that reduces sound quality degradation, and OFC (oxygen-free copper) wire is used as wiring material.In addition, in order to prevent mutual interference between units due to the counter-electromotive current generated by the input, we have adopted a bi-wire-capable terminal that independently inputs low-range and middle-range signals.The cabinet is made of Karamatsu, a conifer with high rigidity and excellent damping characteristics, the front baffle is made of 38 mm thick plywood, and the front and rear double super elliptical baffles improve directivity and opening characteristics.The cabinet was designed using Victor's original sound intensity method. The cabinet was designed with a detailed examination of the direction and intensity of sound waves emitted from speakers in the actual room. The optimum mounting position of each speaker unit was determined and the G line unit arrangement was completed.In addition, the cabinet has a floor-type shape that can expand the internal volume to improve the quality of the low frequency range, and the internal structure has a reinforced structure with less harmful split vibration by modal analysis to improve the sound quality.The sound absorbing material inside uses 100% wool, which generates less noise due to vibration.(c) The RUNNET uses a frame shape with less acoustic reflection and a magnet catch system Saran board with no concave part to reduce the disturbance of radiation characteristics.There was a specially designed speaker stand that was sold separately.This stand is a solid combination of compressed laminated beech plywood and is also designed with a commercially available coin-shaped base for fine tuning of sound quality under various installation conditions.

sections.title: VICTOR ZERO-10F
sections.overview: This speaker system was developed by putting all of the Zero philosophy and technology to expand the frequency range and dynamic range with the aim of wider and more dynamic music playback.In order to realize light weight, high rigidity, and wide pistic motion, we have adopted a diaphragm made of fine ceramics, which has the hardness second to that of diamond and is physically and scientifically stable, for three units of low, middle, and high frequency.A 32 cm woofer with fine ceramic cone is used for the low range.The fine ceramic diaphragm made of aluminum cone increases the high-frequency resonance up to 3 kHz, which was limited to 800 Hz in the paper cone. This allows sufficient allowance for the 500 Hz crossover to achieve pistic motion in all operating bands.In addition, since the apex angle of the cone is too shallow for paper, the shape effect (fluctuation of frequency characteristics due to the concave of the cone) can be ignored. At the same time, the merits of the cone type, which hardly causes rolling phenomenon, are maintained.In addition, harmful unnecessary noise from the edge part is suppressed by the sealed edge structure, and the large 156 mm diameter and 23 mm thick strontium ferrite magnet is adopted for the magnetic circuit. Combined with the edge wound voice coil with high space factor, excellent driving force and linearity are obtained.7.5 cm fine ceramic dome type skoker is adopted for the middle area.The magnetic circuit uses a huge strontium ferrite magnet of the same size as the woofer, and the diameter of the center pole is the same as the woofer.In addition, it is designed with an emphasis on smooth connection with the woofer. The diaphragm is a deep draw-molded, light-weight, high-rigidity fine ceramic dome diaphragm, which is close to a hemisphere. This realizes a wide range of pistic motion from 200 hz to 14 khz over the 500 hz to 5 khz band.A dome tweeter made of 3.5 cm fine ceramic is used for the high frequency band.The fine ceramic layer is 2 ? m thick, which is less than one tenth the thickness of Woofer and midrange, and is made by PVD (physical vapor deposition) method. In addition, an aluminum ribbon edge-wound voice coil is directly connected to the dome without bobbin.In addition, a tangential edge with low amplitude distortion and a magnetic circuit with a high magnetic flux density of up to 19,500 gauss provide sufficient allowance.For ultra-high frequencies, we have adopted a dynaflat ribbon super tweeter in which a ribbon-like voice coil fused to a heat-resistant polyimide resin film directly drives air.The base film is made as thin as possible to extend the frequency response, and the voice coil and peripheral support are strengthened to improve the input resistance.We have also improved the lead wire extraction and the shape of the front horn to obtain a smooth response of up to 100 kHz, radiant energy and a wide dynamic range.The enclosure uses a highly curved super elliptical baffle to prevent adverse diffraction effects. The front baffle is molded from a special UG resin material with excellent acoustic properties and has strong reinforcing ribs based on modal analysis.In addition, the enclosure as a whole has been comprehensively examined to reduce internal standing waves and back pressure applied to the diaphragm, suppress unnecessary vibration, clarify the vibration support point of the unit, and strengthen the strength and center of gravity of the cabinet as a whole. * Built to order  800,000 (1 unit, released in November 1985)

As the laboratory ratory series and the highest point of the Zero series, this is a speaker system developed with all the technology to pursue a warm musical quality that will touch people's hearts.It is equipped with a 39 cm cone type unit for low range and 21 cm cone type unit for middle and low range.A composite cone of ceramic fiber and carbon cloth is used for the diaphragm, and smooth connection and flat energy are achieved by giving moderate internal loss.A 6.5 cm dome and a 3.0 cm dome type unit using a pure fine ceramic diaphragm, which is a polycrystalline artificial jewel diaphragm, are installed in the middle and high frequency ranges.This diaphragm was used for the first time in the world as a high-rigidity, high-speed ceramic dome with a single-layer structure without a metal base material. It has properties very close to those of ruby and sapphire and purifies the quality of the music range.The baffle plate is 38 mm thick and adopts a super elliptical shape to improve directivity, and the units are arranged in G-line layout based on computer Kaiseki.The sound absorbing material is made of 100% wool, which generates less noise due to vibration.The network section is a balanced type that is resistant to external disturbances. A high grade element is selected and used. The OFC wiring material is also caulked without solder.In addition, a gold plated terminal is used for the speaker terminal, and bi-amplifier drive is also available by removing the strapping bar.The front baffle of the enclosure is made of 38 mm thick larch plywood and has a super-elliptical shape to obtain excellent diffraction characteristics.Also, the arrangement of units and mutual sense are arranged in a smooth G-line based on computer analysis.The sound absorbing material inside the enclosure is 100% wool, which produces less noise due to vibration.There was a special speaker base sold separately.

sections.title: VICTOR SX-DW7
sections.overview:
135,000 (1 unit, released in November 2001)

A subwoofer system developed to realize the excitement of live performance.The unit is equipped with a 30 cm cone shaped woofer.The diaphragm is produced by an oven manufacturing method using SP pulp as the main component. This diaphragm is driven by a magnetic circuit exceeding 1,000 mT and a special voice coil with 5 layers structure.The cabinet uses a sealed system.30 mm MDF is used for the front baffle, 25 mm particleboards are used on both sides of the top and bottom, 25 mm MDF is used on the rear side, and the front and top are reinforced.The exterior is finished with a glossy coating of maple veneer.It is equipped with a velocity feedback type MFB servo in order to prevent the sound from becoming heavy and dull while reproducing up to the heavy and low range.In this circuit, the motion of the diaphragm is directly detected by the sensor attached to the voice coil, so that it strongly follows the music signal. This realizes low-frequency reproduction with excellent transient and faithful music source.D-class amplifier is used in the amplifier section.The latest Power MOS-FET has been carefully selected, and a specially designed PWM Class-D power amplifier circuit has been constructed to achieve a maximum output of 600W.Furthermore, we have succeeded in forcing the diaphragm to drive by the newly developed low-noise, high-efficiency switching power supply and MFB velocity feedback function.It is designed to continuously control the crossover of the high-cut filter in the range of 40 Hz to 120 Hz for matching with a wide range of speaker systems.It is equipped with an adaptive control circuit that maintains stable operation for any input signal.
